These orange units are yours.\f
These blue units are the enemy.\rThey belong to the Blue Moon Army.\f
cz: Tyto modre jednotky jsou nepratelske.\rPatri armade Blue Moon.\f

en: Defeat the enemy forces to\rcomplete this mission successfully.\f
cz: Znicte nepratelske sily a splnite\rtuto misi uspesne.\f

en: Well, let's issue some orders.\fThe cursor is used to give commands.\fThe + Control Pad\rmoves the cursor.\f
cz: Tak pojdme vydat nejake rozkazy.\fRozkazy se zadavaji kurzorem.\fOvladaci krizek\rposouva kurzor.\f

en: No, not there.\fPlace the cursor here\rand press the A Button.\f
cz: Ne, tam ne.\fPresunte kurzor sem\ra stisknete tlacitko A.\f

en: The action you just completed\ris called selecting.\fYou'll see this term often,\rso do your best to remember it.\fWhen you select a unit, the area\raround it will become highlighted.\fThis area represents the selected\runit's range of movement.\fFirst, let's approach\rthe enemy with this unit.\f
cz: Akce, kterou jste prave provedl,\rse nazyva vyber.\fTento pojem uslysite casto,\rtak si ho dobre zapamatujte.\fKdyz vyberete jednotku, okoli\rkolem ni se zvyrazni.\fTato plocha je dosah pohybu\rvybrane jednotky.\fNejprve se timto oddilem\rpriblizme k nepriteli.\f

en: Try moving the unit to this space.\fMove the cursor here and\rpress the A Button.\f
cz: Zkuste presunout jednotku sem.\fPresunte kurzor sem a\rstisknete tlacitko A.\f

en: That's not quite right.\fTry moving the unit again, please.\fPlace the cursor here and\rpress the A Button.\f
cz: To neni uplne spravne.\fZkuste jednotku presunout znovu.\fPresunte kurzor sem a\rstisknete tlacitko A.\f

en: The unit's color changed, right?\fThis indicates that the unit can't\rreceive any more orders this turn.\fDon't worry--you'll be able to use it\ragain on your next turn.\f
cz: Jednotka zmenila barvu, vidite?\fZnamena to, ze uz nemuze v tomto\rtahu prijmout dalsi rozkazy.\fZadny strach, pouzijete ji zas\rv pristim tahu.\f

en: Select this unit, please.\fRemember to press the A Button.\f
cz: Vyberte prosim tuto jednotku.\fNezapomente stisknout tlacitko A.\f

en: Eh? Orange Star Army units have\rmoved into the Alara region?\fHah! They won't last long.\fMy troops there will\rmake short work of them!\f
cz: Co? Jednotky Orange Star vtrhly\rdo oblasti Alara?\fHa! Dlouho tam nevydrzi.\fMoje vojska si s nimi\rporadi raz dva!\f

en: You scored damage on the enemy!\f
What are those fools doing?\fIf I were in the field, they wouldn't\rbe suffering such humiliation!\fCursed Orange Star Army!\rI will defeat it! I will!\f
cz: Co ti hlupaci vyvadeji?\fKdybych tam byl ja, nezazivali by\rtakove ponizeni!\fProklata armado Orange Star!\rPorazim te! Porazim!\f

en: It's your turn again.\fYou have a two-to-one advantage.\fThis battle is yours to win!\fBut, wait a minute.\f
cz: Zase jste na tahu.\fMate prevahu dva na jednoho.\fTuhle bitvu musite vyhrat!\fAle moment.\f

en: This unit took damage in\rthe last battle, didn't it?\fUnits lose some of their\rfirepower when damaged.\f
cz: Tato jednotka utrpela v minulem\rboji poskozeni, ze?\fPoskozene jednotky ztraceji\rcast sve palebne sily.\f

en: This is how the A Button is used\rto select units and issue commands.\fIf you make a mistake and want\rto change orders, use the B Button.\fIt's key that you remember this.\f
cz: Takto se tlacitkem A vybiraji\rjednotky a zadavaji rozkazy.\fKdyz udelate chybu a chcete\rrozkaz zmenit, pouzijte tlacitko B.\fJe dulezite si to zapamatovat.\f

en: You've defeated all\rof the enemy units!\fYour mission is a success!\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Znicil jste vsechny\rnepratelske jednotky!\fMise je uspesna!\fJen tak dal!\f

en: What? Inconceivable!\fThat land was mine! How did\rthey lose it so easily?\fGrrr... Next time,\rvictory will be mine!\f
cz: Coze? Nemozne!\fTa zeme byla moje! Jak ji mohli\rtak snadno ztratit?\fGrrr... Priste\rbude vitezstvi me!\f

en: Excellent!\f
You know, if you don't move here,\ryou won't be able to attack.\fWould you please move here?\f
cz: Vite, kdyz se nepresunete sem,\rnebudete moci zautocit.\fPresunte se sem, prosim.\f

en: You attacked the enemy\rfrom the mountains, right?\fDefensive cover in the mountains\ris this number here... a four.\f
cz: Zautocil jste na nepritele\rz hor, ze?\fObranne kryti v horach je\rtoto cislo tady... ctyri.\f

en: The defensive cover\ron the plains is a one.\f
took less damage\rthan the other.\f
Do you know why?\fIt's because of superior defensive\rcover. Remembering this is vital.\fYou should also keep in mind that\rmovement cost differs between units.\f
cz: Vite proc?\fDiky lepsimu obrannemu kryti.\rJe nutne si to pamatovat.\fTake mejte na pameti, ze cena\rpohybu se u jednotek lisi.\f

en: Oh, one more thing.\fIf at any point during the battle you\rneed to stop, there's a way to save.\fSaving will prevent you from having\rto start the same mission over again.\fPlease go to the Map Menu now.\fPlace the cursor on an empty\rspace and press the A Button.\f
cz: Jeste jedna vec.\fKdyz budete potrebovat kdykoli behem\rboje prestat, lze hru ulozit.\fDiky ulozeni nebudete muset zacinat\rstejnou misi znovu od zacatku.\fPrejdete ted do menu mapy.\fUmistete kurzor na prazdne pole\ra stisknete tlacitko A.\f

en: Excuse me, could you please\rdisplay the Map Menu now?\fPress the A Button when the\rcursor's on an empty space.\f
cz: Prominte, mohl byste ted\rotevrit menu mapy?\fStisknete tlacitko A, kdyz je\rkurzor na prazdnem poli.\f

en: You've done it!\fThese units really were\ron a covert operation.\fThanks to your planning, our\rtroops took minimal damage.\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Dokazal jste to!\fTyto jednotky byly opravdu\rna tajne operaci.\fDiky vasemu planu utrpela nase\rvojska minimalni ztraty.\fJen tak dal!\f

en: Aargh! Another failure!\fAfter all of my careful planning,\ranother botched mission!\fGrrr... Next time, I will prevail!\f
cz: Aargh! Dalsi neuspech!\fPo vsem tom peclivem planovani\rzase zpackana mise!\fGrrr... Priste zvitezim ja!\f

en: Would you move it here?\f
Move it here using the\rcursor and the A Button.\f
cz: Presunte ji sem kurzorem\ra tlacitkem A.\f

en: Move the unit to this position, please.\f
When you don't have any immediate\rgoals, it's best to move close to cities.\fSo, move to this space, please.\f
cz: Kdyz nemate zadny bezprostredni\rcil, je nejlepsi jit k mestum.\fPresunte se tedy sem, prosim.\f

en: It's your turn.\f
You may lose the battle if you\rforget to finish securing cities.\fAlways start your turn by having\runits complete previous orders.\f
cz: Muzete bitvu prohrat, kdyz\rzapomenete dokoncit obsazovani.\fZacinejte tah vzdy dokoncenim\rpredchozich rozkazu jednotek.\f

en: Now, this city is yours!\fIt's the same color as your troops,\rright? You can now use it as a base.\f
cz: A ted je toto mesto vase!\fMa stejnou barvu jako vase vojska,\rze? Muzete ho pouzit jako zakladnu.\f

en: So, now you can see that\rthese cities are under enemy control.\f
cz: Takze ted vidite, ze tato\rmesta ovlada nepritel.\f

en: By the way, gray\rcities are neutral.\f
Now, here's a problem for you.\f
cz: A ted maly ukol pro vas.\f

en: Yes, that's the correct choice!\fOf course, capturing either one\rof these cities is a plus for you.\fBut if you secure the enemy city,\ryou also reduce your foe's funds.\f
cz: Ano, to je spravna volba!\fObsazeni kteryhokoli z techto\rmest je pro vas samozrejme plus.\fKdyz ale obsadite mesto nepritele,\rsnizite mu take finance.\f

en: Oh, yes. There's one more thing\ryou need to know.\f
cz: Ach ano. Jeste jednu vec\rmusite vedet.\f

en: Really?\fOk, but just one.\f

Outstanding!\fYou've reclaimed the area and\rforced Blue Moon to withdraw!\fThere's one more thing\rI have to tell you.\fYou receive funds by\rcapturing cities, right?\fWell, once you clear a map,\ryou lose those funds. Sorry!\fGood luck on the next battle!\f
cz: Vyborne!\fDobyl jste oblast zpet a donutil\rBlue Moon k ustupu!\fJeste jednu vec vam\rmusim rict.\fZa obsazovani mest\rdostavate finance, ze?\fJenze jakmile dokoncite mapu,\ro tyto finance prijdete. Pardon!\fHodne stesti v dalsi bitve!\f

en: Oh, no!\rYou've been defeated...\fRegroup and try again.\rGood luck!\f
cz: Ale ne!\rByl jste porazen...\fSeradte se a zkuste to znovu.\rHodne stesti!\f

en: Olaf has his bases covered.\fIt looks like he understands the\rimportance of holding this area.\fAlmost all of our units heading for\rLost Fortress have been eliminated.\f
cz: Olaf ma zakladny dobre kryte.\fVypada to, ze chape, jak dulezite\rje tuto oblast udrzet.\fTemer vsechny nase jednotky mirici\rk Lost Fortress byly znicene.\f

en: To repair a unit, just move it to an\rallied city or a secure base.\f
cz: Opravu jednotky provedete tak, ze ji\rpresunete do sveho mesta ci zakladny.\f

en: If you don't move the unit into a city,\rit won't regain any HP.\fWould you move it here, please?\f
cz: Kdyz jednotku nepresunete do mesta,\rnedoplni si zadne HP.\fPresunete ji sem, prosim?\f

en: If you leave it out there next\rto the enemy, it's done for.\fLet's move it to a safe place.\f
cz: Kdyz ji tam nechate vedle\rnepritele, je s ni konec.\fPresuneme ji na bezpecne misto.\f

en: I'd like to repair this unit now, but\rthere's no safe place within\fits movement range. There's\rnothing we can do about that.\fLet's get it as close to a city as\rpossible and begin repairs next turn.\f
cz: Rad bych tu jednotku opravil, ale\rv jejim dosahu pohybu neni\fzadne bezpecne misto. S tim\rnic nenadelame.\fDostanme ji co nejbliz k mestu\ra opravu zacneme pristi tah.\f

en: Would you move it here, please?\f
I'm sorry for the confusion.\fWould you please move the unit here?\f
cz: Omlouvam se za zmatek.\fPresunete tu jednotku sem, prosim?\f

en: That's right. Thank you.\fBut we can't stop there, can we?\f
cz: Presne tak. Dekuji.\fAle tim to nekonci, ze?\f

en: Well, what to do now? How about\rgiving it a little assistance?\fLet's deploy other units around it to\rprevent it from being attacked.\fThis tactic is called building\ra defensive wall.\fOur available units are...\f
cz: Co ted? Co takhle ji trochu\rpomoct?\fRozmistime kolem ni dalsi jednotky,\raby na ni nepritel nedosahl.\fTato taktika se nazyva stavba\robranne zdi.\fK dispozici mame tyto jednotky...\f

en: Move it here to create\ra defensive wall.\f
cz: Presunte ji sem a vytvorte\robrannou zed.\f

en: At this point, our goal is to\rprotect this unit.\f
cz: Nasim cilem je ted ochranit\rtuto jednotku.\f

en: So, we need to block the enemy's\rapproach with one of our other units.\f
cz: Musime tedy zablokovat pristup\rnepriteli jinou nasi jednotkou.\f

en: There! Now the unit is safe\rfrom enemy attack.\fEnemy units can't cross allied\rlines and vice-versa.\fYou can see why a defensive wall is\rsuch an effective strategic tool.\f
cz: A je to! Jednotka je ted v bezpeci\rpred utokem nepritele.\fNepratelske jednotky nemohou projit\rnasimi radami a naopak.\fVidite, proc je obranna zed tak\rucinny takticky nastroj.\f

en: It's your turn.\f
Even regaining two HP per day,\rwe're not going to be ready in time.\f
cz: I kdyz denne dostaneme dve HP,\rnestihneme to vcas.\f

en: Great! Put the cursor here and\rmove to this spot.\f
cz: Vyborne! Dej kurzor sem a\rpresun se na toto misto.\f

en: The Blue Moon forces\rhave retreated!\fCapturing this area was vital\rto our strategy.\fYou did a great job!\fKeep up the good work.\f
cz: Jednotky Blue Moon\rustoupily!\fObsazeni teto oblasti bylo\rpro nasi strategii klicove.\fOdvedl jsi skvelou praci!\fJen tak dal.\f

en: Nell?\fSo, she does have her hand in this!\fThat explains why this little group\rhas been such unexpected trouble.\fThis is unforgivable! Next time, I\rwill give them a display of true might!\fMark my words!\f
cz: Nell?\fTakze v tom ma prsty ona!\fTo vysvetluje, proc ta mala skupinka\rdela tak necekane potize.\fTo je neodpustitelne! Priste jim\rpredvedu skutecnou silu!\fPamatujte si ma slova!\f

en: You lost. That's too bad.\fBetter luck next time.\f
cz: Prohral jsi. To je skoda.\fPriste budes mit vic stesti.\f

en: OK. Will you select this unit\rand move it here, please?\f
cz: Dobre. Vyber prosim tuto jednotku\ra presun ji sem.\f

en: Would you please move the\runit to this position?\f
also provide supplies simultaneously\rto any unit adjacent to it.\f
Thank you. Now, press the A Button\ragain to display the Command Menu.\f
cz: Diky. Ted znovu stiskni tlacitko A\ra zobraz nabidku prikazu.\f

en: Please move the unit here.\f
It will be easier to deploy this unit\rfrom a point near this base,\fso please deploy it to this position.\f
cz: Tuto jednotku snadneji nasadis\rz mista blizko zakladny,\ftakze ji nasad na tuto pozici.\f

en: to this point.\f
We need to move it\rtoward the base.\fWould you move it here, please?\f
cz: Musime ji presunout\rsmerem k zakladne.\fPresunes ji prosim sem?\f

en: Grrr... Curse you, Nell!\fLooks like you're bound and\rdetermined to get in my way!\fI'll have my troops swat\ryou like a fly!\f
cz: Grrr... At te vezme cert, Nell!\fVypada to, ze jsi rozhodnuta\rplest se mi do cesty!\fMe jednotky te rozplacnou\rjako mouchu!\f

en: OK. Now move the\runit here, please.\f
Let's move this unit.\fWould you select it, please?\f
Please move the unit to\rthis space.\f
Please move it here. Remember\rto press the A Button.\f
cz: Presun ji prosim sem. Nezapomen\rstisknout tlacitko A.\f

en: Please unload the unit\rinto this space.\fUse the + Control Pad\rto select this space, please.\f
cz: Vylod prosim jednotku\rna toto pole.\fPouzij ovladaci krizek\ra vyber toto pole.\f

en: First of all, you need to protect\rthese two cities.\f
Grrr...\fNext time, blast it! Next time!\f
It's too bad, but you lost.\fI have a feeling you'll win next\rtime though. Good luck!\f
cz: Je to skoda, ale prohral jsi.\fMam pocit, ze priste vyhrajes.\rHodne stesti!\f

en: Ha, ha, ha! I see you've failed\rto notice my new weapons, Nell!\fYou'll soon tremble before the power\rof the mightiest ground forces ever!\f
cz: Cha, cha, cha! Vidim, ze sis\rnevsimla mych novych zbrani, Nell!\fBrzy se budes trast pred silou\rnejmocnejsi pozemni armady vubec!\f

en: Olaf is one shrewd guy.\fLook at the units he's deployed.\rHe's always one step ahead of us.\f
cz: Olaf je vychytraly chlap.\fPodivej se, co vsechno nasadil.\rPorad je o krok pred nami.\f

en: I didn't think he'd have any air units.\rI guess I underestimated him again.\f
cz: Necekal jsem, ze ma letecke jednotky.\rZase jsem ho podcenil.\f

en: No, not that unit.\fSelect this unit, please.\f
cz: Ne, tuhle jednotku ne.\fVyber prosim tuto.\f

en: The enemy HQ is right below you.\f
cz: Nepratelske HQ je primo pod tebou.\f

en: OK, let's move it down here.\f
Do you think you could move it\rhere?\f
Good luck!\fI'm counting on you!\f
What in the...\fMy HQ has been stormed!\fNell, you troublesome little...\fYou saw that you couldn't survive\ra frontal assault, and so you pull\fthis out of your hat!\rGrrr...\fThis isn't over yet!\f
cz: Co to...\fMe HQ bylo obsazeno!\fNell, ty protivna mala...\fVidela jsi, ze celni utok\rneprezijes, a tak jsi vytahla\ftohle eso z rukavu!\rGrrr...\fJeste neni konec!\f

en: You routed the enemy?\fAmazing!\fI have to admit, I didn't\rthink you could destroy them all!\fKeep up the good work! Outstanding!\f
cz: Rozprasil jsi nepritele?\fUzasne!\fMusim uznat, ze jsem necekala,\rze je dokazes znicit vsechny!\fJen tak dal! Vynikajici prace!\f

en: All of my beautiful units...gone?\fImpossible!\fNell couldn't possibly do this\ron her own.\fGrrr...\fThis isn't over yet!\f
cz: Vsechny me krasne jednotky...pryc?\fTo je nemozne!\fTohle by Nell nikdy nedokazala\rsama.\fGrrr...\fJeste neni konec!\f

en: A frontal assault on so many enemies\rmakes for pretty tough odds...\fAs long as you don't forget to\rtake over the HQ, things should\fimprove. Better luck next time!\f
cz: Celni utok na tolik nepratel\rjsou dost mizerne sance...\fKdyz nezapomenes obsadit HQ,\rpujde to o dost lip.\fPriste budes mit vic stesti!\f

en: Ha ha ha!\fNell! Mobilizing your troops\ragain, are you?\fWell, you're too late!\fFly, my masters of the sky!\fFinish off these surviving troops, then\rdestroy that meddlesome Nell's units!\f
cz: Cha cha cha!\fNell! Zase mobilizujes\rsve jednotky?\fJenze je pozde!\fLette, moji panove oblohy!\fDorazte ty prezivsi jednotky a pak\rznicte jednotky te otravne Nell!\f

en: We forgot to refill the fuel tanks?\fWhat are you fools thinking???\fIs it that hard to refuel an aircraft?\fAugh!!!\fJust wait until next time!\f
cz: Zapomneli jsme doplnit palivo?\fCo si to vy hlupaci myslite???\fJe tak tezke natankovat letadlo?\fAaach!!!\fJen pockejte priste!\f

en: You've assembled a pretty\rwell-balanced army.\f
But since they're across the sea, you\rcan't easily attack them.\f
cz: Jenze jsou za morem, takze na ne\rjen tak nezautocis.\f

en: Now is our chance to test them.\fSelect this unit, please.\f
cz: Ted je sance je vyzkouset.\fVyber prosim tuto jednotku.\f

en: Do you remember what to do when\ryou have multiple potential targets?\fThat's right! Use the + Control Pad\rto choose one.\f
cz: Pamatujes si, co delat, kdyz\rmas vic moznych cilu?\fPresne tak! Ovladacim krizkem\rjeden vyberes.\f

en: Well done! I knew you'd do it!\fI don't need to tell you anything\rmore! Why don't you see how quickly\fyou can clear this map? Ten days is\fa good benchmark, but if you're really\rgood, you could do it in five.\fWell, good luck!\fI'm counting on you!\f
cz: Vyborne! Vedela jsem, ze to zvladnes!\fUz ti nemusim nic dalsiho\rrikat! Co takhle zkusit, jak rychle\ftuhle mapu zvladnes? Deset dni je\fdobra meta, ale kdyz jsi opravdu\rdobry, zvladnes to za pet.\fTak hodne stesti!\fSpoleham na tebe!\f

en: What?!?\fYou cleared this map that quickly???\fIncredible!\fI'm impressed at how far you've\rdeveloped your skills!\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Coze?!?\fTy jsi tuhle mapu zvladl tak rychle???\fNeuveritelne!\fJsem ohromena, jak moc\rses zlepsil!\fJen tak dal!\f

en: Well done!\fKeep up the good work!\f
Augh!!! I never had\ra chance this time!\fNELL!!!\fJust wait until next time!\f
cz: Aaach!!! Tentokrat jsem\rnemel sanci!\fNELL!!!\fJen pockej priste!\f

en: What's this?!?\fThey found my landing forces?\fAugh! There's no way around it!\fWe'll have to make due with what\rwe've got!\f
cz: Co to?!?\fNasli moje vylodovaci jednotky?\fAaach! Neni zbyti!\fMusime si vystacit s tim,\rco mame!\f

en: Incredible!\fI can't believed you cleared this map\rin just two days!\fSomeone with your skills may even\rbe able to earn the "S" ranking in\fCampaigns, War Room...maybe even\rthe Advanced Campaign!\fYou might enjoy the challenge!\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Neuveritelne!\fNemuzu uverit, ze jsi tuhle mapu\rzvladl za pouhe dva dny!\fS takovym umenim mozna ziskas\rhodnoceni "S" v Tazeni,\fValecne mistnosti...mozna i\rv Pokrocilem tazeni!\fTa vyzva by te mohla bavit!\fJen tak dal!\f

en: What?!?\fYou cleared this map in three days?\fIncredible!\fI'm very impressed that you've\rdeveloped your skills so much!\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Coze?!?\fZvladl jsi tuhle mapu za tri dny?\fNeuveritelne!\fJsem nadsena, jak moc\rses zlepsil!\fJen tak dal!\f

en: Well done!\fKeep up the good work!\f
Augh!!! How could my landing forces\rbe defeated?!?\fNow I'm in trouble!\fJust wait until next time!\f
cz: Aaach!!! Jak mohly me vylodovaci\rjednotky prohrat?!?\fTed mam potize!\fJen pockej priste!\f

en: Air units use fuel every day, so if\ryou don't refuel them, they'll crash.\fYou just have to stand tall and\rattack here. Better luck next time!\f
cz: Letecke jednotky kazdy den pali\rpalivo, a bez doplneni spadnou.\fTady se musis vzchopit a\rzautocit. Priste to vyjde!\f

en: If you leave the copter here, it'll be\rdestroyed immediately.\f
cz: Kdyz tu vrtulnik nechas, hned\rho znici.\f

en: Hurry up and get it out of there!\fCan you select it?\f
At first glance, it doesn't look like\rthere's anywhere it can pull back to...\fBut there is a way to save it!\f
cz: Na prvni pohled to vypada, ze\rnema kam ustoupit...\fPresto se da zachranit!\f

en: Move it here!\f
That took longer to explain than I\rthought it would.\fWell, let's move on to the\rnext unit's capabilities.\f
cz: Vysvetlovani trvalo dele,\rnez jsem cekala.\fTak pojdme na schopnosti\rdalsi jednotky.\f

en: Select this unit.\f
Move it over here.\f

So, we've got a naval battle on our\rhands here, eh?\fIf Nell hadn't taken out my air units,\rvictory would be much easier...\fBut they can't use most of their\rtroops, so that puts us on equal\ffooting. To battle!\f
cz: Takze nas ceka namorni bitva,\rco?\fKdyby Nell neznicila ma letadla,\rvitezstvi by bylo snazsi...\fJenze oni vetsinu svych jednotek\rpouzit nemuzou, takze jsme na tom\fstejne. Do boje!\f

en: It's your turn.\f
This was a very strategic point for\rOlaf to attack Orange Star.\fThanks to you, we managed to\rblock his assault! Thank you!\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Tohle misto bylo pro Olafuv utok\rna Orange Star klicove.\fDiky tobe se nam podarilo\rjeho utok zastavit! Dekuji!\fJen tak dal!\f

en: I never expected them to make it\rthis far...\fAugh!!! Just wait until next time!\f
cz: Necekal jsem, ze se dostanou\raz sem...\fAaach!!! Jen pockejte priste!\f

en: I have a bad feeling about this.\fIt looks like Olaf...\rhas been waiting for us.\fIf we let him use his power,\rthere'll be trouble.\fLet's take him out all at once!\fI'm going to leave this one up\rto you! Good luck!\f
cz: Mam z toho spatny pocit.\fVypada to, ze Olaf...\rna nas cekal.\fKdyz ho nechame pouzit silu,\rbude zle.\fSlozme ho jednim uderem!\fTuhle bitvu necham na tobe!\rHodne stesti!\f

en: Ha ha ha! I've been waiting for you.\fNow I shall unleash my power!\fHeavens, hear my cry!\fBLIZZARD!!!\f
cz: Cha cha cha! Uz jsem vas cekal.\fTed rozpoutam svou silu!\fNebesa, slyste muj hlas!\fBLIZARD!!!\f

en: It's Olaf's CO Power!\fThis is what he's been waiting for...\fWe've been caught in his trap!\fEvery CO has his or her own special\rpower--a CO Power.\fWhen Olaf uses his CO Power, a huge\rsnow storm drops in. It's devastating!\fBut I can't use my CO Power right\rnow.\fI'm sorry.\fThere's one more thing...\fOlaf is very adept in the snow.\fIt's this power that caught\rBlue Moon's eye.\fSnow lowers the movement\rrange of all units.\f
cz: To je Olafova CO sila!\fNa tohle cekal...\fPadli jsme do jeho pasti!\fKazdy velitel ma svou zvlastni\rschopnost -- CO silu.\fKdyz Olaf pouzije CO silu, prijde\robrovska snehova boure. Je nicive!\fJa ale svou CO silu ted pouzit\rnemuzu.\fOmlouvam se.\fJeste jedna vec...\fOlaf si ve snehu skvele vede.\fPrave proto si ho Blue Moon\rvsiml.\fSnih snizuje dosah pohybu\rvsech jednotek.\f

en: This has turned into a rough battle.\fBut it should stop snowing after a\rfew days.\fJust be patient and try to\rhold out until then.\f
cz: Z tohohle je drsna bitva.\fZa par dni by ale melo\rprestat snezit.\fBud trpelivy a snaz se\rdo te doby vydrzet.\f

en: Huh?\fThe snow stopped!!!\fAugh! I don't have enough time to\rbuild up my power again...\fBut...I must have put fear into their\rhearts! Go, my soldiers!\fDon't give them time to regroup!\fDefeat them all!\f
cz: Coze?\fSnezit prestalo!!!\fAaach! Nemam dost casu, abych\rsvou silu znovu nabral...\fAle...urcite jsem jim nahnal\rstrach! Vpred, vojaci!\fNedejte jim cas se seskupit!\fPorazte je vsechny!\f

en: You held out long enough!\fThe snow has stopped!\fYou'd better watch out, though...\rOlaf still has plenty of units.\fYou must regroup!\f
cz: Vydrzel jsi dost dlouho!\fSnezit prestalo!\fAle pozor...\rOlaf ma porad spoustu jednotek.\fMusis se preskupit!\f

en: It's started raining!\fThis is a real blessing!\fRain slows movement a little bit.\fMore importantly, rain punishes Olaf.\fHe'll be brought to a virtual standstill!\fYou have to move now!\fTake him out in one swift blow!\f
cz: Zacalo prset!\fTo je hotove pozehnani!\fDest trochu zpomaluje pohyb.\fHlavne ale Olafovi skodi.\fPrakticky se uplne zastavi!\fTed musis jednat!\fSloz ho jednim rychlym uderem!\f

en: What's this?\fIt's started raining???\fAugh!!!\fOur spirits will have to carry us!\f
cz: Co to?\fZacalo prset???\fAaach!!!\fBude nas muset nest bojovy duch!\f

en: Each CO has a unique special ability.\fIn Olaf's case, he works well\rin snow, but he's susceptible to rain.\fRegardless of that, you were\rgreat this time!\fIf you can win the next battle,\rthen I'll have taught you all I can.\fI think the next battle will be our\rlast one together.\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Kazdy velitel ma vlastni schopnost.\fOlafovi jde skvele snih,\rale dest mu vadi.\fI presto sis dnes vedl\rskvele!\fJestli vyhrajes dalsi bitvu,\rnaucila jsem te uz vsechno.\fMyslim, ze dalsi bitva bude nase\rposledni spolecna.\fJen tak dal!\f

en: Even my trap didn't work...\fIf... If I don't win soon, they'll get back\rall the land I went to the trouble of\fcapturing.\fAugh!!! Just wait until next time!\f
cz: Ani ma past nezabrala...\fKdyz... Kdyz brzy nevyhraju, vezmou si\rzpatky vsechnu pudu, kterou jsem\fs namahou dobyl.\fAaach!!! Jen pockejte priste!\f

en: Olaf's power causes it to snow.\fWhen it snows, you lose your\reffectiveness.\fJust try to group up as much\ras you can.\fBetter luck next time.\f
cz: Olafova sila privolava snih.\fVe snehu ztracis\rucinnost.\fSnaz se drzet jednotky\rco nejvic pohromade.\fPriste budes mit vic stesti.\f

en: What a terrible view! The surrounding\rarea is almost completely hidden.\fThis phenomenon is known\ras Fog of War.\fWhen it is present, units can only\rsee a limited distance.\fCheck each unit's vision range to\rascertain the distance it can see.\f
cz: Hrozny vyhled! Okoli je skoro\rcele skryte.\fTomuhle jevu se rika\rMlha valky.\fJednotky pak vidi jen\rna omezenou vzdalenost.\fU kazde jednotky si zkontroluj\rdosah jejiho videni.\f

en: The other lit areas are around your\rHQ, your cities, and other positions.\fThey're lit to lead you to them.\fThe areas around neutral cities or\renemy positions aren't, though.\fThey stay dark until you draw\rclose to them.\f
cz: Osvetlena mista jsou kolem tveho\rHQ, tvych mest a dalsich pozic.\fSviti, aby te k nim dovedla.\fOkoli neutralnich mest a\rnepratelskych pozic ale ne.\fZustanou tmava, dokud se\rk nim nepriblizis.\f

en: Move it over here.\f
These cities looked the same\rwhen they were dark, didn't they?\fWhen checking a city's allegiance,\rI suggest approaching with caution.\f
cz: Ve tme vypadala tahle mesta\ruplne stejne, ze?\fKdyz zjistujes, komu mesto patri,\rradim ti opatrny pristup.\f

en: Move it over here.\f
When you have a larger vision range,\rit's much easier to spot enemies.\f
cz: S vetsim dosahem videni je\rmnohem snazsi najit nepratele.\f

en: Oh, yes. Did you notice that this\rarea here is still dark?\fThat's because you can't see into\rwoods unless you're adjacent to them.\f
cz: Aha, vsiml sis, ze tahle oblast\rje porad tmava?\fDo lesa totiz nevidis,\rdokud nestojis hned vedle nej.\f

en: By the way, reefs are the same. They\rremain dark until you're next to them.\f
cz: S utesy je to stejne. Zustanou\rtmave, dokud nejsi hned u nich.\f

en: Let's go back a moment.\f
There could actually be something\rin this forest.\fWhy don't you send\ra unit to scout it out?\f
cz: V tomhle lese fakt neco\rbyt muze.\fCo takhle poslat\rjednotku na pruzkum?\f

en: You can move here or here to\rcheck the forest.\fMove it to one of those spaces.\f
cz: Les prozkoumas z tohoto\rnebo z tohoto mista.\fPresun ji na jedno z nich.\f

en: Now, another thing on the subject\rof forests and reefs.\fThis time, the enemy was using the\rterrain to conceal its troops, right?\fWell, you can do the same thing! Using\rthe terrain to hide is a good strategy.\fOf course, you'll be spotted if the\renemy moves next to you, but...\fDid you get all that?\fI told you before, if you need intel,\ruse the cursor and the R Button.\fPress the R Button, then use the\r+ Control Pad to read the intel.\fThis is the way to check out different\rterrains, including woods and reefs.\f
cz: Jeste jedna vec k lesum\ra utesum.\fNepritel ted vyuzival teren\rke skryti svych jednotek, ze?\fTy muzes delat to same! Skryvat se\rv terenu je dobra strategie.\fJasne, kdyz se nepritel postavi\rhned vedle tebe, uvidi te, ale...\fRozumis vsemu?\fRikala jsem ti, ze informace\rziskas kurzorem a tlacitkem R.\fStiskni tlacitko R a pak si\rovladacim krizkem precti data.\fTakhle si prohlednes ruzne\rtereny, vcetne lesu a utesu.\f

en: I'm going to leave the rest of this\rbattle to you. Good luck!\f
cz: Zbytek teto bitvy nechavam\rna tobe. Hodne stesti!\f

en: So, they've taken back most of the\rOrange Star territory...\fI'll concede this day,\rbut the real battle is yet to come!\f
cz: Takze vetsinu uzemi Orange Star\rzase ziskali zpatky...\fTenhle den vam prenecham,\rale prava bitva teprve prijde!\f

en: Well done!\fYou've finally driven Olaf off!\f
Andy! Come here!\f
Nell! What is it?\f
Be prepared, Andy can be\ra bit of a wiseacre.\f
cz: Pripravte se, Andy umi byt\rtrochu chytrak.\f

en: Well, good luck!\f

This is where I'll teach you some new\rcommands and other useful tidbits.\fSome of it may overlap with other\rthings I've taught you, though.\fSo, if you'd like to skip this\rlesson, just reset the game.\fTo reset, press START, SELECT,\rand the A and B Buttons at once.\fI'm going to begin now, OK?\fI'll explain a few things we haven't\rtouched on yet.\fI hope you'll try them all out.\f
cz: Tady te naucim nove prikazy\ra dalsi uzitecne drobnosti.\fNeco se mozna bude kryt s tim,\rco uz jsem te ucila.\fJestli chces tuhle lekci\rpreskocit, restartuj hru.\fRestartujes stiskem START, SELECT\ra tlacitek A a B naraz.\fZacinam, ano?\fVysvetlim par veci, ktere jsme\rjeste neprobrali.\fDoufam, ze si je vsechny zkusis.\f

en: When you want to move it over here,\ryou just move the cursor in a straight\fline and press the A Button, right?\f
cz: Kdyz ji chces presunout sem,\rposunes kurzor rovnou carou\fa stisknes tlacitko A, ze?\f

en: But right now there's an enemy here\rthat you can't see.\f
If you move in a straight line,\ryou'll run into it.\f
cz: Kdyz pujdes rovnou carou,\rnarazis do nej.\f

en: But pay attention to the red line that\rappears when you move the cursor.\fIt follows the cursor's path.\fDo you know what this means?\f
cz: Vsimni si cervene cary, ktera se\robjevi, kdyz hybes kurzorem.\fSleduje drahu kurzoru.\fVis, co to znamena?\f

en: This actually shows your unit's\rmovement direction.\f
So, your unit follows this path\rwhen it moves.\f
cz: Jednotka se pri pohybu\rvyda touhle cestou.\f

en: If you move the line over\rthis way, you'll be fine.\f
cz: Kdyz caru vedes tudy,\rbude to v poradku.\f

en: Just move the cursor like this!\f
Try it out yourself.\f
Move it over here.\f
No, I wanted you to move it\rover here.\f
That's it!\fThis is very handy in Fog of War\rsituations, so keep it in mind.\f
cz: Presne tak!\fV Mlze valky se to hodne hodi,\rtak na to nezapomen.\f

en: Uh-oh! You encountered an enemy...\fWhen a unit runs into an enemy,\rits turn automatically ends.\fThis, of course, can\rbe very dangerous.\fWhen you know an enemy is hiding\rnearby, avoid him with this technique.\f
cz: Ale ne! Narazil jsi na nepritele...\fKdyz jednotka narazi na nepritele,\rjeji tah automaticky skonci.\fTo muze byt\rhodne nebezpecne.\fKdyz vis, ze se nekdo skryva blizko,\rvyhni se mu touhle technikou.\f

en: Oh, unit data?\fThis gives you detailed information\rabout all of your units in the field.\fBut I've already told you that,\rhaven't I?\fYou can change what information\ryou see by moving the cursor.\fOh! One more thing...\fHave you ever wanted information\rabout the terrain the unit is on?\fJust press the R Button once more\rto view it! Try it yourself.\f
cz: Aha, data jednotek?\fUkazuji podrobne informace\ro vsech tvych jednotkach v poli.\fTo uz jsem ti ale\rrikala, ze?\fPohybem kurzoru zmenis,\rktere informace vidis.\fAha! Jeste jedna vec...\fChtel jsi nekdy informace\ro terenu, na kterem jednotka stoji?\fStaci znovu stisknout tlacitko R\ra uvidis je! Zkus si to.\f

en: The L Button, huh?\fThe L Button moves the cursor to\runits you haven't moved yet.\fThe Field Training maps have been\rsmall, so you haven't really needed it.\fOf course, the War Room and\rCampaign maps can be much larger...\fYou'll probably want to spread\ryour units out all over the map.\fThat's when it's quicker to use the\rL Button than to move the cursor.\fGive it a try!\f
cz: Tlacitko L, ano?\fTlacitko L presune kurzor na\rjednotky, kterymi jsi jeste nehnul.\fMapy Vycviku byly male,\rtakze jsi ho moc nepotreboval.\fMapy ve Valecne mistnosti a\rv Tazeni ale byvaji mnohem vetsi...\fNejspis budes chtit jednotky\rrozmistit po cele mape.\fPak je rychlejsi pouzit tlacitko L\rnez posouvat kurzor.\fZkus si to!\f

en: Terrain data...\fThis is where you get detailed\rinformation about the terrain.\fYou can check things like terrain\rcover and city income.\fMovement Cost shows a unit's\rmovement over the selected terrain.\fIt's easiest to view when it's\rcombined with unit data.\fOh, I almost forgot!\fYou can switch between terrain\rdetails and movement cost easily...\fJust press up and down\ron the + Control Pad.\f
cz: Data terenu...\fTady ziskas podrobne\rinformace o terenu.\fZkontrolujes treba kryti terenu\rnebo prijem z mesta.\fCena pohybu ukazuje pohyb\rjednotky po zvolenem terenu.\fNejlepe se to cte spolu\rs daty jednotek.\fAha, malem bych zapomnela!\fMezi detaily terenu a cenou\rpohybu prepnes snadno...\fStaci stisknout nahoru a dolu\rna ovladacim krizku.\f

en: Look at this...\fDo you see Type, HP, Gas, and\rRds (Rounds) all lined up here?\f
cz: Podivej se...\fVidis tu vedle sebe Typ, HP, Palivo\ra Muni (munice)?\f

en: Right now, the cursor is on Type.\fYou can press left and right on the\r+ Control Pad to choose a menu!\fTry it out.\f
cz: Kurzor je ted na polozce Typ.\fVlevo a vpravo na ovladacim krizku\rvyberes nabidku!\fZkus si to.\f

en: Then choose another menu.\f
Then choose another menu.\f
Like us--the Orange Star army.\f
A capture rate of 77% means we've\rcaptured 77% of the cities we\fcould possibly capture.\f
cz: Obsazeni 77% znamena, ze mame\r77% ze vsech mest, ktera\fjde vubec obsadit.\f

en: Income shows how much money we get\reach day from the cities we captured.\f
cz: Prijem ukazuje, kolik penez denne\rdostaneme z obsazenych mest.\f

en: Funds indicates how much money\ryou have right now.\f
cz: Finance ukazuji, kolik penez\rprave ted mas.\f

en: This is the status of your\rOrange Star army.\f
cz: Tohle je stav tve\rarmady Orange Star.\f

en: But you don't know about the\rBlue Moon army, do you?\fThe Fog of War prevents you from\rseeing what the enemy is doing.\f
cz: O armade Blue Moon ale\rnic nevis, ze?\fMlha valky ti brani videt,\rco nepritel dela.\f

en: That's all there is to say about that.\fChoose another menu.\f
cz: K tomu uz neni co dodat.\fVyber jinou nabidku.\f

en: In that case, try something else.\f

Ah, yes, the deployment menu.\fYour bases are where all of your\rland units have been deployed.\fThe number next to each unit is the\rcost of deploying that unit.\fIf it costs less than your total funds,\ryou can deploy the unit.\fAlso, because there are so many land\runits, they might not fit on one page.\fUse the + Control Pad to scroll to\rthe very bottom of the page.\fThat's right. You can use the units\rone day after you deploy them.\fJust remember that the units wait\rthe first day you deploy them.\fYou'll probably wonder what units\ryou should produce first. Which one\fwas the easiest to use in your\fField Training? Focus on those\rfirst, then slowly deploy others.\f
cz: Ano, nabidka nasazeni.\fZe zakladen nasazujes\rvsechny pozemni jednotky.\fCislo vedle kazde jednotky je\rcena jejiho nasazeni.\fKdyz je nizsi nez tve finance,\rmuzes jednotku nasadit.\fPozemnich jednotek je hodne,\rtakze se nemusi vejit na stranku.\fOvladacim krizkem sjed az\ruplne na konec stranky.\fPresne tak. Jednotky muzes pouzit\rden po jejich nasazeni.\fPamatuj, ze prvni den\rpo nasazeni jednotky cekaji.\fAsi te napadne, ktere jednotky\rstavet prvni. Ktera se ti\fve Vycviku pouzivala nejlip?\fNa ty se zamer nejdriv\ra pak pomalu nasazuj dalsi.\f

en: Oh. Then choose something\relse.\f

OK--airport deployment...\fAirports are where you'll deploy\ryour air units from.\fThe number next to the unit is how\rmuch it costs to deploy the unit.\fIf it is less than your total funds,\ryou can deploy the unit.\fUse the + Control Pad to select a\runit.\fYou can't use them on the same day\ryou deploy them, though.\f
cz: Dobre -- nasazeni na letisti...\fZ letist nasazujes\rsvoje letecke jednotky.\fCislo vedle jednotky je cena\rjejiho nasazeni.\fKdyz je nizsi nez tve finance,\rmuzes jednotku nasadit.\fJednotku vyberes ovladacim\rkrizkem.\fVe stejny den, kdy je nasadis,\rje ale pouzit nemuzes.\f

en: Come back anytime you want\rto hear an explanation again!\f
cz: Vrat se kdykoli budes chtit\rvysvetleni slyset znovu!\f

en: Oh, port deployment...\fPorts are where you'll deploy\ryour sea units from.\fThe number next to the unit is how\rmuch it costs to deploy the unit.\fIf it is less than your total funds,\ryou can deploy the unit.\fUse the + Control Pad to select a\runit.\fYou can't use them on the same day\ryou deploy them, though.\f
cz: Aha, nasazeni v pristavu...\fZ pristavu nasazujes\rsvoje namorni jednotky.\fCislo vedle jednotky je cena\rjejiho nasazeni.\fKdyz je nizsi nez tve finance,\rmuzes jednotku nasadit.\fJednotku vyberes ovladacim\rkrizkem.\fVe stejny den, kdy je nasadis,\rje ale pouzit nemuzes.\f

en: Oh. Just ask me anytime you\rwant to hear it.\f
cz: Aha. Rekni si kdykoli,\rkdyz to budes chtit slyset.\f

en: Thanks for listening!\fI hope I'll see you again soon.\f
cz: Diky za pozornost!\fDoufam, ze se brzy uvidime.\f

en: Nell? Is that you?\rIs this a transceiver?\f
cz: Nell? To jsi ty?\rTohle je vysilacka?\f

en: That's right, Andy. I'll be using it to\rcontact you from here on out.\fAs this is your first real command,\rI wanted to check up on you.\f
cz: Presne tak, Andy. Odted se ti\rbudu ozyvat pres ni.\fJe to tve prvni skutecne veleni,\rtak jsem se chtela ozvat.\f

en: No worries here! This is\rgoing to be easy!\f
Oh, Andy! You're nothing if\rnot enthusiastic.\fLet me give you a few\rwords of advice.\fFirst, let's talk about your\rCO Power.\f
cz: Ach, Andy! Nadseni ti\rrozhodne nechybi.\fDam ti par rad\rna cestu.\fNejdriv si promluvme\ro tve CO sile.\f

en: Nell?\rWhat is it?\f
Your Power Meter is full!\fAndy's CO Power lets you\rrepair all damaged units, right?\fDo you know when it's best to\ruse it?\f
cz: Ukazatel sily je plny!\fAndyho CO sila opravi vsechny\rposkozene jednotky, ze?\fVis, kdy je nejlepsi ji\rpouzit?\f

en: Um... No, I don't.\f
Well, I guess I'll have to tell you.\f
cz: Tak to ti to budu muset rict.\f

en: Since you're able to repair all of your\runits, you should use your Power\fwhen you have damaged units.\rOh, and one more thing.\f
cz: Kdyz umis opravit vsechny sve\rjednotky, pouzij svou silu\fve chvili, kdy mas poskozene kusy.\rAha, a jeste jedna vec.\f

en: When you use your Power, all\rof your units will be a little stronger\ffor that turn. Don't forget what\rI just told you, OK?\f
cz: Kdyz pouzijes svou silu, vsechny\rtve jednotky budou o kus silnejsi\fpro ten tah. Nezapomen na to,\rco jsem ti rekla, ano?\f

en: Is that clear?\f
I lost again!\fWho in the world are you?\f
Hey, grandpa. Who are you?\f
Who am I, you ask?\fThroughout Orange Star I\rwas known as...\f
cz: Ptas se, kdo jsem?\fV celem Orange Star me znali\rjako...\f

en: Nell's papa?\f
That's right, Nell's... What? No!\fThat's what I get for being nice\rto children! No respect!\fGrrr... You just watch yourself,\rlittle boy!\f
cz: Presne tak, Nellin... Coze? Ne!\fTo mam za to, ze jsem hodny\rna deti! Zadna ucta!\fGrr... Davej si pozor,\rklucino!\f

en: Olaf's Power isn't fair, is it?\fIt's almost impossible to move\rwhen it starts snowing.\fI suggest moving in groups\rin the snow.\fKeep up the good work!\f
cz: Olafova sila neni fer, ze?\fKdyz zacne snezit, je skoro\rnemozne se hnout.\fVe snehu doporucuji postupovat\rve skupinach.\fJen tak dal!\f

en: What's up, Nell?\f
Well, um...\f
Oh, my. Well, let's go through it again.\f
cz: Ale ne. Tak si to projdeme znovu.\f

en: First, place the cursor on a base and\rpress the A Button.\fA list of units will then be displayed.\rUse the + Control Pad to scroll\fthrough the list, and press the\rA Button to select the unit you want\fto deploy. Units that you can't afford\rwill appear in gray. Don't forget that.\fEach day, you'll receive funds from\rall of the bases you hold. You'll\fhave to make do with that amount.\rRemember, you can't deploy new units\fand move them on the same turn.\rHope you got all of that. Good luck!\f
cz: Nejdriv najed kurzorem na zakladnu\ra stiskni tlacitko A.\fZobrazi se seznam jednotek.\rSmerovym krizem v nem posouvej\fa tlacitkem A vyber jednotku,\rkterou chces nasadit. Jednotky, na\fktere nemas finance, jsou sede.\rNa to nezapomen.\fKazdy den dostanes finance ze\rvsech zakladen, ktere drzis.\fS tou castkou musis vystacit.\rPamatuj, nove jednotky nemuzes\fnasadit a hnout s nimi v jednom tahu.\rSnad je to jasne. Hodne stesti!\f

en: Yeah, Nell. We're here.\rWhat's going on?\f
cz: Jo, Nell. Jsme tady.\rCo se deje?\f

en: We've learned that Grit is\rthe opposing CO!\fGrit is an indirect-fire expert whose\rattack range is larger than normal.\fPlus, his range gets even bigger\rwhen he uses his CO Power!\fMake sure you check Grit's attack\rrange throughout the battle.\f
cz: Zjistili jsme, ze nepratelsky\rvelitel je Grit!\fGrit je expert na neprimou palbu,\rjeho dostrel je vetsi nez bezny.\fA kdyz pouzije svou CO silu,\rdostrel se jeste zvetsi!\fBehem cele bitvy sleduj Grituv\rdosah utoku.\f

en: Understood. Hey, Nell...\fHow do you know so much\rabout this guy?\f
cz: Rozumim. Hele, Nell...\fJak to, ze o nem vis\rtolik veci?\f

en: Well...we used to be...friends.\fUm,  that's all I had to tell you.\rNell out.\f
cz: No... kdysi jsme byli... pratele.\fEhm, to je vse, co jsem chtela.\rNell konci.\f

en: Huh? Nell was sure in a hurry.\rI wonder what was wrong?\f
cz: He? Nell mela najednou naspech.\rCo ji asi je?\f

en: Possum spit! This area wasn't\rBlue Moon's to begin with.\fBlue Moon is just plain greedy.\rThat's what it is.\fFightin' for these folks just\rdon't sit well with me.\fWell, I guess I'll just mosey on out\rand see what happens.\f
cz: Ale to je fuk! Tahle oblast\rBlue Moon nikdy nepatrila.\fBlue Moon je proste hrabivy.\rTak to je.\fBojovat za tyhle lidi mi\rnejak nesedi.\fInu, asi se tam potulim\ra uvidim, co z toho bude.\f

en: Stop calling me Junior!\fI have a name! It's Andy!\f
cz: Prestan mi rikat Junior!\fMam jmeno! Jsem Andy!\f

en: Well now! That's the spirit!\fY'all are new to the Orange\rStar Army, right?\f
cz: No teda! To je duch!\fVy jste v armade\rOrange Star novacci, vid?\f

en: Yeah, so?\fHey! How'd you know that?\f
cz: Jo, a co?\fHele! Jak to vis?\f

en: Grit's indirect fire abilities increase\rwhen he uses his CO Power.\fSo, you should try and take out his\rindirect combat units before his Power\fMeter fills up. His direct combat units\raren't very strong, so you shouldn't\fworry about them too much.\rGood luck on the next battle!\f
cz: Gritova neprima palba sili,\rkdyz pouzije svou CO silu.\fZkus tedy znicit jeho jednotky\rneprime palby drive, nez se mu\fnaplni ukazatel sily. Jeho jednotky\rprime palby nejsou moc silne,\ftak si s nimi nelam hlavu.\rHodne stesti v dalsi bitve!\f

en: Didn't Nell say this area was empty?\rAs in, no enemies?\f
cz: Nerikala Nell, ze je tu prazdno?\rTedy zadni nepratele?\f

en: Nell!\rThere are hostile forces here!\f
You're too late, Nell.\f
What? Does that mean\ryou're already under attack?\fWell... Um... Good luck!\f
cz: Coze? To znamena, ze uz\rjste pod utokem?\fNo... Ehm... Hodne stesti!\f

en: Nell left us! She ran away...\f
I... I lost?\fHuh? It's you! Andy!\f
cz: Ja... prohral jsem?\fHe? To jsi ty! Andy!\f

en: Yeah, but...who are you?\f
Don't play dumb with me, boy!\fI'll never forget what you've done!\f
cz: Nedelej ze mne hlupaka, hochu!\fNikdy nezapomenu, cos provedl!\f

en: Huh?\f
So, continuing to feign\rignorance, eh?\f
cz: Takze si dal hrajes na\rnevedomeho, co?\f

en: Very well, but the next time we\rmeet will be our last!\f
cz: Dobra, ale az se sejdeme\rpriste, bude to naposledy!\f

en: Hey! Wait up!\fHe's gone.\fWhat was that all about?\f
cz: Hej! Pockej!\fJe pryc.\fO co tu vlastne slo?\f

en: Cripes! I can't believe I have to be a\rnanny to this little kid...\f
cz: Sakra! Ja mam delat chuvu\rtomuhle capartovi...\f

en: I'm not a little kid! I'm a CO in\rthe Orange Star Army!\fAnd I don't need a nanny!\r...Whatever that is.\f
cz: Nejsem zadny capart! Jsem velitel\rarmady Orange Star!\fA zadnou chuvu nepotrebuju!\r...At uz je to cokoli.\f

en: Uh-huh.\fOK, little man, why don't you tell me\rhow to use the bases on this map?\f
cz: Aha.\fTak fajn, mrnousi, povez mi,\rk cemu jsou zakladny na teto mape.\f

en: No problem!\rYou use the naval base to deploy\fnaval units and the air base\rto deploy air units.\f
cz: Zadny problem!\rZ pristavu nasazujes namorni\fjednotky a z letiste\rvzdusne jednotky.\f

en: Not bad! I'm surprised you know\rthat much.\fBut if a CO doesn't have guts,\rhe's got nothin'.\fShow me what you can do, kid.\f
cz: Neni spatne! Divim se, ze toho\rvis tolik.\fAle velitel bez odvahy\rneni k nicemu.\fUkaz, co v tobe je, klucino.\f

en: Ha ha ha ha ha!\rBehold! Gaze upon my beautiful army!\fOrange Star may match me in\rnumbers, but I have so\fmuch more power!\f
cz: Ha ha ha ha ha!\rHlete! Pohledte na mou krasnou armadu!\fOrange Star se mi mozna vyrovna\rpoctem, ale ja mam\fdaleko vetsi silu!\f

en: But you're not very well balanced...\fWhat if the enemy send its subs\runder? That'll stop you cold.\f
cz: Ale nemate to moc vyvazene...\fCo kdyz nepritel posle ponorky\rpod hladinu? To vas zastavi.\f

en: Battleships at sea!\fMd Tanks on land!\fIs there anything more I need?\rNo! Nothing at all!\fAttack! Attack! Attack!\f
cz: Bitevni lode na mori!\fTezke tanky na zemi!\fPotrebuji jeste neco?\rNe! Vubec nic!\fUtok! Utok! Utok!\f

en: Well, as long as you're happy, Boss.\f
See? I told you!\f
Hey! Not bad, kid. Not bad at all.\f'Course, I woulda finished that up\ra bit quicker, but...\f
cz: Hej! Neni spatne, mrnousi. Vubec ne.\fJa bych to sice zvladl\ro kus rychleji, ale...\f

en: What did you say?\f
Huh? You wanna piece of me?\f
Knock it off, both of you!\fMax, this is hardly the mature\rbehavior I was expecting from you!\f
cz: Oba dva toho nechte!\fMax, tohle je sotva dospele\rchovani, jake jsem od tebe cekala!\f

en: But he started...\f
Max!\f
Hee, hee!\f
If you keep this up, you're going to\rhave your heads handed to you!\f
cz: Jestli takhle budete pokracovat,\rsetrou s vami podlahu!\f

en: Blast!\fGrit's troops are all around me!\fIf I stay put, I'll be blasted to\rsmithereens. If I retreat, our HQ\fwill be captured... How am I\rgonna get out of this?\f
cz: Sakra!\fGritovy jednotky jsou vsude kolem!\fKdyz zustanu, rozstrileji me na\rkusy. Kdyz ustoupim, obsadi nam\fHQ... Jak se z tohohle\rmam dostat?\f

en: Ya...Yahoo!\f
You're awful beat up to\rbe celebratin'.\f
cz: Na to, jak jsi zrizeny,\rdost slavis.\f

en: Well...\f
Yeah, exactly. You know, Maxie,\ryou never were any good at indirect\fcombat. Why, if you'd have just used\rthose big boys a little more, you\fwouldn't have taken such a poundin'.\f
cz: Jo, presne tak. Vis, Maxie,\rneprima palba ti nikdy moc\fnesla. Kdybys ty velky hochy\rpouzival trochu vic, tak\fbys tak nedostal na frak.\f

en: Um...\f

And long as I'm givin' you what-for,\rwhat's up with you and the kid?\fHe ain't got your particular\rshortcomings, so give him a break!\fHe's pretty darn good, and you know\rit. C'mon Maxie, what do you say?\f
cz: A kdyz uz ti to takhle vytmavuju,\rco mas s tim klukem?\fOn tvoje slabiny nema,\rtak mu dej pokoj!\fJe zatracene dobry a ty to vis.\rNo tak, Maxie, co ty na to?\f

en: Yeah...I guess you're right.\fHey! Andy!\rSorry for being such a jerk.\f
cz: Jo... asi mas pravdu.\fHej! Andy!\rPromin, ze jsem byl takovy pitomec.\f

en: Huh?\fAs long as you're cool,\rI'm cool.\fHey, Grit!\f
cz: He?\fKdyz jsi v pohode ty,\rjsem i ja.\fHej, Grit!\f

en: What's up, Junior?\f
How many times do I have\rto tell you to stop calling me Junior?\f
cz: Kolikrat ti mam rikat,\rabys mi nerikal Junior?\f

en: Whoa! I hear you, I hear you.\rMy apologies.\fWell now, look at the time.\rGotta go, boys!\fSee y'all later! Take care, Junior.\f
cz: Klid! Slysim te, slysim.\rOmlouvam se.\fNo teda, koukni na ten cas.\rMusim jit, hosi!\fTak zas nekdy! Opatruj se, Junior.\f

en: Fog of War...\f
Good memory!\fI guess there's no need for any\rspecial explanation, then.\fLet's get started!\f
cz: Dobra pamet!\fTak to asi nepotrebujes zadne\rzvlastni vysvetlovani.\fPustme se do toho!\f

en: The things I do for my country... (sigh)\fThis gray stuff that's blocking our\rvision, that's Fog of War.\fAs you can imagine, the enemy\ris out there, hidden.\f
cz: Co vsechno pro vlast neudelam... (ach)\fTa seda mlha, co nam brani\rve vyhledu, to je Mlha valky.\fJak si dovedes predstavit, nepritel\rje tam nekde schovany.\f

en: Wow, that's creepy.\fSo, how do we find the bad guys?\f
cz: Teda, to je desive.\fJak teda najdeme ty zlouny?\f

en: Hm hm hm...\fHee hee hee...\fHa ha ha ha ha!\fBehold!\rOlaf's Navy is here!\fIt's no longer just battleships, I've\rassembled a complete armada!\f
cz: Hm hm hm...\fChi chi chi...\fHa ha ha ha ha!\fHlete!\rOlafovo namornictvo je tu!\fUz to nejsou jen bitevni lode,\rdal jsem dohromady celou flotilu!\f

en: Um... Pardon me, Your Stoutness,\fbut if the enemy heads inland, your\rnaval powerhouse'll be useless.\f
cz: Ehm... Prominte, Vase Statnosti,\fale kdyz nepritel vyrazi do vnitrozemi,\rvase flotila bude k nicemu.\f

en: Now it's my turn!\fMy fleet will crush those detestable\rOrange Star fools!\fHa ha ha ha ha!\f
cz: Ted je rada na mne!\fMa flotila rozdrti ty odporne\rhlupaky z Orange Star!\fHa ha ha ha ha!\f

en: But you don't even have a single\rinfantry or mech unit deployed, and...\fMan, he ain't even listenin'.\f
cz: Ale vy nemate nasazenou ani jednu\rpechotu nebo mecha a...\fClovece, on me vubec neposloucha.\f

en: Grrr... I... I lost again...\f
This will be such a disservice to...\rhim...if things continue this way.\fGrit!\f
cz: Takhle... jemu... jen uskodim,\rkdyz to takhle pujde dal.\fGrit!\f

en: Yep.\f
Get out there and stop\rthe Orange Star Army!\f
cz: Vyraz tam a zastav\rarmadu Orange Star!\f

en: That's easy to say, Boss.\rBut you left me nothin' to work with.\f
cz: To se snadno rekne, sefe.\rAle nenechal jste mi vubec nic.\f

en: Don't get saucy! Just rally the\rtroops and do something!\fI must go and pay...him...my respects.\fI'll return later.\f
cz: Zadne reci! Seber vojska\ra neco udelej!\fMusim jit vzdat...jemu...uctu.\fVratim se pozdeji.\f

en: Well, well, he's finally off to visit\rthe mystery man.\fThink I'll just tag along and see\rwhat I can see.\f
cz: Ale ale, konecne jde za tim\rzahadnym chlapikem.\fAsi se povezu za nim a uvidim,\rco se da videt.\f

en: Inconceivable!\fMy beautiful navy has\rbeen destroyed!\fYou... You villains!\fNow you'll have to face\rOlaf's Sea Strike!\f
cz: Nemyslitelne!\fMe krasne namornictvo\rbylo zniceno!\fVy... Vy darebaci!\fTed se postavite\rOlafovu Uderu z more!\f

en: Olaf's Navy was as strong\ras we expected.\fYou went head to head with him, but...\fYou should have moved all\rof your troops inland.\fIf you're away from the sea, you're\rout of the battleships' attack range!\fThen you could've concentrated on\rcapturing the enemy HQ.\fOh, well. Better luck next time.\f
cz: Olafovo namornictvo bylo silne,\rjak jsme cekali.\fPostavil ses mu celem, ale...\fMel jsi presunout vsechny\rsve jednotky do vnitrozemi.\fDaleko od more jsi mimo\rdostrel bitevnich lodi!\fPak by ses mohl soustredit na\robsazeni nepratelskeho HQ.\fNo nic. Priste vic stesti.\f

en: Gimme a break!\rNot this guy again.\f
cz: To si delas srandu!\rZase tenhle chlap.\f

en: What's wrong, Max?\rDon't you like Olaf?\f
That's probably the safest way to\rweather a storm.\fAnyway, let's move out!\f
cz: To je asi nejbezpecnejsi zpusob,\rjak preckat bouri.\fTak jdeme na to!\f

en: Get moving!\fYeah! Right there!\fGet 'em!\fHa ha ha ha ha!\f
cz: Pohyb!\fAno! Presne tam!\fNa ne!\fHa ha ha ha ha!\f

en: Grrr... Another defeat!\f
He will not be pleased with me\rif this losing streak continues.\fGrit!\f
cz: Nebude se mnou spokojeny,\rkdyz budu dal prohravat.\fGrit!\f

en: Yep.\f
Get out there and stop that\rcursed Orange Star Army!\f
cz: Vyraz tam a zastav tu\rproklatou armadu Orange Star!\f

en: Easier said than done, Boss. You\rdidn't leave me anything to work with.\f
cz: To se snadno rekne, sefe.\rNenechal jste mi vubec nic.\f

en: Don't get saucy!\rRally the troops and do something!\fI have to go and pay...him...my respects.\fDon't fail me, Grit!\f
cz: Zadne reci!\rSeber vojska a neco udelej!\fMusim jit vzdat...jemu...uctu.\fNezklam me, Grit!\f

en: Well, well, well...\fOlaf's finally off to see his\rmysterious benefactor.\fThink I'll just tag along behind and\rsee what I can see.\f
cz: Ale ale ale...\fOlaf konecne vyrazil za svym\rzahadnym dobrodincem.\fAsi se povezu za nim a uvidim,\rco se da videt.\f

en: Well, Max. You're here to help, too?\f
cz: Tak, Max. Ty jsi prisel taky pomoct?\f

en: How you doin', Nell?\fNow that I'm here, what's the\rkid gonna do?\f
cz: Jak se vede, Nell?\fKdyz uz jsem tady, co bude\rdelat ten kluk?\f

en: Oh, Max. You haven't changed a bit.\f
But I must tell you, Andy's\rquite a capable CO.\fIf you're not careful,\rhe may just pass you up.\fSee you later. Good luck!\f
cz: Ale musim ti rict, Andy je\rdocela schopny velitel.\fKdyz si nedas pozor,\rmuze te i predbehnout.\fZatim. Hodne stesti!\f

en: How's that? What do you think\rof that power?\f
cz: Tak co? Co rikas\rna tuhle silu?\f

en: Cool! There's no way I could do\rthat much damage.\f
cz: Super! Ja bych takove skody\rnikdy nenadelal.\f

en: Yeah! That's right!\f
As long as I didn't use\rmy indirect combat units, that is.\f
cz: Tedy pokud jsem nepouzil sve\rjednotky neprime palby.\f

en: Oooh...you...\f
That's exactly right.\fMax doesn't use indirect combat units\rbecause he's clumsy.\f
cz: Presne tak.\fMax nepouziva jednotky neprime\rpalby, protoze je nemotorny.\f

en: And your range of fire is small, too.\rThat's life threatening, isn't it?\f
cz: A tvuj dostrel je taky maly.\rTo je zivotu nebezpecne, ze?\f

en: Ha!\fI'll do just fine without relying\ron those units.\f
cz: Ha!\fZvladnu to i bez spolehani\rna takove jednotky.\f

en: I wonder about that.\fAnyway, excellent work, Max!\fNow, you two work together\rand try to get along.\f
cz: To bych rada videla.\fKazdopadne skvela prace, Max!\fA ted spolupracujte\ra snazte se vychazet.\f

en: You heard the lady. Let's\rstop fighting and do this, Andy.\f
cz: Slysels tu damu. Prestanme\rse hadat a jdeme na to, Andy.\f

en: I think she was talking to you, Max.\f
cz: Myslim, ze to rikala tobe, Max.\f

en: Each CO has his or\rher own CO Power.\fDo you think it might\rbe a good idea to try another CO?\fBest of luck!\f
cz: Kazdy velitel ma svou\rvlastni CO silu.\fNechces zkusit\rnejakeho jineho velitele?\fHodne stesti!\f

en: Fog of War...\f
What's "Fog of War"?\f
Please tell me you're joking.\fSee that gray stuff blocking your\rvision? That's Fog of War.\fNow, I wonder where the enemy\rtroops are hidden.\f
cz: Rekni, ze delas srandu.\fVidis tu sedou mlhu, co brani\rve vyhledu? To je Mlha valky.\fTak kdepak asi jsou schovane\rnepratelske jednotky.\f

en: How do we find 'em?\f
Boy, that seems pretty simple.\f

You just don't know enough to\rrealize the danger, Andy.\fIf we can hide units in the woods,\rthen so can our opponent.\fIf we're not careful, hidden units\rwill blow us away!\fAll right. Let's move out!\f
cz: Jen toho vis moc malo, abys\rvidel to nebezpeci, Andy.\fKdyz muzeme schovat jednotky\rv lese, muze to i nepritel.\fKdyz si nedame pozor, skryte\rjednotky nas rozstrileji!\fDobra. Vyrazime!\f

en: Howdy Max. Long time, no see.\f
cz: Zdravim, Max. Dlouho jsme se nevideli.\f

en: Grit? Is that you?\fI was wondering why I hadn't seen you\raround lately, and now I know.\fYou're working for Blue Moon!\rYou traitorous piece of gar--\f
cz: Grit? To jsi ty?\fRikal jsem si, proc te posledni\rdobou nevidim, a ted to vim.\fDelas pro Blue Moon!\rTy zradna hromado sme--\f

en: Aww, Maxie. Don't be like that.\fI got my reasons for doin' what\rI do, you know?\fMan, I'm getting out of here before\ryou get started preachin' again.\fSee y'all down the road!\f
cz: Ale Maxie. Nebud takovy.\fMam sve duvody, proc delam,\rco delam, vis?\fRadsi zmizim driv, nez zase\rzacnes kazat.\fTak nekdy na ceste!\f

en: Hold it, Grit!\fDang! He got away.\fBut what's he doing\rwith Blue Moon?\f
cz: Stuj, Grit!\fSakra! Utekl.\fAle co dela\rs Blue Moon?\f

en: Grit's going to hide some units in\rthe woods.\fIt's important that you remember that\rand advance with the utmost caution.\fBetter luck next time.\f
cz: Grit schova cast jednotek\rv lese.\fPamatuj na to a postupuj\rs nejvetsi opatrnosti.\fPriste vic stesti.\f

en: What is it, Nell?\f
I've learned that this is a vital\rdeployment point for Olaf.\fIf we can drive him from the region,\rwe may just cripple his army!\f
cz: Zjistila jsem, ze tohle je pro\rOlafa klicove misto nasazeni.\fKdyz ho z oblasti vytlacime,\rmuzeme ochromit jeho armadu!\f

en: Really? This may be where we can\rend this conflict with Olaf!\f
cz: Vazne? Tady mozna ten konflikt\rs Olafem ukoncime!\f

en: That's right!\fYou just need to capture as much\rproperty as possible, and fast!\fThe first army to secure twelve\rproperties will win this battle!\fStay alert and good luck!\f
cz: Presne tak!\fStaci obsadit co nejvic\rbudov, a to rychle!\fPrvni armada, ktera obsadi\rdvanact budov, bitvu vyhraje!\fBud ve strehu a hodne stesti!\f

en: Let's see... Yep, we've got\rbases for deploying troops, and...\fOK! Understood. Let's go!\f
cz: Tak schvalne... Jo, mame\rzakladny na nasazovani vojsk a...\fJasne! Rozumim. Jdeme!\f

en: Grrr... Not again!\fHe will not be pleased with me\rif this losing streak continues.\fGrit!\f
cz: Grr... Zase ne!\fNebude se mnou spokojeny,\rkdyz budu dal prohravat.\fGrit!\f

en: Yep.\f
Get out there and stop that\rcursed Orange Star Army!\f
cz: Vyraz tam a zastav tu\rproklatou armadu Orange Star!\f

en: Easier said than done, Boss. You\rdidn't leave me anything to work with.\f
cz: To se lehko rekne, sefe. Nenechal\rjsi mi s cim delat.\f

en: Don't get saucy!\rRally the troops and do something!\fI have to go and pay him my respects.\fDon't fail me, Grit!\f
cz: Nedrz hubu tak nahoru!\rSeber vojsko a udelej neco!\fMusim mu jit vzdat hold.\fNezklam me, Grit!\f

en: Well, I'll be a... Olaf just tucked his\rtail between his legs and ran away.\fWhere does that leave me?\fGuess I'll mosey on down and\rclean up his mess.\f
cz: No to me podrz... Olaf stahl ocas\rmezi nohy a vzal do zajecich.\fA co ja ted?\fAsi se tam dokodrcam a uklidim\rten jeho svincik.\f

en: Too bad. The enemy captured twelve\rproperties first and won.\f
cz: Smula. Nepritel obsadil dvanact\rbudov driv a vyhral.\f

en: Reefs here, woods there,\rhiding places everywhere...\fMan, this place was made for Grit\rand his indirect-combat units.\fI really just want to rush in and\rget to stompin', but...\fThe smart thing to do is to use\rthe terrain and creep up on 'em.\fYep, that's the best plan.\rLet's move out!\f
cz: Tady utesy, tamhle lesy,\rkryt na kazdem kroku...\fClovece, tohle je delane pro Grita\ra jeho neprimou strelbu.\fNejradsi bych se tam vrhnul a\rdupal po nich, jenze...\fChytre je vyuzit teren a\rpomalu se k nim priplizit.\fJo, to je nejlepsi plan.\rVyrazime!\f

en: Well, here I am again.\fThis whole thing don't sit well with me,\rbut I guess I gotta stop foolin' around.\fI figure the best way to stop these\rboys is to take out their lander.\fYeah, that'll keep 'em from movin'\rthose ground troops around.\fReckon I'd best get started.\f
cz: Tak jsem zase tady.\fCelou tuhle vec mam proti srsti,\rale uz musim prestat lelkovat.\fNejlepsi zpusob, jak ty hochy\rzastavit, je sundat jim vysadkovou lod.\fJo, pak uz ty pozemni jednotky\rnikam neprevezou.\fRadsi se do toho dam.\f

en: OK, Grit! Now you're going to\ranswer some questions!\fWhy in blazes did you\rgo over to Blue Moon?\f
cz: Tak jo, Grit! Ted budes\rodpovidat na otazky!\fProc ses ksakru pridal\rk Blue Moon?\f

en: Grit!\f
Nell? What are you doing here?\f
Hey there, Nell. It's been a long time.\f
cz: Ahoj, Nell. Dlouho jsme se nevideli.\f

en: Max. Would you please\rleave us alone for a minute?\f
cz: Max. Mohl bys nas na chvili\rnechat o samote?\f

en: Yeah... Sure...\f
You look well. I was worried.\f
Yeah, I'm doin' all right.\fHow about you?\rYou and Max getting along all right?\f
cz: Jo, mam se docela fajn.\fA co ty?\rVychazite s Maxem v pohode?\f

en: So that's the reason you left\rOrange Star.\fYou sensed Max's feelings, and\rbecause he's your friend, you...\f
cz: Takze proto jsi odesel\rz Orange Star.\fVycitil jsi, co Max citi, a\rprotoze je to tvuj pritel, tak...\f

en: Whoa! Hold on, now. Let me\rset you straight.\fI did what I did 'cause that's\rwho I am, darlin'.\fI go where I want to go, and stay\rwhere I want to stay. That's it.\f
cz: Hola! Zadrz. Rovnou ti to\rvysvetlim.\fUdelal jsem to proto, ze\rtakovej proste jsem, zlaticko.\fChodim, kam chci, a zustavam\rtam, kde chci. A to je vsechno.\f

en: Oh, I...\f
See you later, Nell. Take care.\f
Grit...\fGoodbye.\f
Those look like Green Earth troops.\fI've heard they have an independent\rbattalion around. Maybe this is it.\fThey're supposed to be really tough.\rEspecially the air units.\f
cz: Vypadaji jako vojska Green Earth.\fPry tu nekde maji samostatny\rprapor. Mozna je to prave tenhle.\fMaji byt hodne tvrdi.\rHlavne jejich letectvo.\f

en: That's a Special Forces\rcommander for you!\fAlways up on the latest intel.\f
cz: To je velitel specialnich\rjednotek, jak ma byt!\fVzdycky ma cerstve informace.\f

en: But how did you get this\rintel, Andy?\f
cz: Ale jak jsi k tem informacim\rprisel, Andy?\f

en: I ran into 'em once, and...\f
cz: Jednou jsem na ne narazil a...\f

en: Hey, you survived, didn't you?\fThat's pretty impressive, Andy.\f
cz: Hele, prezil jsi to, ne?\fTo je dost dobre, Andy.\f

en: Yeah, Nice work, Andy.\fAll right, let's roll!\f
cz: Jo, dobra prace, Andy.\fTak jo, jedem!\f

en: The Orange Star Army...\rAndy's troops.\f
This time, I won't be beaten\rby Andy and his ilk.\fI shall crush them with one stroke!\f
cz: Tentokrat me Andy a jemu\rpodobni neporazi.\fRozdrtim je jedinou ranou!\f

en: I, Eagle, beaten by Andy, again?\f
Who are you calling Andy?\f
Eh?\f
I think I'll take offense at your\rmistake. Do I look like a boy to you?\f
cz: Ten tvuj omyl me trochu urazil.\rVypadam snad jako kluk?\f

en: Who are you?\f
The name's Sami.\fI'm an Orange Star CO.\f
cz: Jmenuju se Sami.\fJsem velitelka Orange Star.\f

en: I... I lost to...a girl?\f
You're careless. That's why\ryou keep losing!\fI don't think you're ready for war.\rYou need to go back to basic training!\f
cz: Jsi nepozorny. Proto porad\rprohravas!\fNa valku jeste nejsi zraly.\rVrat se na zakladni vycvik!\f

en: Excuse me, Orange Star CO...Sami?\f
Yes?\f
I would like to apologize for my\rbehavior. It was inappropriate.\f
cz: Rad bych se omluvil za sve\rchovani. Bylo nemistne.\f

en: Oh, OK...\f
I vow by my lucky goggles that the\rnext time we meet, I will do better.\f
cz: Prisaham pri svych brylich, ze\rpriste si povedu lepe.\f

en: Now I will take my leave. Farewell.\f
Wait, wait a minute!\fNo one said you could leave. Come...\fHe's gone!\f
cz: Pockej, pockej chvilku!\fNikdo ti nerekl, ze muzes odejit...\fJe pryc!\f

en: He seems like a pretty\rdecent guy, after all.\f
I, Eagle, lost again?\f
Yeah, it sure looks like it!\f
You're the Orange Star CO?\rWhere's Andy?\f
cz: Ty jsi velitel Orange Star?\rKde je Andy?\f

en: Andy? Listen up, pal. I'm Max.\rThe best Orange Star has to offer!\f
cz: Andy? Poslouchej, kamarade. Ja jsem Max.\rTo nejlepsi, co Orange Star ma!\f

en: I'd heard of a CO who was as strong\ras a bull but a bit one-dimensional.\fWho could have foreseen that\rI would lose to him?\f
cz: Slysel jsem o veliteli silnem\rjako byk, ale trochu jednostrunnem.\fKdo mohl tusit, ze s nim\rprohraju?\f

en: What? What did you say?\f
I don't think you're ready for war!\f
cz: Na valku podle me jeste nejsi zraly!\f

en: Who... Who are you?\f
Hold it!\rWhat about me is one-dimensional?\f
You stink at indirect combat.\f
Rrr...\f
Yes?\f
I would like to apologize for my\rbehavior. It was inappropriate.\f
cz: Rad bych se omluvil za sve\rchovani. Bylo nemistne.\f

en: Oh, OK...\f
I vow by my lucky goggles that the\rnext time we meet, I will do better.\f
cz: Prisaham pri svych brylich, ze\rpriste si povedu lepe.\f

en: Now I will take my leave. Farewell\f
Wait! Wait a minute!\rNo one said you could leave. Come...\f
cz: Pockej! Pockej chvilku!\rNikdo ti nerekl, ze muzes odejit...\f

en: He seems like a pretty\rdecent guy after all.\f
I, Eagle, lost again?\f
Yeah. I don't think you're\rready for war!\f
cz: Jo. Na valku podle me jeste\rnejsi zraly!\f

en: Who... Who are you?\f
The name's Sami.\fI'm an Orange Star CO!\f
cz: Jmenuju se Sami.\fJsem velitelka Orange Star!\f

en: I cannot believe I lost to\rthis group of unseasoned...\f
cz: Nemohu uverit, ze jsem prohral\rs touhle bandou zelenacu...\f

en: You're careless! That's why\ryou keep losing!\fWe're an experienced group of\rCOs here, you know!\fYou need to go back to basic\rtraining and start again.\f
cz: Jsi nepozorny! Proto porad\rprohravas!\fJsme tu ostrileni velitele,\raby bylo jasno!\fVrat se na zakladni vycvik\ra zacni od zacatku.\f

en: Excuse me, Orange Star CO...Sami?\f
Yes?\f
I would like to apologize for my\rbehavior. It was inappropriate.\f
cz: Rad bych se omluvil za sve\rchovani. Bylo nemistne.\f

en: Oh, OK...\f
I vow by my lucky goggles that the\rnext time we meet, I will do better.\f
cz: Prisaham pri svych brylich, ze\rpriste si povedu lepe.\f

en: Now I will take my leave. Farewell.\f
Wait! Wait a minute!\fNo one said you could leave. Come...\fHe's gone!\f
cz: Pockej! Pockej chvilku!\fNikdo ti nerekl, ze muzes odejit...\fJe pryc!\f

en: He seems like a pretty\rdecent guy after all.\f
Oh, no... I was just planning on\rpassing through Yellow Comet, but...\fKanbei's Imperial Forces spotted us\rbefore we even crossed the border.\f
cz: Ale ne... Chteli jsme jen projit\rpres Yellow Comet, jenze...\fKanbeiho cisarske sily nas objevily\rdriv, nez jsme presli hranici.\f

en: Kanbei's Imperial Forces?\f
Uh-huh. They're supposed to be\rthe best-trained troops around.\fThe high equipment costs and salaries\rmust make them hard to maintain.\f
cz: Presne. Pry jsou to nejlip\rvycvicena vojska siroko daleko.\fDrahe vybaveni a vysoke zoldy\rje musi stat hotovy majlant.\f

en: The best trained, huh?\rThis should be fun!\f
I don't think you'll have any\renergy left over for fun, Andy.\fC'mon, show me what you can do!\f
cz: Nemyslim, ze ti na zabavu\rzbydou sily, Andy.\fNo tak, ukaz, co umis!\f

en: Oh, no... I was just planning on\rpassing through Yellow Comet, but...\fKanbei's Imperial Forces spotted us\rbefore we even crossed the border.\f
cz: Ale ne... Chteli jsme jen projit\rpres Yellow Comet, jenze...\fKanbeiho cisarske sily nas objevily\rdriv, nez jsme presli hranici.\f

en: Kanbei's Imperial Forces?\f
Uh-huh. They're supposed to be\rthe best-trained troops around.\fThe high equipment costs and salaries\rmust make them hard to maintain.\f
cz: Presne. Pry jsou to nejlip\rvycvicena vojska siroko daleko.\fDrahe vybaveni a vysoke zoldy\rje musi stat hotovy majlant.\f

en: Oh, no... I was just planning on\rpassing through Yellow Comet, but...\fKanbei's Imperial Forces spotted us\rbefore we even crossed the border.\f
cz: Ale ne... Chteli jsme jen projit\rpres Yellow Comet, jenze...\fKanbeiho cisarske sily nas objevily\rdriv, nez jsme presli hranici.\f

en: Kanbei's Imperial Forces?\f
Uh-huh. They're supposed to be\rthe best-trained troops around.\fThe high equipment costs and salaries\rmust make them hard to maintain.\f
cz: Presne. Pry jsou to nejlip\rvycvicena vojska siroko daleko.\fDrahe vybaveni a vysoke zoldy\rje musi stat hotovy majlant.\f

en: The best trained, huh?\fBoy, Sami, you have all the fun!\rI wish I was going instead of you.\f
cz: Nejlip vycviceni, jo?\fSami, ty si uzijes vsechnu zabavu!\rKez bych tam sel misto tebe.\f

en: Preposterous!\fKanbei's forces...defeated?\fWithdraw!\f
Preposterous!\fSo many of Kanbei's forces defeated\rin such a short time?\fWithdraw!\f
cz: Nehoraznost!\fTolik Kanbeiho sil porazeno\rza tak kratky cas?\fUstup!\f

en: You'll have to take damage in order\rto take out the indirect combat units.\fAfter that, just stay within the\rmountains and protect your position.\fThe enemy will keep coming at you,\rbut you just have to hold on.\fDon't give up!\rGood luck!\f
cz: Bez zraneni jednotky neprime\rstrelby nezlikvidujes.\fPotom uz jen zustan v horach\ra chran svou pozici.\fNepritel bude utocit dal,\rale ty musis vydrzet.\fNevzdavej to!\rHodne stesti!\f

en: Hey!\fWhere's the rest of the army?\f
I'm sorry, Andy.\fThere was an error, and\rpreparations weren't completed.\f
cz: Omlouvam se, Andy.\fDoslo k chybe a pripravy\rnebyly dokonceny.\f

en: But there are bases for deployment.\fYou know how to use them, right?\f
cz: Ale jsou tu zakladny pro nasazeni.\fVite, jak je pouzit, ze?\f

en: Sure, I'm OK!\f
Hey, Nell!\fWhat's with this small battalion?\fIt's like you're asking me to lose!\f
cz: Hej, Nell!\fCo je tohle za maly prapor?\fTo si primo rikas o prohru!\f

en: I'm sorry, Max.\fThere was an error, and\rpreparations weren't completed.\f
cz: Omlouvam se, Max.\fDoslo k chybe a pripravy\rnebyly dokonceny.\f

en: But there are bases for\rdeployment, right there.\f
cz: Ale rovnou tamhle jsou\rzakladny pro nasazeni.\f

en: All right!\fI've got permission to request\rmy own units, right?\f
cz: Tak jo!\fMuzu si vyzadat vlastni\rjednotky, ze jo?\f

en: That's right.\fYou can deploy any unit\rthat you deem necessary.\fDo you remember the procedure?\f
cz: Presne tak.\fMuzete nasadit jakoukoli\rjednotku, kterou uznate za nutnou.\fPamatujete si postup?\f

en: Hey! Don't treat me like a fool!\fOf course I remember!\f
cz: Hej! Nedelej ze me hlupaka!\fJasne, ze si pamatuju!\f

en: There aren't many units here.\f
But then, there must be some\rbases around here. Right, Nell?\f
cz: Ale to tu nekde musi byt\rzakladny. Vid, Nell?\f

en: Right as always, Sami!\rNothing gets by you.\fI'm sure I don't have to tell\ryou what to do, right?\f
cz: Jako vzdy spravne, Sami!\rNic ti neunikne.\fUrcite ti nemusim rikat,\rco delat, ze?\f

en: No, I don't have any questions.\f
Where are all these enemy\runits coming from?\fWithdraw!\f
cz: Odkud se berou vsechny ty\rnepratelske jednotky?\fUstup!\f

en: This is beyond comprehension!\fRegardless of the odds, Kanbei\rshould never lose this many units!\fWithdraw!\f
cz: To je nad moje chapani!\fAt je presila jakakoli, Kanbei\rnesmi ztratit tolik jednotek!\fUstup!\f

en: Kanbei's got us surrounded!\f
On top of that, we have to\rseize properties to win.\fLooks like things are\rgonna get rough.\f
cz: A k tomu musime pro vitezstvi\robsadit budovy.\fVypada to, ze bude\rperne.\f

en: But look! This time we have\ran airport!\f
What's an airport, again?\f
cz: A co ze to letiste dela?\f

en: Airports let us deploy air units!\fPlus, damaged planes and copters\rcan go there to recover HP.\f
cz: Na letisti nasazujeme letadla!\fA poskozene stroje a vrtulniky\rsi tam doplni HP.\f

en: Oh, OK. Got it!\f
That's cool, but isn't that Kanbei's\rbase right there?\f
Oh, ho ho ho!\fLook what I have found!\rA base for Kanbei's troops!\fI shall deploy a mountain\rof troops!\f
cz: Ho ho ho!\fPodivejme, co jsem nasel!\rZakladna pro Kanbeiho vojska!\fNasadim celou horu\rvojaku!\f

en: By my sword!\fWhat a horribly useless\rbase that was!\f
cz: Pri mem meci!\fJak strasne k nicemu\rta zakladna byla!\f

en: Oh, Father!\fYou know this is because you never\rlet me finish what I'm trying to tell you!\f
cz: Ach, otce!\fTo mas z toho, ze me nikdy\rnenechas domluvit!\f

en: But... But... Sonja, I...\f
And one more thing.\fOrange Star's objective is not\rto conquer Yellow Comet.\f
cz: A jeste jedna vec.\fCilem Orange Star neni\rdobyt Yellow Comet.\f

en: Are you mad, daughter?\fThey were...\f
Father! Shooting first and asking\rquestions later is not a good strategy.\fIf you were suddenly attacked,\ryou'd return fire, too!\f
cz: Otce! Nejdriv strilet a pak se\rptat neni dobra strategie.\fKdyby nekdo napadl tebe,\rtaky bys opetoval palbu!\f

en: Well, I...\f
If you leave them be, I'm sure\rthey'll depart without any trouble.\fNo more attacking, Father!\rUnderstood?\f
cz: Kdyz je nechas byt, urcite\rodejdou bez problemu.\fZadne dalsi utoky, otce!\rRozumis?\f

en: Um...\f
Hmm... The Orange Star Army...\fThey're not all that I imagined\rthey would be.\fAs that's the case...\fit's up to me to act.\f
cz: Hmm... Armada Orange Star...\fNejsou uplne takovi, jak\rjsem si predstavovala.\fKdyz je to tak...\fmusim zasahnout sama.\f

en: By my sword!\fWhat a horribly useless\rbase that was!\fAnd I was defeated in such\ra short time!\fWas that base in a poor location?\f
cz: Pri mem meci!\fJak strasne k nicemu\rta zakladna byla!\fA porazili me za tak\rkratky cas!\fStala ta zakladna spatne?\f

en: You let fifteen properties get\rcaptured, didn't you?\f
Sami's comments were dead-on.\fYou should've ignored that one base\rand focused on capturing others.\fIf you stay cool and calm,\ryou'll be fine.\fGood luck!\f
cz: Sami to rekla presne.\fMel jsi tu jednu zakladnu nechat\rbyt a obsazovat ostatni.\fKdyz zustanes v klidu,\rzvladnes to.\fHodne stesti!\f

en: Max, you have underdeveloped\rindirect-combat skills.\fYou compensate for this weakness\rwith a predilection for direct combat.\fIn areas where you can attack\rwith multiple units, you're a titan.\f
cz: Max, v neprime strelbe mas\rznacne mezery.\fTu slabinu si vynahrazujes\rzalibou v primem boji.\fTam, kde muzes utocit vice\rjednotkami, jsi obr.\f

en: Wha...?\f
Who... Who are you?\f
It's a pleasure to meet you.\rMy name is Sonja.\fI'm a Yellow Comet CO.\fI've taken the liberty of separating\ryou from your companions.\fSo, now...\f
cz: Tesi me, ze te poznavam.\rJmenuji se Sonja.\fJsem velitelka Yellow Comet.\fDovolila jsem si te oddelit\rod tvych druhu.\fA ted...\f

en: Sweet dreams, Max.\f

Sonja's quite clever.\fShe hid her units in some\rvery strategic locations.\fSo, emulate her tactics and use the\rwoods for cover when moving.\fYou should be able to avoid a lot\rof damage that way.\fBetter luck next time!\f
cz: Sonja je pekne chytra.\fSchovala jednotky na velmi\rstrategickych mistech.\fNapodobte jeji taktiku a pri pohybu\rvyuzivejte lesy jako kryt.\fTak se vyhnete velke casti\rposkozeni.\fPriste to vyjde!\f

en: What? Really?\f
You seem to\rbe in good spirits, though.\fWell, whatever.\f
cz: Vypadas ale, ze\rmas dobrou naladu.\fNo, nevadi.\f

en: Oh, good. That's a relief.\fWe'd be lost if you got\rknocked out, too.\f
cz: To je dobre. To se mi ulevilo.\fByli bychom v koncich, kdyby\rvyradili i tebe.\f

en: Oh, great. Fog of War...\fThis is Sonja's forte.\fWell, we have to cross the water\rhere, so we must protect our landers.\fWe'll have no chance of victory if\rwe can't transport our troops.\fLet's try and use the reefs for\rcover as we go.\fI think Sonja's forgotten that I'm an\rinfantry troop specialist, though.\fIf we need to capture properties to\rwin this, then it's as good as done!\fGet ready, Sonja!\rWe're comin' for you!\f
cz: No skvele. Mlha valky...\fTo je Sonjina specialita.\fMusime se tu dostat pres vodu,\rtakze musime chranit vysadkove lodi.\fBez prepravy vojaku nemame\rsanci na vitezstvi.\fZkusme cestou vyuzivat utesy\rjako kryt.\fSonja ale asi zapomnela, ze jsem\rspecialistka na pechotu.\fJestli se tu vitezi obsazovanim\rbudov, tak je to jasna vec!\fPriprav se, Sonjo!\rJdeme si pro tebe!\f

en: Nice to see you again, Sonja.\f
Grit!\fDid you discover anything?\f
Nope. Not a darn thing.\fI was able to follow\rHis Beardedness, but...\fI think Olaf himself has been\rtossed by the wayside.\f
cz: Ne. Ani zbla.\fSel jsem tomu vousacovi\rv patach, ale...\fMyslim, ze Olafa samotnyho\rodstavili na vedlejsi kolej.\f

en: Oh...\f

Maybe Olaf'll realize that he's\rbeen used. That'd be nice.\fHe ain't such a bad guy, you know?\fLet's move on to somethin' else\rnow, Sonja.\fDon't you think you're taking\rthings a tad bit too far?\fThere's a whole mess of folks after\ryou, darlin'. Like all of Orange Star.\f
cz: Treba Olafovi dojde, ze ho\rjen vyuzili. To by bylo fajn.\fNeni to zas takovej spatnej chlap.\fAle ted k necemu jinymu,\rSonjo.\fNezda se ti, ze to trochu\rprehanis?\fJde po tobe pekna kupa lidi,\rzlaticko. Treba cely Orange Star.\f

en: Really?\fActually, I don't think I've\rdone enough.\fThis is invaluable intel that I'm\rgathering. I must continue!\f
cz: Opravdu?\fJa si naopak myslim, ze jsem\rudelala malo.\fSbiram nedocenitelne informace.\rMusim pokracovat!\f

en: Well, if you're that determined,\rI guess I ain't got nothin' else to say.\fI'll go see what else I can find out.\f
cz: No, kdyz jsi tak rozhodnuta,\rtak uz nemam co dodat.\fPujdu zjistit, co jeste vyslidim.\f

en: OK. Thanks, Grit!\f
My, oh, my!\fYou're much stronger than\ryou used to be, aren't you?\f
cz: Ale, ale!\fJsi o dost silnejsi,\rnez jsi byvala, ze?\f

en: Of course I am!\f

But your basic abilities haven't\rreally changed at all, have they?\fIn an area with lots of properties\rto capture, your skills are adequate.\fBut you're still poor\rat indirect combat.\fIn straight-up battle, you'd move your\rinfantry in and seize the enemy HQ.\fThat's what you're best at, isn't it?\f
cz: Ale tve zakladni schopnosti se\rvubec nezmenily, ze?\fV oblasti s mnoha budovami\rk obsazeni ti tvoje umeni staci.\fPorad jsi ale slaba\rv neprimem boji.\fV primem stretu posles pechotu\ra obsadis nepratelske HQ.\fV tom jsi nejlepsi, ze?\f

en: Ha...\fYou're as good as ever at breaking\reverything down and analyzing it.\fBut what are you doing, Sonja?\fWhy did you attack us?\f
cz: Ha...\fPorad ti to jde, rozebrat vsechno\rna kousky a zanalyzovat.\fCo ale delas, Sonjo?\fProc jsi na nas zautocila?\f

en: I can't... I can't tell you, yet.\fYou'd better look over there.\f
cz: Nemuzu... Jeste ti to nemuzu rict.\fRadsi se podivej tamhle.\f

en: Huh?\fThat's Andy!\fHow did you...?\f
I told him I had some new tools for him,\rand he followed me like a lost puppy.\f
cz: Rekla jsem mu, ze mam nove nacini,\ra sel za mnou jak ztracene stene.\f

en: (sigh)...\f
He should be waking up\ranytime now. Bye-bye.\f
cz: Kazdou chvili by se mel\rprobrat. Papa.\f

en: The enemy units captured sixteen\rproperties, didn't they?\f
I've got to battle Sonja?\fI really don't want to.\f
cz: Ja mam bojovat se Sonjou?\fVazne se mi nechce.\f

en: If you mention that she gave you new\rtools again, I'm gonna thump you!\f
cz: Jestli jeste jednou reknes, ze ti\rdala nove nacini, jednu ti vrazim!\f

en: Yikes!\f
Do you have any idea what\rI had to go through? New tools! Hah!\fOh, and don't expect any sympathy\rfrom me if you lose!\f
cz: Tusis vubec, cim jsem si\rkvuli tomu prosla? Nove nacini! Ha!\fA kdyz prohrajes, necekej ode mne\rzadny soucit!\f

en: This is the last test...\fShow me what you do, Andy!\f
cz: Tohle je posledni zkouska...\fUkaz mi, co dokazes, Andy!\f

en: Really?\fI wonder why Sami always gets so\rmad when she hears Sonja's name.\f
cz: Opravdu?\fProc se Sami vzdycky tak rozcili,\rkdyz slysi Sonjino jmeno?\f

en: Yeah, I thought so.\fIn that case, who knows what'll\rhappen if I lose.\f
cz: Jo, to jsem si myslel.\fV tom pripade kdo vi, co se stane,\rkdyz prohraju.\f

en: All right, Sonja! Now I\rwant some answers!\fWhy have you been attacking us?\f
cz: Tak dost, Sonjo! Ted chci\rodpovedi!\fProc na nas utocis?\f

en: All in due time, Sami.\rBut first, Andy.\f
