cz: Vsechno v pravy cas, Sami.\rNejdriv ale Andy.\f

en: What?\f
You don't have any weak points.\f
Well, of course not!\f
But you don't have any\rspecial strengths, either.\f
Huh?\f
Hey! Don't ignore me!\f
Sami.\f
Yeah?\f
How do you...?\f
That's not your concern.\fSee you again, Sami.\f
cz: Do toho ti nic neni.\fZase se uvidime, Sami.\f

en: Where you unload your troops is\rkey to this mission.\fWhy don't you try unloading them\rsomewhere else next time?\fThe results may be more\rto your liking.\fGood luck! Don't give up!\f
cz: Kde vylodite vojaky, to je\rklic k teto misi.\fZkuste je priste vylodit\rnekde jinde.\fVysledek se vam mozna bude\rvic zamlouvat.\fHodne stesti! Nevzdavejte to!\f

en: Is that you, Nell?\rWhat is it?\f
cz: To jste vy, Nell?\rCo se deje?\f

en: We have an emergency!\fThe Coral Fortress is being stormed\rby Drake of Green Earth!\fWe've never had trouble with him\rbefore, so we didn't see them coming!\f
cz: Mame nouzovou situaci!\fNa Coral Fortress utoci\rDrake z Green Earth!\fNikdy s nim nebyly problemy,\rtakze jsme je vubec necekali!\f

en: There are a bunch of bad guys here!\f

This point is of vital importance\rto Orange Star.\fIf the enemy seizes a lot of properties\rhere, we'll lose control of the area.\fYou have to beat them to it and\rsecure as many cities as possible.\fIncluding your bases and HQ, you\rmust secure twelve properties to win.\f
cz: Toto misto je pro Orange Star\rzivotne dulezite.\fJestli tu nepritel obsadi hodne budov,\rztratime kontrolu nad oblasti.\fMusite ho predbehnout a zajistit\rco nejvic mest.\fVcetne zakladen a HQ musite pro\rvitezstvi drzet dvanact budov.\f

en: Secure as many properties\ras possible? OK, I got it!\f
I've got it covered!\f
Um...\f
Now's the time.\fI need to know if Orange Star was\rbehind these blackhearted acts.\fAnchors, away!\f
cz: Ted je ten spravny cas.\fMusim vedet, jestli za temi\rpodlymi ciny stoji Orange Star.\fZvednout kotvy!\f

en: By the way, what kind\rof CO is Drake?\f
I've heard that he's virtually\runstoppable in naval combat.\fHis armada is supposed to be\ra real powerhouse.\f
cz: Slysela jsem, ze je v namornim\rboji temer nezastavitelny.\fJeho armada ma byt\rporadna sila.\f

en: There you go again, Sami!\rYou're a warehouse of intel.\f
cz: Zase to delas, Sami!\rJsi chodici databaze informaci.\f

en: But I could swear there was\rsomething else... Something big...\f
cz: Prisahala bych ale, ze bylo\rjeste neco... Neco velkeho...\f

en: A job well done!\fYou've beaten me.\f
So, you're Drake?\f
That'd be me.\fI wanted to find some answers here,\rbut all I've netted are more questions.\fI'll be seeing you again, lad.\f
cz: To jsem ja.\fChtel jsem tu najit odpovedi,\rale ulovil jsem jen dalsi otazky.\fJeste se uvidime, hochu.\f

en: You were so close...\f

Drake's CO Power is really\rdangerous, isn't it?\fBut don't forget Andy's CO Power.\fIf you use it after Drake uses his,\ryou'll be fine!\fAndy's Power restores HP!\fGood luck! Keep your spirits up!\f
cz: Drakeova CO sila je fakt\rnebezpecna, ze?\fNezapomente ale na Andyho CO silu.\fKdyz ji pouzijete po Drakeovi,\rbudete v pohode!\fAndyho sila obnovuje HP!\fHodne stesti! Hlavu vzhuru!\f

en: What's wrong?\f

CO Drake has hit us again!\fWe need you to come in and\rprotect this missile unit.\fIt's vital to Orange Star's\rstrategic success.\fWatch out for the enemy battleship to\rthe south; it's moving in to attack.\f
cz: Velitel Drake nas zase napadl!\fPotrebujeme, abyste prisel\ra ochranil tyhle rakety.\fJsou zivotne dulezite pro\rstrategii Orange Star.\fPozor na nepratelskou bitevni lod\rna jihu; miri k utoku.\f

en: I understand!\fI just have to protect this\rmissile unit, right?\f
Nell!\rBoy, am I glad to see you!\f
cz: Nell!\rTo jsem rad, ze vas vidim!\f

en: You really stuck it out, didn't you!\f
CO Drake! If you want to continue\rthis, you'll have to face me!\f
cz: Veliteli Drakeu! Jestli chcete\rpokracovat, budete celit mne!\f

en: Well, I'll be keelhauled! Nell and her\rtroops have surfaced!\fWe're outnumbered, we are!\fTime to pull anchor!\f
cz: At me hodi zralokum! Nell a jeji\rjednotky se vynorily!\fMaji prevahu, to teda jo!\fCas zvednout kotvy!\f

en: The area around the\rHQ is dangerous.\fSo, you have to get that missile\runit out of there!\fI would suggest using the landers to\rmove the unit to the north.\fTry using the reefs to hide in\rwhile you're on the move.\fThe enemy will have a hard time\rfinding you there.\fUse your recon and sub units to\rhelp find safe passage as well.\fAbove all, use caution.\rGood luck!\f
cz: Okoli HQ je\rnebezpecne.\fMusite odtamtud tu raketovou\rjednotku dostat pryc!\fDoporucuji pouzit vysadkove lodi\ra presunout ji na sever.\fBehem presunu se zkuste\rschovavat v utesech.\fNepritel vas tam bude\rhledat jen tezko.\fBezpecnou cestu vam pomuzou najit\rpruzkumnici a ponorky.\fPredevsim opatrne.\rHodne stesti!\f

en: This'll be the third time\rI've faced Eagle.\fIt's about time to wrap\rhim up for good.\f
cz: To uz bude potreti,\rco stojim proti Eaglovi.\fJe na case ho vyridit\rjednou provzdy.\f

en: I'm gonna get him and make him tell me\rwhy he's been chasing me!\f
cz: Doberu se ho a donutim ho rict,\rproc me porad pronasleduje!\f

en: I must be dreaming!\fAndy! Are you getting serious on us?\f
cz: To se mi snad zda!\fAndy! Ty to myslis vazne?\f

en: Are you feeling OK, pal?\fYou comin' down with something?\f
cz: Je ti dobre, kamarade?\fNeleze na tebe neco?\f

en: Gimme a break, guys! I don't think you\runderstand what it means to be me.\f
cz: Dejte mi pokoj! Asi vazne nechapete,\rjake to je byt mnou.\f

en: Despite Drake's conviction, I\rfind it hard to credit his hypothesis.\fAndy! I'm coming for you!\f
cz: Prestoze je Drake presvedcen,\rjeho domnenku prijmout nedokazu.\fAndy! Jdu si pro tebe!\f

en: C'mon, tell me! Why have\ryou been chasing me?\f
cz: No tak, rekni mi to! Proc\rme pronasledujes?\f

en: Don't play the fool with me, whelp!\fDo you expect me to forget what\ryou did to Green Earth?\f
cz: Nehraj si na hlupaka, klacku!\fMyslis, ze zapomenu, co jsi\rprovedl Green Earth?\f

en: Huh?\f
The look on your face during the\rassault... I'll never forget! Never!\f
cz: Ten tvuj vyraz behem toho\rutoku... Nikdy nezapomenu! Nikdy!\f

en: No! You're wrong!\rIt wasn't me!\f
What do you take me for, boy?\fI saw your face!\f
cz: Za koho me mas, chlapce?\fVidel jsem tvou tvar!\f

en: I'm telling you, it wasn't me!\fWhy would I be out attacking\rother countries? Why?\f
cz: Rikam ti, ze jsem to nebyl!\fProc bych napadal jine\rzeme? Proc?\f

en: Hmm...\fVery well. I'll take you at your\rword...for the moment.\fThere are Drake's thoughts to\rconsider, as well.\fBut don't believe for a moment\rthat I trust you.\fIf I find out you're lying to me,\ryou'll curse the day you were born!\f
cz: Hmm...\fDobra. Verim ti na slovo...\rprozatim.\fJe tu i Drakeuv nazor,\rktery musim zvazit.\fAni na chvili si ale nemysli,\rze ti duveruji.\fAz zjistim, ze mi lzes,\rproklejes den, kdy ses narodil!\f

en: What is it this time, Nell?\f
We've been able to outsmart\rCO Drake!\fOne of his landers is carrying vital\rcargo, and it's hiding in this area.\fIt's up to you to flush it out\rand destroy it!\f
cz: Podarilo se nam prechytracit\rvelitele Drakea!\fJedna z jeho vysadkovych lodi veze\rdulezity naklad a skryva se tady.\fJe na vas, abyste ji vypatrali\ra znicili!\f

en: Got it!\fI just need to find the lander\rand sink it, right?\f
cz: Jasne!\fStaci najit tu vysadkovou lod\ra potopit ji, ze?\f

en: That's it!\fI think it's safe to assume that\rDrake's hiding in the reefs somewhere.\fGo find him!\f
cz: Presne tak!\fDa se predpokladat, ze se Drake\rskryva nekde v utesech.\fNajdete ho!\f

en: Barnacles!\fI was so worried about Eagle that\rI got trapped...\fAhh, I'll think of something.\f
cz: Hrome!\fTak jsem se bal o Eagla,\rze jsem se nechal chytit...\fAch, neco vymyslim.\f

en: Arrgh, you got me!\fI didn't think you'd find me here,\rand I let my guard down.\f
cz: Arr, dostali jste me!\fNecekal jsem, ze me tu najdete,\ra polevil jsem v ostrazitosti.\f

en: Commander Drake, would you please\rtell us why you've been attacking us?\f
cz: Veliteli Drakeu, reknete nam\rprosim, proc na nas utocite?\f

en: Haven't you sensed him?\fThe person behind all of\rthis fighting?\fSonja and Grit have been trying\rto lure him out of hiding.\f
cz: Nevytusili jste ho?\fToho, kdo za vsemi temi\rboji stoji?\fSonja a Grit se ho snazi\rvylakat z ukrytu.\f

en: The person behind all this?\f

We've been trying to keep Sonja's\rmovements a secret.\fSo, we staged these battles to\rdraw his attention away from her.\fBut I think we're finished now.\fIt seems Sonja's found something.\fI'll be joining her as\rsoon as I'm able, but...\fI've got things to take care\rof in Green Earth.\fThis is a difficult thing for me\rto ask...\f
cz: Snazili jsme se udrzet Sonjiny\rpohyby v tajnosti.\fProto jsme sehrali tyhle bitvy,\rabychom od ni odvedli pozornost.\fMyslim, ze ted uz je konec.\fZda se, ze Sonja neco nasla.\fPripojim se k ni, jakmile\rto bude mozne, ale...\fMam jeste veci na praci\rv Green Earth.\fTezko se mi o neco takoveho\rzada...\f

en: You don't have to!\fWe'll help in any way we can!\f
cz: Nemusite nic rikat!\fPomuzeme, jak jen budeme moct!\f

en: Blast!\fRight after Yellow Comet, it's on\rto Green Earth!\fWe're just trying to pass by. Why\rdoes everyone keep attacking us?\fI'd never heard there was any\rbad blood between our countries.\f
cz: Zatracene!\fHned po Yellow Comet je tu\rGreen Earth!\fJen tudy chceme projit. Proc na nas\rporad vsichni utoci?\fNikdy jsem neslysel, ze by mezi\rnasimi zememi byla zla krev.\f

en: I'm as puzzled as you are.\fRegardless, we're facing CO Drake...\rThis is going to be rough.\f
cz: Jsem z toho stejne zmatena jako ty.\fAt tak ci tak, stoji proti nam\rvelitel Drake... Bude to drsne.\f

en: What do you know about him?\f
I've heard that he's virtually\runstoppable in naval combat.\fHis armada is supposed to be\ra real powerhouse.\f
cz: Slysela jsem, ze je v namornim\rboji temer nezastavitelny.\fJeho armada ma byt\rporadna sila.\f

en: Oh, man! Why does Max get all\rthe fun combat?\f
cz: Ale no tak! Proc ma Max vzdycky\rty zabavne bitvy?\f

en: Now's the time.\fI need to know if Orange Star was\rbehind that blackhearted act.\fAnchors, away!\f
cz: Ted je ten spravny cas.\fMusim vedet, jestli za tim\rpodlym cinem stoji Orange Star.\fZvednout kotvy!\f

en: A job well done!\fYou've beaten me.\f
You're a Green Earth CO?\f
That I am.\fI wanted to find some answers here,\rbut all I've netted are more questions.\fI'll be seeing you again, lad.\f
cz: To jsem.\fChtel jsem tu najit odpovedi,\rale ulovil jsem jen dalsi otazky.\fJeste se uvidime, hochu.\f

en: You were so close...\f

Drake's CO Power is really\rdangerous, isn't it?\fYou really should take out Drake's\rmain units before he uses his Power.\fDo you think you should give\rAndy a shot next time?\fGood luck! Keep your spirits up!\f
cz: Drakeova CO sila je fakt\rnebezpecna, ze?\fMeli byste znicit Drakeovy hlavni\rjednotky drive, nez ji pouzije.\fCo takhle priste zkusit\rnasadit Andyho?\fHodne stesti! Hlavu vzhuru!\f

en: A mission for me? You must\rneed some serious smashin' done.\fWell, if that's the case, you\rknow I'm ready to go!\f
cz: Mise pro me? To bude potreba\rneco poradne rozmlatit.\fKdyz je to tak, vis, ze jsem\rpripraveny!\f

en: It's not that simple, Max.\rThere's a catch.\fThe main body of the Green Earth\rArmy is closing in on this position.\f
cz: Neni to tak jednoduche, Maxi.\rJe tu hacek.\fHlavni sily armady Green Earth\rse blizi k teto pozici.\f

en: What? The entire army...?\f
That's right! So, we need to eliminate\rthe troops here ASAP, or else!\fLet's see... How much time...?\rFifteen days! That's all you've got.\f
cz: Presne tak! Musime tu vojaky\rzlikvidovat co nejdriv!\fTakze... Kolik casu...?\rPatnact dni! Vic nemate.\f

en: Fifteen? That's a tall order.\rMan, I hate time limits!\f
cz: Patnact? To je pekny orisek.\rNesnasim casove limity!\f

en: Aarrgh! They're here already.\fA bit later and I could've greeted 'em\rwith the whole Green Earth Army.\fBut if I can keep 'em swimmin' in\rcircles for a while, I'll still win.\fPrepare to be boarded, ye\rscurvy dogs!\f
cz: Arr! Uz jsou tady.\fChvilku pozdeji a privital bych je\rs celou armadou Green Earth.\fKdyz je ale chvili necham plavat\rv kruzich, stejne vyhraju.\fPripravte se na abordaz, vy\rprasive krysy!\f

en: Curses! I've been defeated.\fTime to hoist sail and flee!\f
cz: Hrom do toho! Jsem porazen.\fCas napnout plachty a prchat!\f

en: Time limit or no, rushing about\rwilly-nilly is not going to defeat Drake.\fUse units with large vision ranges to\rgather intel and scout out your path.\fTry the same techniques you used in\rother areas that had Fog of War.\fKeep fighting! Good luck!\f
cz: Limit nelimit, bezhlavym\rpobihanim Drakea neporazite.\fPouzijte jednotky s velkym dohledem,\rat ziskate info a najdete cestu.\fZkuste stejne postupy jako\rv jinych oblastech s Mlhou valky.\fBojujte dal! Hodne stesti!\f

en: Despite Drake's conviction, I\rfind it hard to credit his hypothesis.\fAndy! I'm coming for you!\f
cz: Prestoze je Drake presvedcen,\rjeho domnenku prijmout nedokazu.\fAndy! Jdu si pro tebe!\f

en: Now, I want some answers!\rWhy're you hounding Andy?\f
You demand an answer? Very well.\rHere's your answer, Max.\fYour compatriot, Andy, viciously\rattacked my homeland.\f
cz: Zadas odpoved? Dobra tedy.\rTady ji mas, Maxi.\fTvuj druh Andy brutalne\rnapadl mou vlast.\f

en: Huh?\f
The look on his face during the\rassault... I'll never forget! Never!\f
cz: Ten jeho vyraz behem toho\rutoku... Nikdy nezapomenu! Nikdy!\f

en: Hey! Hold up a minute, Eagle.\fThere's no way Andy would do\rsomething like that.\fC'mon! He couldn't have planned all\rthat out. He's just a kid!\f
cz: Hej! Pockej chvili, Eagle.\fAndy by nikdy nic takoveho\rneudelal.\fNo tak! Tohle by nedokazal\rnaplanovat. Je to jen kluk!\f

en: Um... Excuse me?\f
What I mean is, he does things\rfor a reason.\fAnd there's no reason for him to\rattack Green Earth. He didn't do it!\f
cz: Chci rict, ze vsechno dela\rz nejakeho duvodu.\fA nema duvod utocit na\rGreen Earth. Neudelal to!\f

en: Hmm...\fVery well. I'll take you at your\rword...for the moment.\fBut don't believe for a moment\rthat I trust any of you.\fAndy, if I find that you're lying to me,\ryou'll curse the day you were born!\f
cz: Hmm...\fDobra. Verim ti na slovo...\rprozatim.\fAni na chvili si ale nemyslete,\rze nekomu z vas duveruji.\fAndy, az zjistim, ze mi lzes,\rproklejes den, kdy ses narodil!\f

en: Drake means boats!\fJust watching is fun!\f
cz: Drake znamena lode!\fUz jen divat se je zabava!\f

en: I bet Drake has some reason for\rchallenging us, just like Eagle.\f
cz: Vsadim se, ze Drake ma duvod,\rproc nas vyzval, stejne jako Eagle.\f

en: If he's trying to find something out,\rI wish he'd just ask.\fBut it's never that easy, is it?\f
cz: Kdyz chce neco zjistit,\rmohl by se proste zeptat.\fNikdy to ale neni tak snadne, ze?\f

en: Another mission that revolves around\rlanders. Drake and his darn boats!\fIt's safe to say that he's not going to\rgo out of his way to make this easy.\fBut again, I think he has his reasons.\f
cz: Dalsi mise kolem vysadkovych lodi.\rDrake a ty jeho zatracene lode!\fUrcite se nebude nijak snazit,\raby nam to usnadnil.\fAle zase, myslim, ze ma sve duvody.\f

en: Yeah, you're probably right.\fWell, here I go!\f
cz: Jo, asi mas pravdu.\fTak jdeme na to!\f

en: I think they're ignoring me...\f
Time to make a big splash and\rgive Eagle some cover.\f
cz: Cas nadelat poradne vlny\ra kryt Eagla.\f

en: Same old shanty!\fI just can't beat you guys.\f
cz: Porad ta sama pisnicka!\fProste vas nedokazu porazit.\f

en: Commander Drake, would you please\rtell us why you've been attacking us?\f
cz: Veliteli Drakeu, reknete nam\rprosim, proc na nas utocite?\f

en: Haven't you sensed him?\fThe person behind all of\rthis fighting?\fSonja and Grit have been trying\rto lure him out of hiding.\f
cz: Nevytusili jste ho?\fToho, kdo za vsemi temi\rboji stoji?\fSonja a Grit se ho snazi\rvylakat z ukrytu.\f

en: The person behind all this?\f

We've been trying to keep Sonja's\rmovements a secret.\fSo, we staged these battles to\rdraw his attention away from her.\fBut I think we're finished now.\fIt seems Sonja's found something.\fNow, this is a difficult thing for me\rto ask, but...\f
cz: Snazili jsme se utajit\rSonjiny pohyby.\fTyhle bitvy jsme sehrali, abychom\rod ni odvedli jeho pozornost.\fAle ted uz je to nejspis u konce.\fZda se, ze Sonja neco nasla.\fTohle se mi zada tezko,\rale musim se zeptat...\f

en: What is it?\f
I can't leave\rGreen Earth unprotected.\fI promised Eagle. You understand?\fSo... Would you go in my stead?\rThey need your help.\f
cz: Nemuzu nechat\rGreen Earth bez ochrany.\fSlibil jsem to Eaglovi. Chapete?\fTakze... Sel byste misto me?\rPotrebuji vasi pomoc.\f

en: Of course!\fWe'll do all we can!\f
cz: Samozrejme!\fUdelame, co bude v nasich silach!\f

en: Blast!\fRight after Yellow Comet, it's on\rto Green Earth.\fWe're just trying to pass by. Why\rdoes everyone keep attacking us?\fI've never heard of any\rbad blood between our countries.\f
cz: Sakra!\fHned po Yellow Comet je na rade\rGreen Earth.\fChceme jen projit. Proc na nas\rporad vsichni utoci?\fNikdy jsem neslysel o zadne\rzasti mezi nasimi zememi.\f

en: I'm as puzzled as you are.\fRegardless, we're facing CO Drake...\rThis is going to be rough.\f
cz: Jsem stejne zmateny jako ty.\fTak ci tak, proti nam stoji Drake...\rBude to tvrde.\f

en: What do you know about him?\f
I've heard that he's virtually\runstoppable in naval combat.\fHis armada is supposed to be\ra real powerhouse.\f
cz: Slysel jsem, ze v namorni bitve\rje temer nezastavitelny.\fJeho flotila ma byt\rprava valecna masina.\f

en: If he's that good, I want\rto challenge him!\f
cz: Kdyz je tak dobry, chci si to\rs nim rozdat!\f

en: That's Andy for you,\rMr. Happy-go-lucky.\fAnyway, I think we need to secure\rbases as we move through this area.\fI won't feel safe unless we're\rable to do that.\fYes, I think fifteen properties should\rbe enough to secure our victory.\fLet's get movin'.\f
cz: To je cely Andy,\rvecny optimista.\fKazdopadne musime cestou touhle\roblasti obsadit zakladny.\fJinak se nebudu citit\rv bezpeci.\fAno, patnact budov by melo\rstacit k zajisteni vitezstvi.\fJdeme na to.\f

en: Now's the time.\fI need to know if Orange Star was\rbehind that blackhearted act.\fAnchors, away!\f
cz: Je cas.\fMusim vedet, jestli za tim cinem\rstal Orange Star.\fKotvy nahoru!\f

en: Great!\fYou're in command!\f
A job well done!\fYou've beaten me.\f
You're a Green Earth CO?\f
That I am.\fI wanted to find some answers here,\rbut all I've netted are more questions.\fI'll be seeing you again, lad.\f
cz: To jsem.\fDoufal jsem, ze tu najdu odpovedi,\rale ulovil jsem jen dalsi otazky.\fJeste se uvidime, chlapce.\f

en: You were so close...\f
Drake's CO Power is really\rdangerous, isn't it.\fDo you think you should give\rAndy a shot next time?\fGood luck! Keep your spirits up!\f
cz: Drakova CO sila je vazne\rnebezpecna, ze?\fCo takhle to priste zkusit\rs Andym?\fHodne stesti! Hlavu vzhuru!\f

en: Yes, Nell. What is it?\f
It's about some units you're using.\fWe need you to protect your landers!\fOrange Star is experiencing a\rshortage of them!\fIf you lose those units, you'll\rlose this battle.\f
cz: Jde o nektere z vasich jednotek.\fMusite ochranit sve vysadkove lode!\fOrange Star jich ma\rvazny nedostatek!\fKdyz o ne prijdete,\rprohrajete tuhle bitvu.\f

en: Landers? We have two of them.\rDo you mean protect both of them?\f
cz: Vysadkove lode? Mame dve.\rMame chranit obe?\f

en: Yes, both of them!\f
Understood. We'll do our part.\fYou can count on us!\f
cz: Rozumim. Splnime svuj ukol.\fMuzete se na nas spolehnout!\f

en: You think she's looking for\ra promotion?\f
Hey, you!\rYou're playing with fire, Andy!\f
cz: Hej, ty tam!\rZahravas si s ohnem, Andy!\f

en: Oh, OK. I guess it's just me.\f
cz: Aha, dobre. Asi se mi to jen zda.\f

en: Yo, Andy!\rSami's givin' you the evil eye!\f
I've gotta stop thinking.\rIt just gets me in trouble.\f
cz: Musim prestat premyslet.\rVzdycky me to dostane do prusvihu.\f

en: Let's see.\fAll I've got to do to win is send those\rlanders to the bottom of the sea.\fThat'll keep 'em from comin' ashore!\fUp and at 'em, mateys!\f
cz: Podivejme.\fK vitezstvi mi staci poslat ty\rvysadkove lode ke dnu.\fPak se na breh nedostanou!\fDo toho, namornici!\f

en: Curses! I've been defeated.\fTime to hoist sail and flee!\f
cz: Zatraceni! Jsem porazen.\fCas napnout plachty a zmizet!\f

en: About Drake's CO Power...\fDid you notice that units on landers\ravoided taking any damage?\fUse landers well, and you can unload\rfresh troops on the enemy's doorstep.\fBetter luck next time!\f
cz: K Drakove CO sile...\fVsimli jste si, ze jednotky na lodich\rneutrpely zadne poskozeni?\fS dobre vedenou lodi vylodite\rcerstve vojaky primo u nepritele.\fPriste vice stesti!\f

en: Eagle!\fWhy do you keep harrying us?\f
It's you again...Sami.\f
Well, excuse me for\rgetting in your way!\fListen, will you just explain to me why\ryou won't leave us be?\f
cz: Tak promin, ze ti\rstojim v ceste!\fPoslouchej, vysvetlis mi konecne,\rproc nas nenechas byt?\f

en: It... It has nothing to do with you.\f
cz: S... S tebou to nema nic spolecneho.\f

en: Bring out Andy!\fI want to settle this now!\f
No! Absolutely not!\fI'm in command now.\fYou can't ask for Andy unless\ryou get by me first!\f
cz: Ne! V zadnem pripade!\fTed velim ja.\fAndyho dostanes, az projdes\rpres me!\f

en: Don't do this, Sami...\rI won't hold anything back.\f
cz: Nedelej to, Sami...\rNebudu se drzet zpatky.\f

en: I don't want to fight Sami, but...\rit looks like I've got no choice.\fTo the skies!\f
cz: Nechci se Sami bit, ale...\rzda se, ze nemam na vyber.\fVzhuru do nebes!\f

en: Start talking, Eagle.\rI'm listening.\f
Very well... I'll tell you everything.\fI'll tell you all about it.\fAll about how Andy attacked\rmy homeland, Green Earth!\f
cz: Dobra... Reknu vam vsechno.\fReknu vam, jak to bylo.\fJak Andy napadl mou vlast,\rGreen Earth!\f

en: Huh?\f
The look on his face during the\rassault... I'll never forget! Never!\f
cz: Ten vyraz v jeho tvari pri\rutoku... Nikdy nezapomenu! Nikdy!\f

en: Eagle! Stop it!\f
Stop what, Sami?\f
Look who you're accusing!\fAndy couldn't pull off\ranything that complicated.\fYou suspect this kid who has\rhis hands full just getting dressed?\f
cz: Podivej se, koho obvinujes!\fAndy by nic tak slozitneho\rnedokazal vymyslet.\fPodezrivas kluka, co ma praci\ruz s tim, aby se oblekl?\f

en: Um... Excuse me?\f
Well, it's not really a face\rthat shines with intelligence.\f
cz: No, zrovna inteligenci\rz te tvare nevyzaruje.\f

en: Hold on a...\f
Exactly!\fAndy spends the entire day not\rthinking of things!\f
cz: Presne tak!\fAndy stravi cely den tim,\rze na nic nemysli!\f

en: All right, that's...\f
If you put it that way, it's hard\rto imagine Andy pulling it off.\f
cz: Kdyz to rikate takhle, tezko si\rAndyho v tom predstavit.\f

en: You guys are mean!\f
But I'm not completely convinced.\rI still suspect you of something!\fIf I find that you're lying to me, Andy,\ryou'll curse the day you were born!\f
cz: Ale uplne presvedceny nejsem.\rPorad te z neceho podezrivam!\fJestli zjistim, ze lzes, Andy,\rproklines den, kdy ses narodil!\f

en: What is it, Nell?\f
We have a problem.\fA recon force we sent into Green\rEarth has been ambushed!\f
cz: Mame problem.\fPruzkumny oddil vyslany\rdo Green Earth padl do lecky!\f

en: So, we need to perform a\rrescue mission, correct?\fUnderstood.\f
My attitude towards Nell?\fWhat do you mean? It's not like I'm\rsucking up or anything.\fI'm just polite because she was\rahead of me in school. That's all!\fLet's get back to the task at hand!\f
cz: Muj pristup k Nell?\fJak to myslis? Nijak se ji\rnepodlizam.\fJsem jen zdvorily, protoze byla\rve skole rocnik prede mnou. Nic vic!\fZpatky k ukolu!\f

en: There's nothing special about\rmy behavior. Nothing at all!\fLet's get back to the task at hand!\f
cz: Na mem chovani neni nic\rzvlastniho. Vubec nic!\fZpatky k ukolu!\f

en: Let's take stock: anti-air and\rmd tank units on the ground...\fcruisers to prevent escape by\rtransport copter...\fAll right! Everything's shipshape.\rThere's no escape for that unit!\fTime to make a big splash and give\rEagle some cover.\f
cz: Shrnme to: protiletadla a tezke\rtanky na zemi...\fkriziky proti uteku\rtransportnim vrtulnikem...\fVyborne! Vse je, jak ma byt.\rTa jednotka nema kam utect!\fCas rozvirit vlny\ra kryt Eagla.\f

en: Same old shanty!\fI just can't beat you guys.\f
cz: Porad ta sama pisnicka!\fProste vas neporazim.\f

en: Commander Drake, would you please\rtell us why you've been attacking us?\f
cz: Veliteli Drake, reknete nam prosim,\rproc na nas utocite?\f

en: Haven't you sensed him?\fThe person behind all of\rthis fighting?\fSonja and Grit have been trying\rto lure him out of hiding.\f
cz: Necitite ho?\fToho, kdo stoji za vsemi\rtemi boji?\fSonja a Grit se ho snazi\rvylakat z ukrytu.\f

en: The person behind all this?\f
We've been trying to keep Sonja's\rmovements a secret.\fSo, we staged these battles to\rdraw his attention away from her.\fBut I think we're finished now.\fIt seems Sonja's found something.\f
cz: Snazili jsme se utajit\rSonjiny pohyby.\fTyhle bitvy jsme sehrali, abychom\rod ni odvedli jeho pozornost.\fAle ted uz je to nejspis u konce.\fZda se, ze Sonja neco nasla.\f

en: That sounds like\rsomething Sonja would do.\f
cz: To je presne neco,\rco by Sonja udelala.\f

en: I can't leave\rGreen Earth unprotected.\fI promised Eagle. You understand?\fSo... Would you go in my stead?\rThey need your help.\f
cz: Nemuzu nechat\rGreen Earth bez ochrany.\fSlibil jsem to Eaglovi. Chapete?\fTakze... Sel byste misto me?\rPotrebuji vasi pomoc.\f

en: Of course!\fWe'll do all we can!\fEagle, Sonja, and Grit\rare our friends!\f
cz: Samozrejme!\fUdelame, co bude v nasich silach!\fEagle, Sonja a Grit\rjsou nasi pratele!\f

en: Eagle!\f
Andy.\fPlease accept my apologies.\rI'm sorry I doubted you.\f
cz: Andy.\fPrijmi prosim mou omluvu.\rMrzi me, ze jsem ti neveril.\f

en: What the...? It's another me!\f
cz: Co to...? To jsem zase ja!\f

en: Ah, yes.\fThat's the clone of you our enigmatic\rfoe somehow constructed.\fStarting with Green Earth, he's\rattacked several countries.\f
cz: Ach ano.\fTo je tvuj klon, ktery ten zahadny\rnepritel nejak vytvoril.\fZacal Green Earth a napadl uz\rnekolik zemi.\f

en: Are you serious?\f
I've caused a lot of trouble for you,\rbut I'd like to battle by your side.\f
cz: Zpusobil jsem vam spoustu potizi,\rale rad bych bojoval po vasem boku.\f

en: The green units are mine!\fLet me handle all of the\renemy air units.\fIt'll give you time to push straight\rahead and storm the foe's HQ.\f
cz: Zelene jednotky jsou me!\fNepratelska letadla nechte\rvsechna na mne.\fZiskate cas prorazit primo\rvpred a dobyt nepritelovo HQ.\f

en: Who?\fOh, it's you. Sami!\f
Who is that?\fIs that...Andy?\f
What the...?\f
Huh? Two Andys?\fWhat's going on?\fEagle! Can you explain this?\f
cz: Coze? Dva Andyove?\fCo se to deje?\fEagle! Vysvetlis mi to?\f

en: Ah, yes.\fThat's a clone of Andy that our\renigmatic foe somehow constructed.\fStarting with Green Earth, he's\rattacked several countries.\f
cz: Ach ano.\fTo je klon Andyho, ktery ten\rzahadny nepritel nejak vytvoril.\fZacal Green Earth a napadl uz\rnekolik zemi.\f

en: So this is why everyone's been\rpicking fights with Orange Star!\fI don't know who that guy is,\rbut he's got me steamed!\fLook out, bozo! Here I come!\f
cz: Tak proto si vsichni zacinali\rs Orange Star!\fNevim, kdo ten chlap je,\rale pekne me nastval!\fPozor, trubko! Uz jdu!\f

en: Hey! Hold on a moment!\fThe green units are my troops!\fLet me handle all of the\renemy air units.\fIt'll give you time to push straight\rahead and storm the foe's HQ.\f
cz: Hej! Moment!\fZelene jednotky jsou moji vojaci!\fNepratelska letadla nechte\rvsechna na mne.\fZiskate cas prorazit primo\rvpred a dobyt nepritelovo HQ.\f

en: Hm?\fOh, it's you, Max.\f
These troops! Whose are they?\f

Ah, yes.\fThat's a clone of Andy that our\renigmatic foe somehow constructed.\fStarting with Green Earth, he's\rattacked several countries,\fwhich prompted my actions towards\ryou and your friends. My apologies.\f
cz: Ach ano.\fTo je klon Andyho, ktery ten\rzahadny nepritel nejak vytvoril.\fZacal Green Earth a napadl uz\rnekolik zemi,\fcoz me privedlo k tazeni proti\rvam a vasim pratelum. Omlouvam se.\f

en: Forget about it!\f
We should crush this guy first.\f
I concur!\f
I'll make him suffer for\rfooling Eagle.\f
cz: Zaplati mi za to, ze\roklamal Eagla.\f

en: Maelstrom, come... All who oppose me...\fDestroy!\f
We've won...for the time being.\f
Here they come again!\f
Cripes!\rThere's no end in sight!\f
You don't have time to\rwaste around here.\fLeave this to me and go!\f
cz: Nemuzete tu ztracet\rdrahocenny cas.\fNechte to na mne a bezte!\f

en: I'm staying, too!\f
No, Sami!\fYou have to go as well!\f
No!\fEven you can't stand against\rthis horde!\f
You have no idea how powerful\ra foe awaits your friends.\fThey can't face him alone!\fGo, Sami! Go!\f
cz: Netusis, jak silny nepritel\rna tve pratele ceka.\fNemohou mu celit sami!\fBez, Sami! Bez!\f

en: I understand.\fWatch your back!\f
Ha!\fThey'll soon find Eagle's no\reasy prey!\f
cz: Ha!\fBrzy zjisti, ze Eagle neni\rsnadna korist!\f

en: You should leave most of the\renemy units to Eagle.\fWhen you see that the main source\rof power has left, capture the HQ!\fBetter luck next time!\f
cz: Vetsinu nepratelskych jednotek\rprenechte Eaglovi.\fAz hlavni sila odejde,\robsadte HQ!\fPriste vice stesti!\f

en: Who's that?\f
I guess that's our mystery foe.\f
If we beat him, do you think\rmy clone will vanish, too?\f
cz: Kdyz ho porazime, myslis, ze\rzmizi i muj klon?\f

en: Hmm.\f
Was that...it?\f
It looks like it's finally...\f
Andy!\f
Hey! It's Grit!\rLong time, no see.\f
cz: Hej! To je Grit!\rDlouho jsme se nevideli.\f

en: No time for that now, Junior.\fI found the snake's hidin' place!\f
cz: Na to ted neni cas, mladej.\fNasel jsem hadovo doupe!\f

en: Huh? Then this isn't...\f
That's just the tip o' the\rol' boy's tail.\fHurry!\fSonja's in danger!\f
cz: To je jen spicka ocasu\rtoho starocha.\fPospeste si!\fSonja je v nebezpeci!\f

en: Sonja!\f
Grit?\fI'm so sorry.\rTake everyone and run...\fThe enemy...Sturm... He's much more\rpowerful than I'd imagined...\fEveryone's going to be...\f
cz: Grit?\fMoc me to mrzi.\rVezmi vsechny a utecte...\fNepritel...Sturm... Je mnohem\rsilnejsi, nez jsem cekala...\fVsichni budou...\f

en: This 'Sturm' is the one who\rdid this to you, right?\f
cz: Tenhle 'Sturm' ti to udelal,\rje to tak?\f

en: Andy, please...\rYou've got to get away.\f
Who's running away?\fThat guy's goin' down!\f
This is the clown who's been\rjerkin' our chains? He's goin' down!\f
cz: Tak tenhle sasek si z nas\rutahoval? Uz je po nem!\f

en: Hold on, Max!\fAndy's takin' this one, right?\f
cz: Pockej, Maxi!\fTohohle si vezme Andy, ne?\f

en: Oh, yeah. You're right.\f
Don't give me that long face.\fOh, all right, big dawg.\fYou can use my troops.\f
cz: Netvar se tak kysele.\fTak dobre, velkej kluku.\fMuzes pouzit moje vojaky.\f

en: Watch yourself, Sturm!\f
Hey there, Boss!\fYou doin' all right?\f
Of course I am!\fGrit! That wretch deceived\rand used me!\f
cz: Samozrejme!\fGrite! Ten bidak me oklamal\ra vyuzil!\f

en: You just figurin' that out?\f
Eh?\rWhat was that?\f
Did you hear somethin'?\rI didn't hear anythin', sir.\f
cz: Slysel jste neco?\rJa nic neslysel, pane.\f

en: Sonja!\f
Whoa! Where'd this guy come from?\f
Looks like I got here just in time.\f
cz: Vypada to, ze jsem dorazil vcas.\f

en: Captain Drake!\f
Green Earth is secure,\rso I came to join the fray!\fThere's something else\rbothering me, too.\f
cz: Green Earth je zajistena,\rtak jsem se prisel pridat!\fJeste neco jineho mi\rnedava spat.\f

en: Something else?\f
So that's the face of the enemy.\f
Eagle!\fYou're OK!\fThank goodness. (sigh)\f
I... I... Ooooh!\rI am so mad!\fSturm! I can't stand power-hungry\rblockheads like that!\f
cz: Ja... Ja... Uuuuh!\rJsem tak nastvana!\fSturm! Nesnasim takove pitomce\rposedle moci!\f

en: You're a bit steamed,\reh, Sami?\f
Captain Drake!\fHow did you...?\f
I got Green Earth all\rstraightened out.\fSo, I thought I'd come\rdeliver my army.\f
cz: Dal jsem Green Earth\rzase do poradku.\fTak jsem si rekl, ze vam\rprivezu svou armadu.\f

en: These Green Earth troops?\fI can use them?\f
cz: Tyhle jednotky Green Earth?\fMuzu je pouzit?\f

en: Naturally!\fI deployed this group\respecially for you!\f
cz: Samozrejme!\fTuhle skupinu jsem nasadil\rspecialne pro vas!\f

en: All right, everybody!\fLet's move out!\f
No one...ever listens...to me.\rI told you...you can't...win.\fThank you...for trying.\f
I never shoulda left her alone...\f
We can't afford to lose!\f
You will feel my wrath!\f
My precious keepsake, Sonja.\fI will protect you with\rmy life.\f
cz: Sonjo, ma nejdrazsi pamatko.\fBudu te chranit\rvlastnim zivotem.\f

en: I've got to do my best here.\rI can't let Eagle down!\f
cz: Musim tu podat maximum.\rNesmim Eagla zklamat!\f

en: This is getting interesting.\fI was losing my edge\rfighting that darned clone!\f
cz: Tohle zacina byt zajimave.\fS tim zatracenym klonem\rjsem uz ztracel formu!\f

en: We can't let our guards down.\f
Those fools...\fTheir troops are all amassed\rright there...\fBwah ha ha... They've played\rright into my hands!\fThey'll rue the day they dreamed\rof opposing me!\f
cz: Ti hlupaci...\fVsechny jednotky maji\rnahromadene tam...\fBua ha ha... Padli mi\rpresne do rukou!\fBudou litovat dne, kdy si mysleli,\rze se mi postavi!\f

en: Sturm's proving to be\ra dangerous enemy.\fBut if we all work together,\rI know we can win!\fLet's take him!\f
cz: Sturm je vazne\rnebezpecny nepritel.\fAle kdyz budeme drzet pri sobe,\rvim, ze vyhrajeme!\fJdeme na nej!\f

en: Nooooooooooo!\fSo close, I was so close...\fI underestimated the strength\rof these worms!\fI...I've been beaten!\fMy dream of world conquest...\fI vow that I will return!\fWhen that time comes, I will\rchallenge you worms yet again!\f
cz: Neeeeeeeeeee!\fTak blizko, byl jsem tak blizko...\fPodcenil jsem silu\rtechto cervu!\fJa...ja jsem porazen!\fMuj sen o ovladnuti sveta...\fPrisaham, ze se vratim!\fAz ten cas prijde, vyzvu vas\rcervy znovu!\f

en: Yahoo!\fI think that about wraps things up!\fThanks, Grit!\f
cz: Jupi!\fTim by to asi bylo hotovo!\fDiky, Grite!\f

en: Yeah, not a bad day's work, Maxie.\rFor you!\f
You wanna start somethin'?\fShould we settle this right\rhere and now?\f
cz: Chces se hadat?\fMame si to vyridit\rhned tady a ted?\f

en: Ha, ha, ha, ha!\fHow's that?\rDid you see my display?\fI paid back Sturm in kind for\rdaring to deceive me!\f
cz: Cha, cha, cha, cha!\fCo rikas?\rVidel jsi to predstaveni?\fSturmovi jsem oplatil stejnou minci\rza to, ze se opovazil me oklamat!\f

en: I think you just caused a peck\ra trouble with all that snow, Boss.\f
cz: Mam dojem, zes tim snehem nadelal\rpekny poprask, sefe.\f

en: What was that, Grit?\fOh, who cares? It's a grand day!\fHa, ha, ha, ha, ha!\f
cz: Cos to rikal, Grite?\fAch, co na tom? Je to skvely den!\fCha, cha, cha, cha, cha!\f

en: Well, it's not like he's got any\rbad intentions.\f
I do believe we've reached the\rend of a long, dusty road.\fGoodness gracious!\fIf it ain't my old friend--\rbig, bearded Olaf.\f
cz: Mam za to, ze jsme dorazili\rna konec dlouhy prasny cesty.\fNo to me podrz!\fJestli to neni muj stary kamarad--\rvelkej vousatej Olaf.\f

en: Is that you, Grit?\fWhat have I done...?\fI never realized Sturm was...\f
cz: To jsi ty, Grite?\fCo jsem to jen udelal...?\fVubec jsem netusil, ze Sturm...\f

en: Don't get all long in\rthe face now, Olaf.\fEverything turned out all\rright in the end.\fAnd Boss, you still got\ra lot of work to get done.\f
cz: Ale nedelej si teda\rtakovou hlavu, Olafe.\fNakonec to dopadlo\rvsechno dobre.\fA sefe, porad te ceka\rspousta prace.\f

en: You...you're right.\f
Blue Moon's treated me well,\rand I'm in her debt.\fWell, what else can I do?\fWhat do you say? Can I help\ryou rebuild her?\f
cz: Blue Moon se ke mne chovala dobre\ra ja ji dluzim.\fNo, co jineho muzu delat?\fCo ty na to? Muzu ti pomoct\rji postavit na nohy?\f

en: Hm?\fDo you mean you would\rforgive me my misguided deeds?\fGrit, you...you...(sniff, sniff)\f
cz: Hm?\fTy chces rict, ze mi\rodpustis me pomylene ciny?\fGrite, ty...ty...(popotahne)\f

en: Maybe it was worth Sturm\rfoolin' him just for this.\f
cz: Mozna to stalo za to, ze ho\rSturm takhle oblbnul.\f

en: Did you say something?\f
Nope. Not a word.\fLet's say we get movin'\ron down the road.\f
cz: Ale ne. Ani slovo.\fCo kdybysme se radsi\rvydali na cestu.\f

en: Sonja!\fAre you all right?\f
Uh-huh. Thank you, Father.\f
Oh, Sonja...\rIf anything had happened to you...\f
cz: Ach, Sonjo...\rKdyby se ti bylo neco stalo...\f

en: Father! Don't you dare start crying!\f
Bu...but...\f
Really!\fUm, Father... I truly thank you.\fDo you know what Mother\rused to tell me?\f'Your Father's a bit silly, but he'll\ralways be there when you need him.'\f
cz: Vazne!\fEhm, otce... Opravdu ti dekuji.\fVis, co mi vzdycky\rrikavala matka?\f'Tvuj otec je trochu potrhly, ale\rvzdycky tu pro tebe bude.'\f

en: (sniff)\fYou look just like her, Sonja.\rYou really do.\f
Did we win?\f
Yeah, this time we really won!\f
And Sturm's army is\rgone for good, too.\fAh!\fWhat happened to Eagle?\f
cz: A Sturmova armada je\rtaky nadobro pryc.\fAch!\fCo se stalo s Eaglem?\f

en: Ahoy, there mateys!\fIt looks like you've weathered the\rstorm! Or should I say, 'Sturm!'\f
cz: Ahoj, namornici!\fVypada to, ze jste tu bouri\rprestali! Nebo spis 'Sturm'!\f

en: Captain Drake!\f
Don't you worry your pretty little\rhead over Eagle.\fHe'll be back.\fHe always keeps his word.\rNo matter what!\f
cz: Kvuli Eaglovi si tu svou hlavicku\rnelamte.\fVrati se.\fVzdycky drzi slovo.\rAt se deje cokoliv!\f

en: Yes... Yes, he does!\f

At any rate, you did great!\fBut we've still got\rrough seas ahead of us.\fWe've got to put right the country\rborders that Sturm muddled with.\fIt's going to take some time for\rthe fighting to die down.\f
cz: Kazdopadne jste si vedli skvele!\fAle ceka nas jeste\rporadne rozbourene more.\fMusime napravit hranice zemi,\rse kterymi si Sturm pohral.\fChvili potrva, nez boje\rutichnou.\f

en: Do you mean we're not done yet?\f
cz: Chcete rict, ze jeste neni konec?\f

en: It's not as bad as all that.\fAt the very least, it'll be fun\rseeing you all again!\f
cz: Neni to tak strasne.\fAspon bude legrace\rvidet vas zase vsechny!\f

en: I think it'll be fun, too!\f
cz: Taky myslim, ze to bude legrace!\f

en: That's a good lad!\fLooking forward to testing your\rmettle again! Until next we meet!\f
cz: To je spravny chlapik!\fTesim se, az zase otestuji tvou\rodvahu! Do priste!\f

en: Yeah, this time we really won!\f
And Sturm's army is\rgone for good, too.\fEagle! Thanks for your help!\f
cz: A Sturmova armada je\rtaky nadobro pryc.\fEagle! Diky za pomoc!\f

en: No thanks are necessary.\fAfter all, much of your hardships\rwere caused by my earlier mistake.\f
cz: Neni treba dekovat.\fKoneckoncu spoustu potizi\rzpusobila ma drivejsi chyba.\f

en: Facing you in combat was really\ra tough struggle.\fThere was absolutely no\rmargin for error!\f
cz: Bitva proti vam byla opravdu\rtezky boj.\fNebyl tam ani kousek\rprostoru na chybu!\f

en: Yeah, but it was a ton of fun!\f
cz: Jo, ale byla to obrovska zabava!\f

en: For me as well!\fWhy not? Hey, Andy!\fI think I'd like to take\ranother shot at you!\fWhat do you say? Are you\rup for the challenge?\f
cz: Pro mne taky!\fProc ne? Hej, Andy!\fRad bych si to s vami\rrozdal jeste jednou!\fCo vy na to? Prijmete\rtu vyzvu?\f

en: Another battle? You know it!\fLet's go!\f
cz: Dalsi bitva? Jasne, ze jo!\fJdeme na to!\f

en: There aren't many\runits here, are there?\f
That's right.\fDo you know what to do?\f
Sure! I just use these bases to\rdeploy whatever troops I want!\f
cz: Jasne! Na techto zakladnach si\rnasadim jakekoli jednotky chci!\f

en: I guess there's nothing left\rfor me to teach you.\f
cz: Vypada to, ze uz vas nemam\rco naucit.\f

en: I lost again.\rYou're a tough one.\f

Oh, that's right. Orange Star is using\rstrategic advisors.\fThat way, the commanders can just\rconcentrate on the combat itself.\fThat's an impressive system.\rIt's why I couldn't match you in battle.\f
cz: Ach ano. Orange Star pouziva\rstrategicke poradce.\fVelitele se tak mohou soustredit\rjen na samotny boj.\fPusobivy system.\rProto jsem vam v bitve nestacil.\f

en: I don't know why, but when we work\rtogether, we're really strong!\f
cz: Nevim proc, ale kdyz drzime\rpospolu, jsme fakt silni!\f

en: Yes, indeed.\fThis was your day in the sun.\rBut...\f
Hey! Let's fight again some day.\f
cz: Hej! Nekdy si to zase rozdame.\f

en: Lucky me!\e\e\e\e
It's time for a tune-up!\e\e\e\e
Roll, tanks, roll!\e\e\e\e
Let the winds of war bring snow!\e\e\e\e
Ready or not, here I come!\e\e\e\e
Reckon it's time to take you down!\e\e\e\e
cz: Rekl bych, ze je cas vas slozit!\e\e\e\e

en: Who shall taste my wrath?\e\e\e\e
Now you're gonna get it!\e\e\e\e
The Eagle soars above you!\e\e\e\e
Wave good-bye to your troops!\e\e\e\e
You will learn to fear my power!\e\e\e\e
cz: Naucite se bat se me moci!\e\e\e\e

en: Let the winds of war bring snow!\e\e\e\e
Sorry 'bout this. But, you've left\rme no choice.\e\e\e\e
Are you fool enough to believe you\rcan withstand two of my attacks?\e\e\e\e
cz: Jste tak hloupy, ze verite, ze\rustojite dva me utoky?\e\e\e\e

en: Ha, ha, ha... This is what\rI've been waiting for!\e\e\e\e
cz: Cha, cha, cha... Na tohle\rjsem cekal!\e\e\e\e

en: Grit! Try this one on for size!\e\e\e\e
cz: Grite! Zkus, jak ti sedne tohle!\e\e\e\e

en: OK, Max! Now you've\rdone made me mad!\e\e\e\e
cz: Tak jo, Maxi! Ted\rjsi me teda nastval!\e\e\e\e

en: Set sail, my mighty armada!\rDrive them before you!!!\e\e\e\e
cz: Vyplout, ma mocna flotilo!\rZazente je pred sebou!!!\e\e\e\e

en: None can challenge my\rSea Strike Force!\e\e\e\e
cz: Me namorni udernou sile\rse nikdo nevyrovna!\e\e\e\e

en: See if you can handle\rmy best shot!\e\e\e\e
The spirits of winter\rhave blessed my army!\e\e\e\e

en: But all of our commanders are\rcaught up in other campaigns.\fSo there's no one available to lead\rthe Orange Star Army against him.\f
cz: Jenze vsichni nasi velitele\ruvazli v jinych tazenich.\fTakze neni nikdo, kdo by proti nemu\rvedl armadu Orange Star.\f

en: Let me brief you on\rthe current mission.\fOur troops en route to the Lost\rFortress have been waylaid by Olaf.\fIt's up to you to join up with them,\rbeat back Olaf and secure the area.\fWe need the Lost Fortress!\rMove out!\f
cz: Podam vam briefing\rk aktualni misi.\fNase jednotky mirici ke Ztracene\rpevnosti prepadl Olaf.\fJe na vas se k nim pripojit,\rzahnat Olafa a zajistit oblast.\fZtracenou pevnost potrebujeme!\rVyrazte!\f

en: But, it sounds like it's seen a lot of\raction on the front lines, and...\fWell, I guess we'll get a look at it when\rwe reach the battlefield.\f
cz: Jenze prej toho hodne zazil\rna prvni linii, a...\fNo, asi si ho prohledneme, az\rdorazime na bojiste.\f

en: This one is fresh from the factory,\rso don't worry about its condition.\fOK! Let's get moving!\f
cz: Tenhle je primo z tovarny,\rtak o jeho stav strach neni.\fFajn! Jdeme na to!\f

en: This is a chance for you to show me\rwhat you've learned. Are you ready?
cz: Tady mi muzete ukazat, co jste\rse naucili. Jste pripraveni?

en: An entire company doing recon in the\rCoral Lagoon area has been lost.\fThe Coral Fortress is surrounded by\rmountains, so it's hard to imagine that\fthere are many enemy units there.\rStill, an entire company is gone, so...\fThe point is, we can't afford to lose\rthat territory.\f
cz: Cela rota na pruzkumu v oblasti\rKoralove laguny je ztracena.\fKoralovou pevnost obklopuji hory,\rtakze se tezko veri, ze\ftam ma nepritel mnoho jednotek.\rPrece jen zmizela cela rota...\fJde o to, ze si nemuzeme dovolit\rprijit o to uzemi.\f

en: Time to get going!\f
It's time to introduce air units.
Nevertheless, let's make good\ruse of them.\fI'll give you more details once we\rreach the staging area.\fLet's move out!\f
cz: Presto je vyuzijme\rco nejlepe.\fVic podrobnosti vam reknu,\raz dorazime na shromazdiste.\fVyrazme!\f

en: This mission deals with air units, fuel\rconsumption and anti-air defenses.
cz: Tato mise resi vzdusne jednotky,\rspotrebu paliva a protiletadla.

en: No, that's not possi...\rForget it. It's nothing.\fI'm sure I'm just reading\rtoo much into the situation.\fWell, time to get moving!\f
cz: Ne, to neni mozn...\rNechme to. Nic to neni.\fNejspis si tu situaci jen\rzbytecne moc vykladam.\fTak, cas vyrazit!\f

en: It seems that the enemy always has\rsuperior units deployed. I apologize.\f
cz: Zda se, ze nepritel ma vzdy\rlepsi jednotky. Omlouvam se.\f

en: Anyway, it's time to move out!\f
I wonder how fast you can clear this\rair and indirect combat unit section?
cz: Jak rychle asi zvladnete tuhle cast\ro letectvu a neprimych jednotkach?

en: You've only got them for\rthis mission, but...\f
cz: Mate je jen pro tuhle\rmisi, ale...\f

en: It seems Olaf's troops have appeared\ron the far shore.\fYour job is to get over there and\rtake them out in one fell swoop!\fLet's get moving!\f
cz: Zda se, ze Olafovy jednotky se\robjevily na protejsim brehu.\fVasim ukolem je dostat se tam\ra smest je jednim uderem!\fVyrazme!\f

en: Naval units are the topic\rof this briefing.
The mission focuses on climate\rand CO Powers.
cz: Mise se zameruje na pocasi\ra CO sily.

en: Before we move out, I need to brief\ryou in detail on CO Olaf.\fOlaf used to be a CO in\rthe Orange Star Army.\fIn fact, he was my superior.\fHis strong character and skill with the\rtroops make him an invaluable CO.\fThis is what brought him to\rBlue Moon's attention.\f
cz: Nez vyrazime, musim vas\rpodrobne seznamit s Olafem.\fOlaf byval velitelem\rv armade Orange Star.\fDokonce byl mym nadrizenym.\fSilny charakter a schopnost vest\rvojaky z nej delaji skveleho velitele.\fPrave proto si ho vsiml\rBlue Moon.\f

en: Not only did he switch allegiances,\rbut then he attacked Orange Star...\fHe's a complete wretch!\f
cz: Nejen ze zmenil stranu,\rale pak napadl Orange Star...\fJe to naprosty ubozak!\f

en: Just a little more, and the Blue Moon\rArmy will be forced to retreat!\fLet's go get 'em!\f
cz: Jeste kousek a armada Blue Moon\rbude muset ustoupit!\fJdeme na ne!\f

en: Fog of War is the topic of\rthis briefing.
Finally, we've arrived.\f
What a surprise! Are you here\rfor my Special Intel briefing?
cz: To je prekvapeni! Jdete si pro\rme specialni informace?

en: This lesson is for commanders who\rwant a little extra knowledge.\fThis is special intel that may just\rgive you the edge in combat.\f
cz: Tahle lekce je pro velitele, kteri\rchteji vedet neco navic.\fJsou to specialni informace, ktere\rvam mohou dat v boji vyhodu.\f

en: Let's get started!\f
Please enter your name.\f
Name your map, please.\f
Welcome to Advance Wars!\f
I'm a CO in the Orange\rStar Army.\f

Very well, let me explain\ra few things briefly.\fThere are several different\rmodes of game play.\fThe Vs. Mode is for multiplayer\rbattle on one Game Boy Advance.\fTo play Advance Wars on multiple\rsystems, link up with friends and\ftry the Link Mode.\fAnd then there's Field Training.\fIf you're playing for the first time,\ryou should start in Field Training.\fWould you choose Field Training\ron the Mode Select Menu, please?\fIn Field Training, I can\rinstruct you on game controls\fand overall battle strategy.\fOnce in Field Training, please\rcomplete the missions in order\ffrom top to bottom.\f
cz: Dobra, vysvetlim vam\rstrucne par veci.\fHra nabizi nekolik ruznych\rhernich rezimu.\fVs. rezim je pro bitvu vice hracu\rna jednom Game Boy Advance.\fChcete-li hrat Advance Wars na vic\rpristrojich, spojte se s prateli a\fzkuste Link rezim.\fA pak je tu Vycvik.\fPokud hrajete poprve,\rzacnete prave ve Vycviku.\fZvolte prosim Vycvik\rv nabidce vyberu rezimu.\fVe Vycviku vas naucim\rovladani hry\fa zaklady bojove strategie.\fVe Vycviku plnte mise\rpostupne v poradi\fshora dolu.\f

en: The first lesson is on Troop Orders.\rLet's start here!\f
cz: Prvni lekce je o rozkazech jednotkam.\rZacneme tady!\f

en: I think that's for the best!\f

You can get to Field Training\rfrom the Mode Select Menu.\fAlso on the Mode Select Menu is\rVs. Mode, a multiplayer mode for\fa single Game Boy Advance.\fPlus, there's Link Mode, a multiplayer\rmode for multiple game systems.\fNext is Field Training. Please enter\rand complete the missions\fin order from top to bottom.\f
cz: Do Vycviku se dostanete\rz nabidky vyberu rezimu.\fV te nabidce je take Vs. rezim,\rrezim vice hracu\fna jednom Game Boy Advance.\fA dale Link rezim, rezim vice hracu\rna vice pristrojich.\fPak nasleduje Vycvik. Vstupte\ra plnte mise\fpostupne shora dolu.\f

en: The first lesson is on Troop Orders.\rGood luck!\f
cz: Prvni lekce je o rozkazech jednotkam.\rHodne stesti!\f

en: Very well, let me explain\ra few things briefly.\fThere are several different\rmodes of game play.\fVs. Mode is for multiplayer\rbattle on one Game Boy Advance.\fTo play Advance Wars on multiple\rsystems, link up with friends\fand try Link Mode.\fThen there's the Field Training,\rwhere I give game\fand strategy instructions.\fYou must at least clear the final Field\rTraining mission, Fog of War.\fOnce you clear it, other modes\rwill open up for game play.\f
cz: Dobra, vysvetlim vam\rstrucne par veci.\fHra nabizi nekolik ruznych\rhernich rezimu.\fVs. rezim je pro bitvu vice hracu\rna jednom Game Boy Advance.\fChcete-li hrat Advance Wars na vic\rpristrojich, spojte se s prateli\fa zkuste Link rezim.\fPak je tu Vycvik,\rkde ucim ovladani\fa strategii boje.\fMusite dokoncit aspon posledni\rmisi Vycviku, Mlhu valky.\fJakmile ji zvladnete, otevrou se\rdalsi herni rezimy.\f

en: Move out and good luck!\f
