ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ!?,.abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz:/&-1234567890     $$$$$$$$%%%####
Hone your tactical skills.\rHow high can you score?
cz: Brouste sve takticke schopnosti.\rKolik bodu zvladnete?

en: Lessons in the art of war.\rI'll be your instructor.
Shop here with\ryour hard-earned coins.
One to four players can\rplay a single game system.
cz: Jeden az ctyri hraci\rna jednom pristroji.

en: Begin a new\rVs. Mode battle.
Continue a previous\rVs. Mode battle.
Start the Campaign Mode\rfrom the beginning.
Continue the Campaign\rin progress.
Start an Advance\rCampaign!
Continue the Advance\rCampaign in progress.
Link multiple systems\rfor multiplayer battle!
cz: Propojte vice pristroju\rpro bitvu vice hracu!

en: Single-Pak Link.\rFor up to four players.
Multi-Pak Link.\rFor up to four players.
Link up and trade\rmaps with friends!
cz: Propojte se a vymente si\rmapy s prateli!

en: Congratulations! You've received\rsome Advance Wars coins!\fYou can use these coins\rto shop at Battle Maps.\fGo to Battle Maps and talk\rto Hachi for more information.\fYou can find Battle Maps on the\rMode Select Menu. Check it out.\f
cz: Gratulujeme! Ziskali jste\rmince Advance Wars!\fZa tyto mince muzete\rnakupovat v Bojovych mapach.\fZajdete do Bojovych map a\rpromluvte si s Hachim.\fBojove mapy najdete v nabidce\rvyberu rezimu. Mrknete na to.\f

en: Come on in!\fWelcome to Battle Maps.\rIf you've got Advance Wars coins,\fthis is the place to spend 'em.\fMostly I deal in maps.\fOnce you own a map,\ryou can fight on it, you see?\fOh, and I also have map cases.\fYou need a case to\rhold your Vs. Maps in.\fLet me explain... Well, nah, just\rbuy something. You'll figure it out.\fWhoa, hold up there. There's\rsomething else I need to tell you.\fNew COs will become available after\rmeeting certain game conditions.\fYou'll have to figure out those\rconditions on your own, though.\fBut if you stop by again, I might\rshare a few secrets with you.\fWell, that's enough gabbing. Time\rfor business. What do you need?\f
cz: Pojdte dal!\fVitejte v Bojovych mapach.\rMate-li mince Advance Wars,\ftady je utratite.\fObchoduju hlavne s mapami.\fKdyz mapu vlastnite,\rmuzete na ni bojovat, chapete?\fAha, a mam taky pouzdra na mapy.\fPouzdro potrebujete\rna sve Vs. mapy.\fVysvetlim... Ale ne, proste si\rneco kupte. Uz na to prijdete.\fHej, pockat. Musim vam rict\rjeste neco dalsiho.\fNovi velitele se odemknou po\rsplneni urcitych podminek.\fNa ty podminky ale musite\rprijit sami.\fAle kdyz zase zaskocite, mozna\rvam par tajemstvi prozradim.\fTak dost kecu. Jdeme na obchod.\rCo potrebujete?\f

en: Back again?\fWhat can I do for you?\f
cz: Zase tady?\fCo pro vas muzu udelat?\f

en: I'm outta everything.\rThe shelves are bare.\fIt's a sign of my\rconsummate salesmanship.\f
cz: Uz nemam vubec nic.\rRegaly jsou prazdne.\fTo je dukaz meho\rdokonaleho obchodniho ducha.\f

en: Came back, eh?\rI've got everything you need.\f
cz: Tak zpatky, co?\rMam vsechno, co potrebujete.\f

en: What do you need now, Ne...\fOh, you're not...\fUm... What do you want?\f
cz: Co zas potrebujete, Ne...\fAha, vy nejste...\fEhm... Co chcete?\f

en: What a beautiful day!\fThink I'll close up and...\fWhat? A customer?\fDon't you worry, I'm\rnot going anywhere.\fLet's get down to business!\f
cz: Krasny den!\fAsi zavru kram a...\fCoze? Zakaznik?\fZadny strach, nikam\rneodchazim.\fJdeme na obchod!\f

en: Well, now! You're back again!\fThat means you must've made some\rmoney in War Room or Campaign Mode.\fWhat'll it be today?\f
cz: Ale ale! Zase jste tady!\fTo znamena, ze jste vydelali\rve Valecne mistnosti nebo Tazeni.\fCo to dnes bude?\f

en: Oh, its you again!\fHave you picked up\ra map case yet?\fGet one and you can increase\ryour Vs. Map collection.\fSo, come on! Buy something!\f
cz: A jste tu zas!\fPoridili jste si uz\rpouzdro na mapy?\fS nim si rozsirite\rsbirku Vs. map.\fTak do toho! Kupte si neco!\f

en: Hey there, soldier!\fWhich CO have you been using?\fJust between me and you, there's\ra way you can enlist new COs.\fYou just have to... Well,\ractually, I can't tell you!\fYou may learn something\rin the Campaign Mode, though.\fSo, you need anything?\f
cz: Zdravim, vojaku!\fKtereho velitele pouzivate?\fJen mezi nami, existuje zpusob,\rjak naverbovat nove velitele.\fStaci jenom... No, vlastne\rvam to rict nemuzu!\fNeco se mozna dozvite\rv Tazeni.\fTak co, potrebujete neco?\f

en: Look who's here!\fHey, listen. Even if you buy all\rthe maps in stock, come back again.\fI'm always getting new stock.\fGo ahead and take a\rlook at what I've got in today.\f
cz: Koukejme, kdo je tady!\fPoslyste. I kdyz koupite vsechny\rmapy na sklade, zase se stavte.\fPorad dostavam nove zbozi.\fKlidne se podivejte,\rco dneska mam.\f

en: I hear you're doing a good job. Don't\rforget to take a rest now and then.\fHave you been back to Field Training\rsince you cleared it?\fAll right, time for business.\rSee anything you like?\f
cz: Prej si vedete dobre. Nezapomente\rsi obcas odpocinout.\fByli jste ve Vycviku znovu,\rkdyz jste ho dokoncili?\fDobra, jdeme na obchod.\rLibi se vam neco?\f

en: Come on in!\fHey, have you cleared\rthe Campaign Mode?\fThere's more to it than\rjust clearing it once, you know.\fRumor has it that there's\ranother, harder campaign...\fAh, I'm talking too much!\fAre you going to buy anything today?\f
cz: Pojdte dal!\fHele, dokoncili jste uz\rTazeni?\fNeni to jen o tom dokoncit\rho jednou, vite?\fRika se, ze existuje jeste\rjine, tezsi tazeni...\fAch, moc mluvim!\fKoupite si dneska neco?\f

en: Hey! If you're coming in,\rcome in and shut the door!\fBy the way, which CO\rhave you been using?\fUsing the same CO over\rand over isn't very impressive.\fIf you want to reach a higher score,\ryou should try someone new.\fEnough of that,\rwhat'll it be today?\f
cz: Hej! Kdyz uz jdete dovnitr,\rzavrete za sebou dvere!\fMimochodem, ktereho velitele\rpouzivate?\fPorad dokola stejny velitel,\rto neni zadna slava.\fKdyz chcete vyssi skore,\rzkuste nekoho noveho.\fAle dost o tom,\rco to dnes bude?\f

en: Well, back again, are you?\fSay, have you tried\rthe Advance Campaign?\fAll you need to do is\rpress and hold SELECT when\fyou start the Campaign Mode.\fThe Advance Campaign is just\rthe challenge you need, soldier!\fIt'll toughen you up, and the\rpayoff is bigger, too!\fIf you're ever short of funds,\rgive the Advance Mode a shot.\fSo, go make some cash and\rspend it all here! Heh, heh, heh!\f
cz: Tak zase zpatky, co?\fRekneme, zkusili jste uz\rAdvance Tazeni?\fStaci jen\rdrzet stisknute SELECT,\fkdyz spoustite Tazeni.\fAdvance Tazeni je presne ta vyzva,\rkterou potrebujete, vojaku!\fZoceli vas a odmena\rje taky vetsi!\fKdyz vam dojdou mince,\rdejte sanci Advance rezimu.\fTak bezte vydelavat a\rutratte to tady! He, he, he!\f

en: Hey! It's my favorite soldier!\fAre you getting the most\rout of your special CO power?\fAndy's power is to repair\runits and restore HP, right?\fHis units' overall power also grows\ron the day he uses Hyper Repair!\fSo, you can use Andy's power to\rattack with more success, too!\fNow, to the business at hand!\rYou are buying something, right?\f
cz: Hej! Muj oblibeny vojak!\fVyuzivate naplno svou\rspecialni CO silu?\fAndyho sila opravuje jednotky\ra vraci HP, ze?\fV den, kdy pouzije Hyper Repair,\rroste i celkova sila jeho jednotek!\fTakze Andyho silou muzete\rutocit i uspesneji!\fA ted k veci!\rNeco si koupite, ze?\f

en: Welcome!\fHave you ever tried\rusing Sami as your CO?\fDo you think she's difficult to\ruse or that she's a weak CO?\fThat's ridiculous!\fYou DO know that her infantry and\rmech units capture bases faster\fthan other COs' units do, don't you?\fPlus, her troop transports can move\rfarther than other COs' transports!\fWhen it comes to capturing the\renemy's HQ, Sami's the best!\fSure, she's a bit weak in direct\rcombat, but there's nothing wrong\fwith her long distance firepower.\fTry luring the enemy into range with\rher foot soldiers and then blast them\ffrom a distance!\fOh yeah, and another thing. Sami's\rCO power builds up quickly.\fYou should use it\ras often as you can!\fI've done it again! Chatting when I\rshould be selling! Bad for business!\fSo, what's it going to be?\rStart buying stuff, will you?\f
cz: Vitejte!\fZkusili jste uz\rvelet se Sami?\fMyslite si, ze se s ni tezko hraje\rnebo ze je slaba?\fTo je smesne!\fVite prece, ze jeji pechota\ra mechove obsazuji zakladny\frychleji nez u jinych veliteli?\fA jeji transporty dojedou dal\rnez transporty jinych veliteli!\fNa obsazovani nepratelskeho HQ\rje Sami nejlepsi!\fJiste, v primem boji je slabsi,\rale jeji palba na dalku\fje naprosto v poradku.\fZkuste nepritele nalakat pechotou\rdo dostrelu a pak ho rozstrilejte\fz dalky!\fJo, a jeste neco. Sami se\rCO sila nabiji rychle.\fPouzivejte ji\rco nejcasteji!\fZase je to tady! Kecam, misto abych\rprodaval! Spatne pro obchod!\fTak co to bude?\rZacnete uz neco kupovat, ano?\f

en: Look who's here!\fTell me, have you been using Max?\fHe's strong as an ox,\rbut kind of clumsy!\fIf you're looking to get ahead with\rhim, you've got to be strategic.\fMax is pretty ineffective\rat anything but direct attacks.\fIf you try battling in a confined area\ryou'll get whipped! With Max, you\fneed some wide, open space.\fYou know, when I was younger...\rAhh, forget those old stories.\fWhat can I get for you today?\f
cz: Koukejme, kdo je tady!\fRekneme, pouzivate Maxe?\fJe silny jako byk,\rale trochu nemotorny!\fKdyz s nim chcete uspet,\rmusite mit strategii.\fMax je dost neucinny\rve vsem krome primych utoku.\fV uzkem prostoru dostanete\rna frak! S Maxem potrebujete\fsiroky, otevreny prostor.\fVite, kdyz jsem byl mladsi...\rAch, zapomente na stare historky.\fCo vam dneska muzu nabidnout?\f

en: Hello, there! You winning?\fHow much do you know\rabout Blue Moon CO Olaf?\fIf you're thinking that all he can do\ris make it snow, you're dead wrong!\fOlaf is a very well-balanced CO\rwith no real weaknesses!\fHe can battle anywhere, and that\rmakes him a dangerous enemy.\fWell, OK, he's not\rso good in the rain.\fYou should try using him occasionally.\rI guarantee he'll show you something.\fWhy, I remember when he used to...\rOops! Getting sidetracked again.\fAll right, back to business!\f
cz: Zdravim! Vyhravate?\fCo vite o Olafovi,\rveliteli Blue Moon?\fJestli myslite, ze umi jen\rdelat snih, hodne se pletete!\fOlaf je velmi vyvazeny velitel\rbez skutecnych slabin!\fBojuje kdekoli, a to z nej\rdela nebezpecneho nepritele.\fNo dobra, v desti\rmu to moc nejde.\fObcas ho zkuste pouzit.\rZarucene vam neco predvede.\fPamatuju, jak kdysi...\rJejda! Zase odbiham od tematu.\fDobra, zpatky k obchodu!\f

en: My favorite soldier's back again!\fHow familiar are you with Grit?\fHe's an expert marksman, you know!\rWhen it comes to distance attacks,\fthe man has no equal!\fBut because he's so good, he's\rnever polished his direct combat\fskills, and that's his weakness.\fIt's best to use him in\rbattles where you can protect\fhis long distance units.\fOK, time for business!\f
cz: Muj oblibeny vojak je zpatky!\fJak dobre znate Grita?\fJe to mistrny strelec!\rV utocich na dalku\fmu nikdo nesaha po paty!\fJenze protoze je tak dobry,\rnikdy nepiloval primy boj,\fa to je jeho slabina.\fNejlepe se hodi do bitev,\rkde umite ochranit\fjeho jednotky na dalku.\fFajn, jdeme na obchod!\f

en: Come on in!\fSay, have you heard much about\rYellow Comet's little genius, Sonja?\fTo be honest, I think\rshe's tough to manage.\fIt's because her strengths aren't\ras easily recognizable as other COs.\fFor some reason, she's unlucky,\rand her troops don't always do\fas much damage as they should.\fI guess the best time to use her\ris when Fog of War is involved.\fEnough about Sonja!\rLet's talk business!\f
cz: Pojdte dal!\fRekneme, slyseli jste o Sonje,\rmalem geniovi Yellow Comet?\fPo pravde, myslim, ze se\rs ni tezko hraje.\fJeji prednosti totiz nejsou\rtak videt jako u jinych veliteli.\fZ nejakeho duvodu nema stesti\ra jeji jednotky nezpusobi\fvzdy takove skody, jak by mely.\fNejlepsi je nasadit ji tam,\rkde je Mlha valky.\fDost o Sonje!\rJdeme na obchod!\f

en: So, you want to enlist Nell, right?\f
You can now enlist Olaf!\f
Do you want to enlist Grit?\f
You're enlisting Kanbei, right?\f
You can now enlist Sonja!\f
So, you want to enlist Drake?\rWell, let's go get him!\f
cz: Takze chcete Drakea?\rTak pro nej jdeme!\f

en: Eagle?\rYou aim high, don't you?\f
Don't tell anyone, but\ryou can now enlist Sturm!\f
cz: Nikomu to nerikejte, ale\rted muzete naverbovat Sturma!\f

en: This map case is for Vs. Maps. Buy\rit, and I'll throw in some maps, too!\f
cz: Tohle pouzdro je na Vs. mapy. Kupte\rho a par map pridam zdarma!\f

en: This map case is for old maps.\rAnd what do you know, it's full!\f
cz: Tohle pouzdro je na stare mapy.\rA hle, uz je plne!\f

en: You'll be able to use the\rWar Room Maps in Vs. Mode!\f
cz: Mapy z Valecne mistnosti\rpujdou pouzit ve Vs. rezimu!\f

en: This map case is for 3P Vs. Maps.\rI'll throw in some maps, too!\f
cz: Tohle pouzdro je na 3P Vs. mapy.\rPar map pridam zdarma!\f

en: This goes in a Vs. Maps case.\rIf you buy it, that's where it goes.\f
cz: Tohle patri do pouzdra Vs. map.\rKdyz to koupite, ulozi se to tam.\f

en: This goes in a Special Maps case.\rIf you buy it, that's where it goes.\f
cz: Tohle jde do pouzdra specialnich map.\rKdyz to koupite, ulozi se to tam.\f

en: This goes in a War Room case.\rIf you buy it, that's where it goes.\f
cz: Tohle jde do pouzdra Valecne mistnosti.\rKdyz to koupite, ulozi se to tam.\f

en: This goes in a 3P Vs. case.\rIf you buy it, that's where it goes.\f
cz: Tohle patri do pouzdra 3P Vs.\rKdyz to koupite, ulozi se to tam.\f

en: This goes in a 4P Vs. case.\rIf you buy it, that's where it goes.\f
cz: Tohle patri do pouzdra 4P Vs.\rKdyz to koupite, ulozi se to tam.\f

en: This goes in a Pre-Deployed case.\rIf you buy it, that's where it goes.\f
cz: Tohle patri do pouzdra Pre-Deployed.\rKdyz to koupite, ulozi se to tam.\f

en: This is a blank map! You\rcan use it in Design Maps Mode!\f
cz: Tohle je prazdna mapa! Pouzijete\rji v rezimu Tvorba map!\f

en: After you buy this, try pressing\rand holding SELECT\fwhile starting a campaign.\f
cz: Az si to koupite, zkuste drzet\rstisknute SELECT\fpri spousteni tazeni.\f

en: Thanks for coming in!\rDon't forget your stuff.\e\e\e
You don't have enough\rAdvance Wars coins! You're\fnot buying this from me.\f
cz: Nemate dost minci\rAdvance Wars! Tohle\fode me nekoupite.\f

en: Well, how about something else?\f
Darn!\rI'm out of everything!\fI guess I'll close up\rshop for the day.\f
cz: Sakra!\rDoslo mi uplne vsechno!\fAsi dnes kram\rzavru.\f

en: Come back again!\e\e
Don't be discouraged!\e\e
Keep up the good work!\e\e

Orange Star forces?\fHere so soon?\fBut, wait... something's\rnot right here.\fNell wouldn't leave Orange Star's\rcapital city unguarded.\fWhich means...\rA new commanding officer?\fHa, ha, ha! Excellent!\fI've lost a few battles lately,\rbut no more!\fAn Orange Star Army without\rNell is no match for me!\fTime to teach this raw recruit\rwhat war's all about!\f
cz: Sily Orange Star?\fUz tady?\fAle pockat... neco tu\rnehraje.\fNell by nenechala hlavni mesto\rOrange Star bez ochrany.\fCoz znamena...\rNovy velitel?\fHa, ha, ha! Vyborne!\fPosledni bitvy jsem prohral,\rale to uz skoncilo!\fArmada Orange Star bez Nell\rse mi nemuze rovnat!\fJe cas naucit toho zeleneho\rnovacka, co je to valka!\f

en: Empty.\f
Empty.\f
I win!
Dummy.
Dummy.
Grit! Grit!\rWhere's Grit?\f
Easy there! I heard you the first\rtime, O bearded one.\f
cz: Klid! Slysel jsem te uz\rnapoprve, vousaci.\f

en: Bearded one?\rWhy you...\f
A slip of the tongue. My\rapologies, commander.\f
What? You want me to go\rpersonally? Like, in person?\f
cz: Coze? Ja mam jet\rosobne? Jako fakt osobne?\f

en: Why you lazy, no-good... What do\ryou think a commanding officer does?\fIf you don't get moving...\f
cz: Ty lenochu jeden... Co si\rmyslis, ze velitel dela?\fJestli sebou nehodis...\f

en: All right. Keep your beard on. I don't\rmuch like the idea, but I'm going.\f
cz: Dobra. Nerozcuchej si vousy.\rMoc se mi to nezamlouva, ale jedu.\f

en: Gone at last...\fHe's an impudent rogue, but he's also\rthe best marksman I've ever seen.\fThose Orange Star fools will never\rknow what hit them. Perfect!\f
cz: Konecne je pryc...\fJe to drzy darebak, ale taky\rnejlepsi strelec, co jsem videl.\fTi hlupaci z Orange Star nebudou\rvedet, co je smetlo. Dokonale!\f

en: Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha!\f
Empty.\f
Empty.\f
Stop calling me Junior!
Dummy.
Dummy.
Hmmm... What have we here?\fOrange Star forces, if I'm not\rmistaken. And, of course, I never am.\fI had heard that the Blue Moon Army\rruined them, but...\f
cz: Hmmm... Copak to tu mame?\fSily Orange Star, pokud se\rnepletu. A ja se nikdy nepletu.\fSlysel jsem, ze je armada\rBlue Moon znicila, ale...\f

en: How interesting. I think I'll\rentertain them for a while.\f
cz: Zajimave. Asi se s nimi\rchvili pobavim.\f

en: Empty.\f
Empty.\f
Who in the world is that?
Dummy.
Dummy.
Sorry to keep you waiting!\f
Who are you?\f
A new CO, huh? What's so special\rabout you?\f
cz: Novy velitel, co? Co je na tobe\rtak zvlastniho?\f

en: You get right to the point,\rdon't you, pal?\fI'm the king of direct combat. Need\rsomeone to mix it up? I'm the best!\fWhen I really get rolling, Max Force\rboosts my firepower even higher.\f
cz: Jdes rovnou k veci,\rvid, kamarade?\fJsem kral prime palby. Potrebujes\rnekoho do mlyna? Jsem nejlepsi!\fKdyz se rozjedu, Max Force mi\rjeste zvysi silu palby.\f

en: Cool!\f
Empty.\f
Hooray!
That about wraps it up!
Dummy.
Hey! Junior!\f
Stop calling me Junior!\f
You're just a regular\rfireball, ain't you?\f
By the way, how're you\rand Big Maxie getting along?\f
cz: Mimochodem, jak spolu vychazis\rs velkym Maxikem?\f

en: Grit?\fIn the Blue Moon Army?\f

Yep. Things happen, you know.\fBlue Moon helped me out of some\rtrouble, and I always pay my debts.\fBut that's neither here nor\rthere, big fella.\fYou must be getting old if they've\rsent you out to test Junior here.\f
cz: Jo. Zivot je slozitej, vis.\fBlue Moon me vytahl z maleru\ra ja dluhy vzdycky splacim.\fAle to sem ted nepatri,\rvelkej chlape.\fUz asi starnes, kdyz te poslali\rotestovat tady mladyho.\f

en: What? Why you...\f
I tell you what, why don't I\rjust lend you a hand testing him out?\fYou boys survive the next five days\rand you'll know what he's made of.\fThink you can take me, old dog?\rBring it on boys!\f
cz: Vis co, co kdybych ti s tim\rtestovanim trochu pomoh?\fPrezijte dalsich pet dni\ra uvidite, co v nem je.\fMyslis, ze na me mas, stary pse?\rTak do toho, hosi!\f

en: Empty.\f
Empty.\f
Whew! Squeaked that one out!
That was close!
Dummy.
Nell? Is that you?\fWhat's wrong? You\rsound upset.\f
cz: Nell? To jsi ty?\fCo se deje? Znis\rrozrusene.\f

en: There's no time to worry about me.\rOlaf's naval units are on the move!\fBlue Moon must not be allowed to\rregain its momentum!\fIt's imperative that you hurry and\rsecure as many bases as possible.\f
cz: Nemame cas resit mne.\rOlafovy lode se daly do pohybu!\fBlue Moon nesmi znovu\rziskat prevahu!\fMusite si pospisit a obsadit\rco nejvic zakladen.\f

en: Got it!\fLet's get moving!\f
I'll go!\f
I'll take care of this!\f
Empty.\f
Keep this up and we'll drive\rOlaf outta here in no time!
cz: Takhle dal a Olafa odsud\rvyzeneme co nevidet!

en: Darn! Olaf got away!
Dummy.

I never dreamed that they could\rannihilate my navy... Who would've\fguessed? I badly\runderestimated them.\fStill... I'm not done yet!\fI still have my elite Sea Strike\rForce. They'll clear up this mess!\f
cz: Ani ve snu by me nenapadlo, ze\rznici mou flotilu... Kdo to mohl\ftusit? Hrube jsem\rje podcenil.\fPresto... jeste nekoncim!\fPorad mam elitni Namorni\rudernou skupinu. Ta to napravi!\f

en: Sea Strike Force, huh?\fIt seems smaller than the\rlast naval group, but...\f
cz: Namorni uderna skupina, jo?\fVypada mensi nez ta\rminula flotila, ale...\f

en: Fight! Fight for him!\fThis battle shall bring\rus victory!\f
cz: Bojujte! Bojujte za nej!\fTato bitva nam prinese\rvitezstvi!\f

en: ...Hmm. Whatever.\f
Empty.\f
That was really cold.
That's that!
Dummy.
Grit!\fWhere is that fool?\f
I'm right here.\rWhat are you bellowing about now?\f
cz: Jsem tady.\rNad cim to zas tak hulakate?\f

en: Bellowing?\rLet me tell you something, you...\f
My apologies, exalted commander.\fI am at your service.\f
cz: Omlouvam se, vzneseny veliteli.\fJsem vam k sluzbam.\f

en: That's better. You just remember\ryour place. Now, listen closely.\fThose units we saw earlier have\radvanced further into our territory.\fThis is your chance to redeem\ryourself. Do what needs to be done.\f
cz: To je lepsi. Jen si pamatuj,\rkam patris. A ted pozorne poslouchej.\fTy jednotky, co jsme videli,\rpostoupily hloub na nase uzemi.\fTohle je tvoje sance na napravu.\rUdelej, co je treba.\f

en: Riiight. So, I should wait here and...\f
cz: Jasneee. Takze mam pockat tady a...\f

en: Oh, OK. Understood. If duty calls,\ryour humble servant Grit'll answer!\f
cz: Aha, dobre. Kdyz povinnost vola,\rvas pokorny sluha Grit odpovi!\f

en: If I didn't know better, I might think\ryou weren't taking this seriously.\f
cz: Kdybych te neznal, rekl bych,\rze to neberes vazne.\f

en: Empty.\f
I did it! I won!
Chalk another one up for me!
Dummy.
Blast! We're running out\rof opportunities.\f
I don't see the need to\rget so worked up.\fIt's not like this was Blue Moon\rproperty to begin with.\f
cz: Nevidim duvod se kvuli tomu\rtak cilit.\fStejne to nikdy nepatrilo\rBlue Moon.\f

en: What did you say?\fAfter all my work\rand planning?\f
cz: Cos to rekl?\fPo vsi te praci\ra planovani?\f

en: It's common theft, man!\rNothing more, nothing less.\f
cz: Je to sprosta kradez, chlape!\rNic vic, nic min.\f

en: Why, you insolent little...\f
Whoa! Hold on chief! Don't you\rthink it's time to move out?\fLike you said, the Orange Star\rtroops are knocking on our door.\f
cz: Hola! Klid, sefe! Nemyslite,\rze je cas vyrazit?\fJak jste rikal, Orange Star\rnam klepe na dvere.\f

en: Grit!\fYou're pushing your luck!\fDon't go anywhere, you understand?\fI'll deal with you when I get back.\f
cz: Grit!\fPokousis stesti!\fNikam nechod, rozumis?\fAz se vratim, vyridim si to s tebou.\f

en: Empty.\f
That was cold.
Got 'em!
Dummy.
It looks like we'll be\rfacing Grit next.\f
cz: Vypada to, ze dalsi na rade\rje Grit.\f

en: Grit... Is he the guy who keeps\rcalling me junior?\fDo you know him or something?\f
cz: Grit... To je ten, co mi porad\rrika mlady?\fTy ho znas, nebo co?\f

en: Yeah, you could say that.\rHe, Nell and I used to be friends.\fHe was always a tough one to figure\rout, but this Blue Moon stuff...\f
cz: Jo, dalo by se to tak rict.\rOn, Nell a ja jsme byvali kamaradi.\fNikdy nebylo snadne ho prokouknout,\rale tohle s Blue Moon...\f

en: Nell knows him, too?\fWhy is he working for Blue Moon?\f
cz: Nell ho taky zna?\fProc dela pro Blue Moon?\f

en: That's something I'd like\rto ask him myself.\f
cz: Na to bych se ho rad\rzeptal sam.\f

en: That's why you've got to\rlet me face him, Andy!\f
cz: Proto me proti nemu\rmusis pustit, Andy!\f

en: Empty.\f
Boy, he was pretty tough.
Grit...
Dummy.
Who are you?\f

My name is Sami.\fI'm the Special Forces commander.\fI was supposed to join you earlier,\rbut my last mission ran long.\fWell, better late than never, right?\fI'm an infantry and\rmech unit specialist.\fMy units can seize and secure new\rbases faster than any other CO's.\fMy transport units are\rtop of the line, too.\fDon't hesitate to deploy me\rand my troops as you see fit.\f
cz: Jmenuji se Sami.\fVelim specialnim jednotkam.\fMela jsem se k vam pridat driv,\rale posledni mise se protahla.\fLepe pozde nez nikdy, ne?\fJsem specialistka na pechotu\ra mechy.\fMe jednotky obsadi nove zakladny\rrychleji nez kdokoli jiny.\fMoje transportni jednotky\rjsou taky spicka.\fNevahejte me a me vojaky\rnasadit, jak uznate za vhodne.\f

en: I'm ready for action!\f
Looking forward to working\rwith you, Sami!\f
That's the spirit!\f
Oh, I've got some information, too.\fWord is that Olaf's forces\rare marching toward Yellow Comet.\fLet's go get 'em!\f...Wait a minute... who's that?\f
cz: Aha, mam taky nejake informace.\fPry Olafovy jednotky\rmiri k Yellow Comet.\fJdeme po nich!\f...Momentik... kdo je tohle?\f

en: Eagle's troops are tough!
I'm nobody's fool!
Now it's on to Yellow Comet!
Hmm?\fLike a plague, here comes\rthe Orange Star Army!\fNot content with their own lands,\rthey've come to steal mine!\fNever, I say! Never!\fKanbei's Imperial Forces shall\rdrive them back!\f
cz: Hmm?\fJako mor se blizi\rarmada Orange Star!\fNestaci jim vlastni zeme,\rprisli ukrast i mou!\fNikdy! Rikam nikdy!\fKanbeiho cisarske vojsko\rje zazene zpet!\f

en: Wow! They were good.
That was much too close.
Whew! Kanbei's as tough as ever!
cz: Uf! Kanbei je tuhy jako vzdy!

en: What shall we do, Sonja?\f
Well, what are the current battle\rconditions, Father?\f
cz: Nuze, jake jsou aktualni bojove\rpodminky, otce?\f

en: What?\f
I asked about the conditions, Father.\f
cz: Ptala jsem se na podminky, otce.\f

en: Well, I... Uhm...\f
Oh, Father. This is\rso typical of you.\fGathering thorough intel is\rthe key to victory!\fWhat were you planning to do\rwithout even basic information?\f
cz: Ach, otce. To je\rpro tebe typicke.\fDukladny pruzkum je\rklic k vitezstvi!\fCo jsi chtel delat bez\rzakladnich informaci?\f

en: Basic information... well, yes...\f
Hopeless. Absolutely hopeless.\fI suppose I'll share my\rintel with you, Father.\fThe enemy troops are deployed here.\fIt doesn't appear to be\ra very large force.\f
cz: Beznadejne. Naprosto beznadejne.\fAsi se s tebou o svoje\rpoznatky podelim, otce.\fNepratelske jednotky jsou tady.\fNevypada to na nijak\rvelkou silu.\f

en: Is that so?\fThen I'll just crush them\rwith superior numbers!\f
cz: Tak takhle?\fPak je proste rozdrtim\rprevahou v poctu!\f

en: Well, yes. You could do that.\fBut first...\f
cz: No, ano. To bys mohl.\fAle nejdriv...\f

en: It is decided! This time Kanbei\rwill be showered with glory!\f
Wait! Wait!\rFather!\fYou've got to remember to deploy\rin an area with secure bases.\fIf the enemy seizes them\rbefore you arrive...\fFather? He's gone. Oh, Father.\rWhat are you trying to prove?\f
cz: Pockej! Pockej!\rOtce!\fMusis se rozmistit v oblasti,\rkde jsou zajistene zakladny.\fKdyz je nepritel obsadi\rdriv, nez dorazis...\fOtce? Je pryc. Ach, otce.\rCo chces vlastne dokazat?\f

en: Now that was fun!
Kanbei's even stronger\rthan I'd heard.
cz: Kanbei je jeste silnejsi,\rnez se rikalo.

en: This one belongs to me!
They're pretty good, aren't they?\rYou can go on and on about their\fsuperior number of bases, but they\rreally just outlasted you, Father.\f
cz: Jsou dost dobri, vid?\rMuzes porad mluvit o tom, kolik\fmaji zakladen, ale oni te proste\rpreckali, otce.\f

en: But Sonja...\f
Father! Stop that whining!\fYou're the Yellow Comet\rcommander for goodness' sake!\f
cz: Otce! Prestan fnukat!\fJsi prece velitel\rYellow Comet, proboha!\f

en: Yes, you're right... I am.\rWhat should I do?\f
cz: Ano, mas pravdu... jsem.\rCo mam delat?\f

en: Well, first of all, we obviously need\rto match their number of bases.\f
cz: Predne se musime vyrovnat\rjejich poctu zakladen.\f

en: Of course!\rKanbei must have bases, too!\f
Yes, but we also...\f
It is decided!\fKanbei shall secure bases\rnear the enemy!\f
Father? Ohhhh... gone again.\rDoesn't he realize that the proper\flocation of bases is just as\rimportant as numbers?\f
cz: Otce? Ale ne... zase je pryc.\rCopak mu nedochazi, ze poloha\fzakladen je stejne dulezita\rjako jejich pocet?\f

en: I want to keep on battling!
That was hard work!
I did it! I won!
Father, you're impossible! Do you\rknow why this keeps happening?\fYou never let me finish\rwhat I'm trying to tell you!\f
cz: Otce, ty jsi nemozny! Vis, proc\rse to porad opakuje?\fNikdy me nenechas dorict,\rco ti chci rict!\f

en: Uh...\f
I will admit that your Imperial Forces\rdon't generally lose, but...\fLet's just blame the enemy\rfor being too strong this time.\f
cz: Uznavam, ze tve cisarske vojsko\robvykle neprohrava, ale...\fSvedme to tentokrat na to,\rze byl nepritel moc silny.\f

en: Hmm...\f
This time, I'll take command.\f
Sonja! Kanbei will not allow his\rdaughter to be placed in harm's way!\fWhy, if the unthinkable were to\rhappen...\f
cz: Sonjo! Kanbei nedovoli, aby se\rjeho dcera vydala v nebezpeci!\fKdyby se stalo to\rnemyslitelne...\f

en: Father, you hush! There's something\rI need to investigate.\fAnd, I need first-hand intel\rto formulate a strategy.\f
cz: Otce, ticho! Neco si musim\roverit.\fA k sestaveni strategie\rpotrebuji vlastni poznatky.\f

en: But, but...\f
Ok, Father, take it easy.\fHow's this? At the first sign of\rdanger, I'll retreat. Ok?\f
cz: Dobre, otce, klid.\fCo treba takhle? Pri prvnim\rnaznaku nebezpeci ustoupim. Ano?\f

en: You must promise to avoid\runnecessary risks. Understood?\f
cz: Musis mi slibit, ze se vyhnes\rzbytecnym rizikum. Rozumis?\f

en: Of course, Father.\fI'll be back.\f
Dummy.\f
Dummy.\f
Dummy.
Hmm...
Dummy.
You're wasting your breath.\fI've seen to it that he'll be\rasleep for quite some time.\f
cz: Marnis dech.\fPostarala jsem se o to, ze bude\rjeste dlouho spat.\f

en: You... Sonja! I might've known!\rSplitting the three of us up... This\fwas all part of your strategy,\rwasn't it!\f
cz: Ty... Sonjo! Mel jsem to tusit!\rRozdelit nas tri... To vsechno\fbyla soucast tve strategie,\rvid!\f

en: Of course. Brilliant deduction.\fI've got Andy secured in a\rnice, safe place, too.\fIf you want him back, you\rjust have to get past me.\fThe first person to secure sixteen\rproperties on this map wins.\fGot it? Good.\rReady, set, go!\f
cz: Samozrejme. Skvela dedukce.\fAndyho mam taky ulozeneho\rna pekne bezpecnem miste.\fJestli ho chces zpatky,\rmusis se dostat pres me.\fVyhrava ten, kdo prvni obsadi\rsestnact budov na teto mape.\fJasne? Dobre.\rPripravit, pozor, ted!\f

en: Hey! Come back here!\f
Dummy.\f
Dummy.\f
Dummy.
Dummy.
Okay, now this is really starting\rto make me mad!
cz: Tak tohle me uz zacina fakt\rstvat!

en: Andy! Are you okay?\f
Andy!\f
I'm... so... groggy...\f
Wake up!\f
Huh?\fOh... morning, Sami.\f

Unbelievable! Here I am, working my\rtail off, and you're sleeping!\fWhy am I the only one who's\rtaking these things seriously?\fSonja's been leading us around by\rour noses like a bunch of sheep!\fOooh...! She makes me so mad!\fEver since we were classmates,\rshe's been the Queen of Strategy.\fNow here I am, losing units left and\rright, and my allies are all sleeping!\fGet up and get moving, Andy!\rIt's up to you. You've got to go!\f
cz: Neuveritelne! Ja se tu drem\rjako mezek a ty si spis!\fProc jsem jedina, kdo to tady\rbere aspon trochu vazne?\fSonja nas vodi za nos\rjako stado ovci!\fUaaa...! Ta me tak vytaci!\fUz od skoly ze studii je z ni\rkralovna strategie.\fZtracim jednotku za jednotkou\ra spojenci si tu v klidu chrapou!\fVstavej a hni sebou, Andy!\rTed je to na tobe. Musis jit!\f

en: Dummy.\f
Dummy.\f
I'm glad I won...
Dummy.
Dummy.
Blow ye winds o' the mornin'!\rBlow ye winds hi ho!\f
cz: Fouknete vetry rannich vln!\rFouknete vetry, hej ho!\f

en: Drake!\fWhat are you doing\rall the way out here?\fYou've got to get into position!\f
cz: Drake!\fCo tady vubec\rdelas tak daleko?\fMusis se presunout na pozici!\f

en: Morning, Eagle.\fWouldn't you rather just\rsit and bask in the sun a while?\f
cz: Dobre rano, Eagle.\fNechces si radsi chvili\rsednout a vyhrat se na slunci?\f

en: Are you insane?\fThe Orange Star Army\ris on the move!\f
cz: Zblaznil ses?\fArmada Orange Star\rje na pochodu!\f

en: Oh, is that so?\f
Is that so? Drake, are you...\f
Be cool - everything's under control.\rNo need to rush.\fI've got everything set up.\f
cz: Klid - vse je pod kontrolou.\rNeni proc spechat.\fMam uz vsechno pripravene.\f

en: Now, doesn't this sun feel good?\fOh...\fHe's gone.\rAh well. I guess I'd better get\funder way before Eagle gets his\rfeathers any more ruffled.\f
cz: Tak co, nehreje to slunce hezky?\fOch...\fJe pryc.\rNo nic. Radsi uz vyplujem, nez\fse Eagle nacepyri jeste vic,\rnez uz stejne je.\f

en: Drake always finds some\rway to sidetrack me.\fHe's absolutely peerless in naval\rcombat, but sometimes I wonder...\f
cz: Drake me vzdycky necim\rdokaze rozhodit.\fV namornim boji nema soupere,\rale nekdy si rikam...\f

en: Love that fresh sea air!
That's what happens\rwhen you face me!
cz: Tak to dopada, kdyz\rse postavis mne!

en: That Tsunami should be\ragainst the rules!
cz: Ta Tsunami by mela\rbyt proti pravidlum!

en: By Neptune's beard,\rthat was a rough battle!\f
cz: U Neptunovy brady,\rto byla drsna bitva!\f

en: Come on, Drake!\fWe'll be beaten again if\ryou don't get moving!\f
cz: Delej, Drake!\fZase nas porazi, pokud\rse nehnes z mista!\f

en: Quit your jabbering and\rlook around, Eagle.\fOnly fools sail into uncharted\rwaters blindfolded.\f
cz: Prestan zvanit a\rrozhledni se, Eagle.\fJen hlupak vplouva do neznamych\rvod se zavazanyma ocima.\f

en: What are you talking ab...?\f
Orange Star did not\rattack Green Earth.\f
But, we saw...\f
We saw what we were meant to see!\rAnd this goes beyond the battles in\fGreen Earth. This entire conflict has\rbeen orchestrated from the beginning.\f
cz: Videli jsme to, co videt meli!\rA netyka se to jen boju v\fGreen Earth. Cely tenhle konflikt\rnekdo reziruje uz od zacatku.\f

en: But how...\f
Quiet! Now, if I'm right, we'll have to\rturn the tides on our mystery foe.\fThe best way to test my theory\ris to battle Orange Star again.\f
cz: Ticho! Pokud mam pravdu, musime\robratit vlny proti tomu neznamemu.\fNejlepsi zpusob, jak to overit,\rje utkat se s Orange Star znovu.\f

en: You mean... that wasn't Andy?\f
cz: Chces rict... ze to nebyl Andy?\f

en: Tough battles are the best!
That was pretty tight!
I won... somehow.
Aye, like I said, that's\ra rough opponent.\fDoesn't this old sea dog deserve\rsome smooth sailing now and then?\f
cz: Jo, rikal jsem ti,\rje to tvrdy souper.\fNezaslouzi si stary morsky vlk\robcas taky klidnou plavbu?\f

en: Drake! Listen...\fAbout our earlier conversation...\f
Ahoy there, Eagle.\fIt's time for you to test the waters.\fBattle Orange Star yourself and see\rif my theory holds any water.\f
cz: Ahoj, Eagle.\fJe cas omocit si nohy.\fUtkej se s Orange Star sam a uvidis,\rjestli moje teorie drzi nad vodou.\f

en: I think you're right.\f
It wasn't me! I swear!
I'm still good to go!
He's not such a bad guy...\rBut, boy, is he stubborn.
cz: Neni to spatny chlap...\rAle je palicaty jako mezek.

en: I saw his face! That\rhad to be Andy, but...\f
cz: Videl jsem mu do tvare!\rMusel to byt Andy, ale...\f

en: Hello, Eagle.\f
You... you're Sonja from\rYellow Comet.\fWhat are you doing here?\f
cz: Vy... vy jste Sonja z\rYellow Comet.\fCo tu delate?\f

en: It wasn't Andy who attacked you.\rIt was someone else.\f
cz: Neutocil na vas Andy.\rByl to nekdo uplne jiny.\f

en: Do you know something\rabout all of this?\f
Yes, I do.\fI'll tell you who's pulling all of\rour strings if you'll follow me.\f
cz: Ano, vim.\fReknu vam, kdo taha za nase\rnitky, pokud pujdete se mnou.\f

en: But I...\f
I know what you're worried about.\rGo ahead and go with her.\f
cz: Vim, co te trapi.\rKlidne jdi s ni.\f

en: Are you sure it's OK?\f
I'll take care of Green Earth\rfor you, don't worry.\fThat's what shipmates\rare for, right?\f
cz: O Green Earth se ti postaram,\rneboj se.\fOd toho prece kamaradi\rz posadky jsou, ne?\f

en: You have my gratitude, Drake.\f
I like the idea of getting a closer\rlook at the Orange Star Army.\fI'll meet you again later.\fWatch yourself, Eagle!\f
cz: Rad se na armadu Orange Star\rpodivam trochu zblizka.\fSejdeme se zase pozdeji.\fDej na sebe pozor, Eagle!\f

en: Yahoo! Here I go!
All right!
So that's the reason...
Blow ye winds 'o the mornin'\rBlow ye winds hi ho!\f
cz: Fouknete vetry rannich vln\rFouknete vetry, hej ho!\f

en: Drake!\fWhat are you doing\rall the way out here?\fYou've got to get into position!\f
cz: Drake!\fCo tady vubec\rdelas tak daleko?\fMusis se presunout na pozici!\f

en: Morning, Eagle.\fWouldn't you rather just\rsit and bask in the sun a while?\f
cz: Dobre rano, Eagle.\fNechces si radsi chvili\rsednout a vyhrat se na slunci?\f

en: Are you insane?\fThe Orange Star Army\ris on the move!\f
cz: Zblaznil ses?\fArmada Orange Star\rje na pochodu!\f

en: Oh, is that so?\f
Is that so? Drake, are you...\f

Be cool - everything's under control.\rThere's no need to rush.\fI've got everything set up.\fNow, doesn't this sun feel good?\fOh...\fHe's gone.\rAh well, I guess I'd better get\funder way before Eagle gets his\rfeathers any more ruffled.\f
cz: Klid - vse je pod kontrolou.\rNeni proc spechat.\fMam uz vsechno pripravene.\fTak co, nehreje to slunce hezky?\fOch...\fJe pryc.\rNo nic. Radsi uz vyplujem, nez\fse Eagle nacepyri jeste vic,\rnez uz stejne je.\f

en: Drake always finds some\rway to sidetrack me.\fHe's absolutely peerless in naval\rcombat, but sometimes I wonder...\f
cz: Drake me vzdycky necim\rdokaze rozhodit.\fV namornim boji nema soupere,\rale nekdy si rikam...\f

en: Love that fresh sea air!
That's what happens\rwhen you face me!
cz: Tak to dopada, kdyz\rse postavis mne!

en: That Tsunami should be\ragainst the rules!
cz: Ta Tsunami by mela\rbyt proti pravidlum!

en: By Neptune's beard,\rthat was a rough battle!\f
cz: U Neptunovy brady,\rto byla drsna bitva!\f

en: Come on, Drake!\fWe'll be beaten again if\ryou don't get moving!\f
cz: Delej, Drake!\fZase nas porazi, pokud\rse nehnes z mista!\f

en: Quit your jabbering and\rlook around, Eagle.\fOnly fools sail into uncharted\rwaters blindfolded.\f
cz: Prestan zvanit a\rrozhledni se, Eagle.\fJen hlupak vplouva do neznamych\rvod se zavazanyma ocima.\f

en: What are you talking ab...?\f
Orange Star did not\rattack Green Earth.\f
But, we saw...\f
We saw what we were meant to see!\rAnd this goes beyond the battles in\fGreen Earth. This entire conflict has\rbeen orchestrated from the beginning.\f
cz: Videli jsme to, co videt meli!\rA netyka se to jen boju v\fGreen Earth. Cely tenhle konflikt\rnekdo reziruje uz od zacatku.\f

en: But how...\f
Quiet! Now, if I'm right, we'll have to\rturn the tides on our mystery foe.\fThe best way to test my theory\ris to battle Orange Star again.\f
cz: Ticho! Pokud mam pravdu, musime\robratit vlny proti tomu neznamemu.\fNejlepsi zpusob, jak to overit,\rje utkat se s Orange Star znovu.\f

en: You mean... that wasn't Andy?\f
cz: Chces rict... ze to nebyl Andy?\f

en: Tough battles are the best!
That was pretty tight!
I won... somehow.
Aye, like I said, that's\ra rough opponent.\fDoesn't this old sea dog deserve\rsome smooth sailing now and then?\f
cz: Jo, rikal jsem ti,\rje to tvrdy souper.\fNezaslouzi si stary morsky vlk\robcas taky klidnou plavbu?\f

en: Drake! Listen...\fAbout our earlier conversation...\f
Ahoy there, Eagle.\fIt's time for you to test the waters.\fBattle Orange Star yourself and see\rif my theory holds any water.\f
cz: Ahoj, Eagle.\fJe cas omocit si nohy.\fUtkej se s Orange Star sam a uvidis,\rjestli moje teorie drzi nad vodou.\f

en: I think you're right.\f
Yeah, I'm right here...
I'm still good to go!
He's not such a bad guy...\rBut, boy, is he stubborn.
cz: Neni to spatny chlap...\rAle je palicaty jako mezek.

en: I saw his face! That\rhad to be Andy, but...\f
cz: Videl jsem mu do tvare!\rMusel to byt Andy, ale...\f

en: Hello, Eagle.\f
You... you're Sonja from\rYellow Comet.\fWhat are you doing here?\f
cz: Vy... vy jste Sonja z\rYellow Comet.\fCo tu delate?\f

I know what you're worried about.\rGo ahead and go with her.\f

en: Yahoo! Here I go!
All right!
So that's the reason...
Who is that?\f

Olaf's invasion of Orange Star\ris where all of this began.\fDuring the attack, Andy was seen\rleading sorties on several countries.\fYou saw him yourself, didn't you?\fSo... doesn't all this strike\ryou as exceedingly odd?\f
cz: Vsechno zacalo Olafovym\rvpadem do Orange Star.\fBehem utoku videli Andyho,\rjak vede vypady na dalsi zeme.\fSam jste ho videl, ze?\fNezda se vam to\rvsechno nesmirne divne?\f

en: Well, now that you\rmention it...\f
You see what I'm getting at? It\rwould've been impossible for Orange\fStar to launch multiple offensives\rwhile trying to repel Olaf's attack.\fThat's the anomaly I wanted\rto show you.\f
cz: Chapete, kam mirim? Orange Star\rby nikdy nedokazala vest\fnekolik ofenziv naraz,\rkdyz odrazela Olafuv utok.\fTo je ta odchylka, kterou jsem\rvam chtela ukazat.\f

en: Impossible!\rI'm getting angrier by the moment!\f
cz: To neni mozne!\rVztek ve mne roste kazdou chvili!\f

en: It seems that our mystery foe has\rthe ability to create human clones.\fI think it's safe to say that we've\rencountered several copies of Andy.\f
cz: Zda se, ze nas zahadny nepritel\rumi vytvaret lidske klony.\fKlidne se da rict, ze jsme potkali\rhned nekolik kopii Andyho.\f

en: Blast! This is terrible!\f
I have some more stones to\roverturn, so I'll be going.\fWhat are your plans?\f
cz: Musim jeste obratit par kamenu,\rtak uz pujdu.\fJake mate plany vy?\f

en: I won't leave this madman\ron the loose!\fI'll find him and crush him!\f
cz: Toho silence nenecham\rbehat na svobode!\fNajdu ho a rozdrtim!\f

en: It's up to you then, Eagle!\rHail the Prince of the Skies!\fGood luck!\f
cz: Je to na vas, Eagle!\rAt zije Princ nebes!\fHodne stesti!\f

en: No way I'm losing to a fake me!
That was Andy's clone? Wow... It\rwas a powerful opponent.
cz: To byl Andyho klon? Pane... Byl\rto silny protivnik.

en: We owe it all to Eagle!
Grit!\f
Howdy, Sonja!\rHow y'all doing?\f
I've finally got our foe by the tail.\fI need you to convey some intel\rto Andy and his friends.\f
cz: Konecne mam nepritele za ocas.\fPotrebuji, abyste predal zpravu\rAndymu a jeho pratelum.\f

en: And what are you gonna\rbe doing in the meanwhile, darlin'?\f
cz: A copak budete zatim\rdelat vy, zlaticko?\f

en: I need to survey the situation.\fDon't worry, I won't do\ranything foolish.\fFather warned me to take care.\f
cz: Musim prozkoumat situaci.\fNebojte, neudelam\rzadnou hloupost.\fOtec me varoval, at davam pozor.\f

en: You wouldn't be trying to pull\rthe wool over my eyes, would you?\f
cz: Nechcete mi nahodou\rvesat buliky na nos, ze ne?\f

en: Of course not.\fYou'll go, won't you?\f
cz: Samozrejme ze ne.\fPujdete tam, ze ano?\f

en: Well, I reckon I have to.\fStay put now, I'll be right back.\f
cz: No, asi mi nic jineho nezbyva.\fZustante tady, hned jsem zpatky.\f

en: There's no way I'm losing to this guy!
That wasn't him!
If we don't stop this enigma\rsoon, Eagle might...
cz: Jestli tu zahadu brzy\rnezastavime, Eagle mozna...

en: So... you're the one\rbehind all this chaos.\fDo you have a name, or\rshould we just call you Disaster?\f
cz: Takze... vy stojite\rza vsim tim chaosem.\fMate jmeno, nebo vam mame\rrikat proste Pohroma?\f

en: My name is... Sturm.\f
Well Sturm, we've finally\rhunted you down.\fTime to pay the piper, as they say.\f
cz: Tak, Sturme, konecne jsme\rvas vystopovali.\fTed prijde placeni uctu, rika se.\f

en: Hunted down? Me?\fYou've done nothing but enter\rthe door that I opened for you.\f
cz: Vystopovali? Mne?\fJen jste vesli do dveri,\rktere jsem vam sam otevrel.\f

en: What?\f
Did you think I didn't\rnotice you, little girl?\fYou and your pathetic strategy\rgames! Is that all you're good for?\f
cz: Myslela sis, ze jsem si te\rnevsiml, holcicko?\fTy a tvoje ubohe strategicke\rhricky! Nic jineho neumis?\f

en: What? But... that's...\ryou couldn't...\fAre you saying you've\rknown all along?\f
cz: Coze? Ale... to je...\rto prece nejde...\fChcete rict, ze jste to\rvedel cely cas?\f

en: You've made one stupid\rmistake after another...\fDid you imagine yourself a match\rfor me? You conceited fool!\fIt's time to put an end to this farce.\rTime to pay the piper, was it?\f
cz: Delala jsi jednu hloupou\rchybu za druhou...\fMyslela sis, ze se mi vyrovnas?\rTy domysliva hlupacko!\fJe cas skoncit tuhle frasku.\rPlaceni uctu, rikalas?\f

en: ...\fI'm sorry, Father...\fI've broken my promise...\f
I win!
That should about do it!
Victory is mine!
Andy! I wanted to face you\rone more time.\fLet's go!\f
cz: Andy! Chtel jsem se ti postavit\rjeste jednou.\fJdeme na to!\f

en: Yahoo!
I've got more where that came from!
He's not such a bad guy...\rbut he's so stubborn.
cz: Neni to spatny clovek...\rale je strasne tvrdohlavy.

en: Did I go too far?
Yes!!! I won!
That was a piece of cake!
Victory is mine!
Yes!
I suspected as much.
I win!
My strategy was merely better...\rThat is all.
cz: Moje strategie byla proste lepsi...\rTo je vse.

en: Hmph! As expected!
Yeah! I won!
Who would have thought you could\roppose me?
cz: Kdo by cekal, ze se mi\rdokazete postavit?

en: There's nothing left for me to tell\ryou. Congratulations, graduate!
cz: Uz vas nemam co ucit.\rGratuluji, absolvente!

en: As you complete battles, your rank\rwill rise. This is a special card that\fallows you to check your ranking\rat any time. Congratulations!\f
cz: S kazdou bitvou vase hodnoceni\rstoupa. Tahle zvlastni karta vam\fumozni podivat se na vasi hodnost\rkdykoli budete chtit. Gratuluji!\f
